title: Information-Theoretic Privacy Control for Sequential Multi-Agent LLM Systems
summary: Sequential multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems are increasingly deployed in sensitive domains such as healthcare, finance, and enterprise decision-making, where multiple specialized agents collaboratively process a single user request. Although individual agents may satisfy local privacy constraints, sensitive information can still be inferred through sequential composition and intermediate representations. In this work, we study \emph{compositional privacy leakage} in sequential LLM agent pipelines. We formalize leakage using mutual information and derive a theoretical bound that characterizes how locally introduced leakage can amplify across agents under sequential execution. Motivated by this analysis, we propose a privacy-regularized training framework that directly constrains information flow between agent outputs and agent-local sensitive variables. We evaluate our approach across sequential agent pipelines of varying depth on three benchmark datasets, demonstrating stable optimization dynamics and consistent, interpretable privacy-utility trade-offs. Our results show that privacy in agentic LLM systems cannot be guaranteed by local constraints alone and must instead be treated as a system-level property during both training and deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究顺序多智能体LLM流水线中的"组合式隐私泄漏"：即使每个智能体各自满足本地隐私约束，敏感信息仍会通过中间表示的逐级传递与复用在系统层面被推断并放大。作者用互信息形式化泄漏，证明了局部预算到全局泄漏的指数级放上界（Σ2^{N−i}εᵢ），并提出基于MINE（DV变分互信息估计）的隐私正则化训练框架MINE-Reg，在MedQA、FinQA、PrivacyLens三个基准、N=2~5的顺序流水线上验证：MI_avg下降75–90%，SB提升0.35~0.50，BS仅下降6–10个百分点，综合指标PARI从约0.46提升至0.87~0.90。
AI.motivation: 顺序多智能体LLM系统（医疗、金融、企业决策）被广泛部署：单个用户请求经N个专门化智能体逐级处理，前一智能体的中间表示、摘要或工具输出成为后一智能体的输入。每个智能体可能持有agent-local敏感上下文（内部策略、路由逻辑、私有记忆、机密数据），下游智能体虽无直接访问权限，但中间消息与表示中保留的统计依赖使得敏感属性可被逆向推断；因此"每个智能体本地安全"并不等于"系统整体安全"。现有工作主要关注单模型的记忆化、成员推断、训练期差分隐私，以及多智能体中的对抗性提示传播、信任失准、记忆投毒等，但缺乏对"表示在顺序组合中传播/放大"这一现象的定量刻画，也缺乏随流水线深度可扩展的组合式保证。启发式防御（净化、访问控制、提示过滤）只关注表层披露，无法刻画中间表示中的潜在统计依赖。
AI.method:
【问题建模】顺序流水线更新规则 O_i = A_i(O_{i−1}, D_i, S_i)，O_0=∅；D_i为公开/任务相关输入，S_i为agent-local敏感变量，O_i为输出表示。假设条件Markov结构 S_{i−1}→(O_{i−1},D_i,S_i)→O_i→O_{i+1}→…→O_N，且S_i相互独立。全局组合泄漏定义为 L_global = I(O_N; S_1,…,S_N)；本地泄漏 I(O_i;S_i) ≤ ε_i。
【理论】定理4.1（累积泄漏界）：I(O_N;S_1,…,S_N) ≤ Σ_{i=1}^N 2^{N−i} ε_i；一致情形为 (2^N−1)ε，即早期智能体泄漏以指数权重放大。证明（附录A.1）用MI链式法则 + 条件数据处理不等式展开，得到递推 L_i ≤ ε_i + Σ_{j<i} L_j，从而 U_i ≤ ε_i + 2U_{i−1}。命题4.2给出早期智能体泄漏主导性（贡献权重 2^{N−i}）。
【方法（MINE-Reg）】训练目标 L_total = L_utility + Σ_i β_i·I(O_i;S_i)。MI 用 Donsker–Varadhan 表示的 MINE 变分估计（Belghazi et al., 2018），critic T_ψ 为两层MLP（隐层256，ReLU），通过批内打乱敏感变量构造边缘乘积样本，指数移动平均稳定对数配分项；critic 最大化 MI、agent 参数最小化该量，形成每个agent边界的信息瓶颈。三阶段交替优化：前向+效用损失→更新critic→更新agent参数。
【实验】基准：MedQA（医学推理）、FinQA（金融数值推理）、PrivacyLens（情境隐私规范，附录A.4）。深度 N∈{2,3,4,5}，角色为输入解释者、任务推理者、上下文精炼者、隐私感知重写者、合规检查者；各agent为独立LLM，不共享参数。模型：Qwen-2B/4B、LLaMA-3B/7B，LoRA（rank 8）微调，AdamW lr=2e−5，batch 16，3随机种子。指标：CE、BS、LA、SB、OS、BO、MI_avg、复合指标PARI（RC/OT/PI/RT加权 0.3/0.1/0.5/0.1）。消融：隐私权重β∈{0,1e−3,1e−2,1e−1,1}、选择性正则化（仅早期/全部）、表示压缩效应（I(O_i;y) vs I(O_i;S_i)）、对抗探针鲁棒性。
AI.result: 【MedQA/FinQA】MI_avg 大幅下降约75–90%（Qwen-4B 2-agent：0.54→0.06，约−89%；5-agent：1.02→0.13；LLaMA-7B FinQA：0.51→0.06、1.10→0.15）。SB 提升约+0.35~0.50（Qwen-4B MedQA 0.38→0.82、0.22→0.71）。PI 从基线的0（定义使然）升至约0.69–0.89。效用侧：BS 对大模型降6–8点、小模型降8–10点，CE 温和上升（Qwen-4B 1.40→1.58；LLaMA-3B 5-agent 2.02→2.21）。PARI 大幅提升：Qwen-4B MedQA 0.477→0.903（2-agent）、0.459→0.874（5-agent）；LLaMA-7B FinQA 0.481→0.905、0.458→0.872。【深度趋势】基线 MI_avg 随深度单调放大（LLaMA-7B MedQA 0.49→1.05），与定理4.1的深度依赖放大一致；MINE-Reg 曲线被压平，5-agent仍<0.35。分布分析（LLaMA-3B 小提琴图）：基线 SB≈0.20–0.40、MINE-Reg 中位数≈0.70、上四分位>0.80；PARI 基线0.44–0.48 vs MINE-Reg 0.87–0.90；OS 基线<0.10 vs MINE-Reg 0.55–0.70。【信息论验证】MI_avg 与 SB 强负相关（Qwen-4B FinQA Pearson ρ=−0.959 基线、−0.986 MINE-Reg），正则化后斜率更陡，说明低泄漏区间的敏感性更高。【PrivacyLens（Qwen-2B/LLaMA-3B）】MI_avg 下降约65–80%，SB 随深度一致上升，LA 与 MI_avg 近线性对应，OS 提升一个数量级以上（如 Qwen-2B 2-agent 0.12→0.65）。【消融】β 增大时总泄漏单调下降而验证精度平缓退化，无相变，说明优化景观良态且β是稳定可解释的隐私旋钮；仅正则化早期agent虽显著降泄漏但残留大，全agent正则化泄漏最低；I(O_i;y) 下降明显慢于 I(O_i;S_i)，表明正则器选择性抑制敏感信息而非坍缩表示；对抗探针准确率随β单调降至接近随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 核心结论：顺序多智能体LLM系统中的隐私不能由局部（per-agent）约束保证，必须被视为训练与部署阶段的系统级属性——局部预算在顺序组合下会以指数权重放大为全局泄漏，早期agent是泄漏的关键放大点，因此需要显式约束中间表示与agent-local敏感变量之间的信息流。方法上，MI正则化（MINE-Reg）以可微分、表示级的方式直接压制累积泄漏，在几乎不损失良性任务性能的前提下大幅提升系统级隐私与整体可靠性，且优化动力学稳定、隐私-效用折中单调可解释。局限与展望：结论基于Markov结构与S_i独立的假设，且各agent有明确角色分工（后段agent本身也被分配了隐私职责，存在一定"设计性"泄漏抑制）；理论界为上界且指数形式较为粗糙；实验限于2B–7B级模型、LoRA微调与固定角色流水线；未来方向包括动态/自适应流水线、泄露感知的编排、与差分隐私或安全推理的结合、更大基础模型与多模态agent系统、以及对并行/层级交互拓扑的推广。

title: The Coordination Gap: Alternation Metrics for Temporal Dynamics in Multi-Agent Battle of the Exes
comment: 40 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to Mathematical Social Sciences
summary:
Multi-agent coordination dilemmas expose a fundamental tension between individual optimization and collective welfare, yet characterizing such coordination requires metrics sensitive to temporal structure and collective dynamics. As a diagnostic testbed, we study a BoE-derived multi-agent variant of the Battle of the Exes, formalizing it as a Markov game in which turn-taking emerges as a periodic coordination regime. Conventional outcome-based metrics (e.g., efficiency and min/max fairness) are temporally blind -- they cannot distinguish structured alternation from monopolistic or random access patterns -- and fairness ratios lose discriminative power as n grows, obscuring inequities.
  To address this limitation, we introduce Perfect Alternation (PA) as a reference coordination regime and propose six novel Alternation (ALT) metrics designed as temporally sensitive observables of coordination quality. Using Q-learning agents as a minimal adaptive diagnostic baseline, and comparing against random-policy null processes, we uncover a clear measurement failure: despite exhibiting deceptively high traditional metrics (e.g., reward fairness often exceeding 0.9), learned policies perform up to 81% below random baselines under ALT-variant evaluation -- a deficit already present in the two-agent case and intensifying as n grows.
  These results demonstrate, in this setting, that high aggregate payoffs can coexist with poor temporal coordination, and that conventional metrics may severely mischaracterize emergent dynamics. Our findings underscore the necessity of temporally aware observables for analyzing coordination in multi-agent games and highlight random-policy baselines as essential null processes for interpreting coordination outcomes relative to chance-level behavior.

AI.tldr: 论文针对多智能体协调 dilemmas 中传统指标无法捕捉时间结构的问题，提出完美交替（PA）参考机制和6种ALT时间敏感指标。实验表明，即使传统指标显示高公平性（>0.9），Q-learning策略在ALT评估下比随机基线差81%，证明传统指标存在严重误判风险，呼吁使用时间感知观测器和随机基线作为null过程。
AI.motivation: 解决多智能体协调 dilemma 中的一个根本问题：传统结果指标（如效率和公平性）是“时间盲目”的，无法区分结构化交替、垄断性访问或随机访问模式。随着智能体数量n增长，公平性比率的判别能力下降，掩盖了不平等现象。
AI.method: 提出完美交替（Perfect Alternation, PA）作为参考协调机制，设计6种新的交替（ALT）指标作为协调质量的时间敏感观测器。使用Q-learning智能体作为最小自适应诊断基线，与随机策略null过程进行对比。
AI.result: 尽管表现出虚高的传统指标（如奖励公平性常超过0.9），但在ALT变体评估下，学习策略表现比随机基线低81%。这种赤字在双智能体情况下已存在，并随n增长而加剧。
AI.conclusion: 高聚合收益可能与糟糕的时间协调共存，传统指标可能严重误解涌现动力学。随机策略基线是解释协调结果必不可少的null过程。 temporally aware observables对于分析多智能体游戏中的协调至关重要。

title: Evaluating LLM Alignment With Human Trust Models
comment: This paper will appear in the post-proceedings of ICAART 2026
summary: Trust plays a pivotal role in enabling effective cooperation, reducing uncertainty, and guiding decision-making in both human interactions and multi-agent systems. Although it is significant, there is limited understanding of how large language models (LLMs) internally conceptualize and reason about trust. This work presents a white-box analysis of trust representation in EleutherAI/gpt-j-6B, using contrastive prompting to generate embedding vectors within the activation space of the LLM for diadic trust and related interpersonal relationship attributes. We first identified trust-related concepts from five established human trust models. We then determined a threshold for significant conceptual alignment by computing pairwise cosine similarities across 60 general emotional concepts. Then we measured the cosine similarities between the LLM's internal representation of trust and the derived trust-related concepts. Our results show that the internal trust representation of EleutherAI/gpt-j-6B aligns most closely with the Castelfranchi socio-cognitive model, followed by the Marsh Model. These findings indicate that LLMs encode socio-cognitive constructs in their activation space in ways that support meaningful comparative analyses, inform theories of social cognition, and support the design of human-AI collaborative systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个白盒（white-box）评测框架，用对比提示（contrastive prompting）提取 LLM（EleutherAI/gpt-j-6B）内部激活空间中"信任"及人际关系的概念向量，再与五个经典人类信任模型（Marsh、Mayer、McAllister、McKnight、Castelfranchi）的概念结构做余弦相似度对齐。方法上分两阶段：先用 30 个正负情绪概念（双向展开为 60 个）计算两两余弦相似度分布，取 80 分位（≈0.6）作为"显著对齐"阈值；再将各信任模型所属概念与"trust1"向量比较，以（1）带符号平均余弦相似度、（2）超阈值概念数量两项指标判定。结果：GPT-J-6B 的内部信任表征与 Castelfranchi 社会认知模型对齐最强（平均 0.7303，8 个概念超阈值），其次为 Marsh 模型（0.6973，7 个）；Mayer 模型最低（0.4530），其中 risk1（-0.8462）与 benevolence2（-0.1434）甚至与信任呈负相关，说明 LLM 未按理论编码部分"正向"关联。
AI.motivation: 信任（trust）是人类与多智能体系统中促成合作、降低不确定性、引导决策的关键心理状态，但学界对"信任应如何定义与操作化"缺乏共识，既有研究多停留在黑箱层面：只用 LLM 的输入输出去推断信任动态或生成建立信任的策略，却不清楚 LLM 内部究竟如何表征和推理信任。作者指出，至今没有工作对支撑信任相关认知的内部激活模式做白盒考察。空白在于：既不知道 LLM 是否真的"理解"信任，也不知道这种推理如何在底层计算结构中涌现。作者希望回答一个具体问题——LLM 激活空间中隐含的信任表征，与人类理论所提出的概念结构（能力、善意、可靠性、可预测性、意愿等）究竟对齐到什么程度；若能对齐，则可为社会认知理论提供模型侧证据，也可为人机协作系统的设计（如信任感知的 AI、激活引导式的行为调控）提供可操作机制。
AI.method: 方法分两个阶段，基于 mechanistic interpretability 的 persona vector 思路（difference-in-means + 线性探测）。**技术细节**：选取完全开源、可无限制访问分层激活的 EleutherAI/gpt-j-6B（28 层、4096 维）作为被试模型；用 GPT-4o 为每个概念生成 100 条正向、100 条负向的一句话故事；提示模板以固定背景句（"Katherine 与 Alice 是同一开发团队的软件工程师同事"）开头，后接针对具体概念的"正向/反向"指令；将所有语句输入 GPT-J，逐层提取每层所有 token 的隐状态并做 token 平均得到句向量，再对正/负语句分别取层均值，二者相减得到该层的"概念方向"，堆叠成 (28, 4096) 张量，最后跨层平均得到单一概念向量。**双向性（dyadic）处理**：因信任是有方向的，每个概念拆为 concept1（Katherine→Alice）与 concept2（Alice→Katherine）。**阶段一（阈值标定）**：选取 30 个正负情绪/特质概念（快乐、理解、平静、满意、骄傲、兴趣、自信、友好、舒适、合作、信任、接纳、耐心、希望、乐观 / 愤怒、嫉妒、苦涩、不诚实、沮丧、贪婪、多疑、绝望、悲伤、受伤、恐惧、否认、破坏性、残忍、困惑），因双向展开为 60 个概念，计算全部两两余弦相似度，画直方图并取右尾 80 分位数作为"显著对齐"阈值（文中取 0.6，即仅保留相似度最高的 20%）。**阶段二（模型对齐量化）**：从五个信任模型中抽取其核心概念（Table 1 共 20 个概念），为每个概念按模型中与信任的因果/关联方向确定方向性（如 cooperation2 指向 trust1），计算与 trust1（Katherine 对 Alice 的信任）的余弦相似度；两个评价指标：(a) 带符号平均余弦相似度（负值保留原符号计入）；(b) 超过阈值的概念数量。
AI.result: **阶段一**：相似度热力图显示 GPT-J-6B 的激活空间确实把语义相近的概念聚在一起、把对立概念分开，说明该潜空间可用于有意义的概念比较；阈值定为 0.6。**阶段二**（各模型平均余弦相似度 / 超阈值概念数）：Castelfranchi 0.7303 / 8（含 confidence1 0.9225、reputation1 0.8963、willingness2 0.8858、competence2 0.8504、commitment2 0.8450、security1 0.8089、reliability2 0.7667、predictable2 0.7141）最强；Marsh 0.6973 / 7 次之；McAllister 0.6704 / 4；McKnight 0.6640 / 5；Mayer 0.4530 / 5 最弱。绝大多数概念与 trust1 呈正相关，唯三例为负：Mayer 与 McKnight 的 benevolence2 (-0.1434) 及 Mayer 的 risk1 (-0.8462)。作者分析这说明即使提示明确将"risk"框定为"愿意冒险/承担脆弱性"（Mayer 认为信任提升风险承受意愿）、将 benevolence 框定为 Mayer 式的善意，模型内部仍把 risk 与 trust 强烈区分、把 benevolence 与 trust 拉开，暗示 LLM 对这些"理论上正向"关系的编码方式与人类模型不同（可能更贴近"与信任存在性无关"或一般负面语义）。附雷达图于补充材料。
AI.conclusion: 结论与意义：LLM 激活空间可承载并可量化社会认知构念（trust、competence、commitment 等关系），GPT-J-6B 的内部信任表征最贴近 Castelfranchi 的社会认知理论（信任=基于对受托方能力、意愿、可预测性的信念的心理状态），其次为 Marsh 的计算信任模型；这既为社会认知理论提供了模型侧证据，也说明 LLM 编码复杂社会心理结构的方式与某些人类概念化存在偏差（risk、benevolence）。实践启示：可利用与信任模型对应的潜在嵌入在生成时注入激活以引导模型行为（如鼓励 competence、reliability、willingness），从而构建信任感知的 AI 系统、可用于监测交互主体（如教练与运动员）间的信任水平并给出关系改善建议；量化潜在表征也为系统研究 LLM 涌现的信任推理模式提供了工具。局限与未来工作：仅分析单一模型 gpt-j-6B，需扩展到更多可访问内部表征的开源模型以比较不同 LLM 与各信任模型的对齐差异；使用静态嵌入而非随对话动态更新的表征，未覆盖多轮交互中信任推理的演化；尚未与人类行为数据做外部效度验证，未来需在交互式设定中检验并做人类基准对照。

title: Towards Neural Graph Data Management
summary: While AI systems have made remarkable progress in processing unstructured text, structured data such as graphs stored in databases, continues to grow rapidly yet remains difficult for neural models to effectively utilize. We introduce NGDBench, a unified benchmark for evaluating neural graph database capabilities across five diverse domains, including finance, medicine, and AI agent tooling. Unlike prior benchmarks limited to elementary logical operations, NGDBench supports the full Cypher query language, enabling complex pattern matching, variable-length paths, and numerical aggregations, while incorporating realistic noise injection and dynamic data management operations. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs and RAG methods reveals significant limitations in structured reasoning, noise robustness, and analytical precision, establishing NGDBench as a critical testbed for advancing neural graph data management. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/NGDBench.

AI.tldr: NGDBench 是首个面向"神经图数据管理"的统一基准：它把五个真实领域（社交、金融、生物医药、AI Agent 工具、企业财报）的结构化与非结构化数据统一为标签属性图（LPG），为每个实例配对"干净潜在图"与"扰动观测图"，并支持完整 Cypher 查询语言（复杂模式匹配、可变长路径、数值聚合）以及 CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE 动态管理操作。作者用 Text-to-Cypher（Neo4j-Text2Cypher、GPT-5.1-Codex、DeepSeek-V3.2、Qwen3-Coder）与 GraphRAG（GraphRAG、HippoRAG2、ToG-RAG）等两大范式评测，结论是现有方法在结构化推理、抗噪鲁棒性、聚合精度与动态状态跟踪上全面受限（如 NGD-Fin 聚合 MSLE：Oracle 0.355 vs 最佳 LLM 15.9；GraphRAG 达 52.5），为噪声感知查询与误差累积控制指明方向。
AI.motivation: 现实世界的关键决策数据（企业、金融机构内部的关系型/图/企业系统数据）具有异质、持续演化、含噪与信息不完整等特征。现有数据栈是"被动"的：传统数据库依赖显式 schema 做符号匹配，只能返回已存储的记录；向量数据库仅做相似度检索，无法做复杂逻辑查询；RAG / Text-to-SQL / Text-to-Cypher 等 Agent 接口同样只暴露观测到的事实，无法推断隐含的潜在关系（如在含噪数据中识别隐藏的欺诈团伙、多跳隐式结构）。因此作者主张下一代数据管理系统应为"神经数据库（neural database）"：结合精确查询执行能力与神经推断能力，能挖掘潜在关系、区分信号与噪声、并在数据演化时保持状态一致性。图结构天然支持这一愿景（可容纳实体、属性、关系、多跳依赖，并可涵盖关系表），但现有 Neural Graph Database 与复杂逻辑查询回答方法多局限于存在型一阶逻辑（EPFO/FOL），把含无效边与缺失边的观测图当作事实来源，且不支持插入/删除/更新等状态变更操作；现有基准（Q2B、LitCQD、NRN、EFO_k-CQA、RelBench v2、4DBInfer）大多静态、同质、模态单一，无法检验系统能否在异构、含噪、不完整、动态演化的图数据上执行完整数据库级查询。
AI.method:
1）数据准备与统一（LPG 模式）：五个领域构建 NGD 前缀数据集。结构化：NGD-BI（源自 LDBC-BI，社交网络，多对多稠密关系）、NGD-Fin（源自 LDBC-FIN，金融交易，含时序与数值属性）、NGD-Prime（源自 PrimeKG，疾病/药物/基因/生物过程的稠密跨类型关系）；非结构化：NGD-MCP（源自 Toucan-1.5M 的 MCP 工具与轨迹数据，刻画 Agent 工作流依赖）、NGD-Econ（源自 LongBench 公司年报，跨文档聚合与隐式业务关联）。后者经 AutoSchemaKG 抽取实体/关系/schema 后实例化为 LPG，规模示例：NGD-BI 约 300 万节点/1719 万边，NGD-Prime 12.9 万节点/810 万边，NGD-MCP 18.2 万节点/35.1 万边，NGD-Econ 3.3 万节点/6.4 万边，NGD-Fin 1.1 万节点/5.8 万边。

2）扰动生成器（可配置、可追溯）：基于真实数据质量报告与已有合成噪声研究的调研（真实噪声从 0.55% 属性错误到超过 70% 关系缺失不等，单一固定比例不可行），将扰动设计为参数化环境而非固定噪声基准。五类噪声家族及默认比例：incomplete_edges 0.10（缺失事实）、false_edges 0.15（虚假链接/抽取错误）、relation_type_noise 0.20（关系类型歧义）、node_type_noise 0.20（实体类型歧义）、attribute_noise 0.25（拼写/OCR/数值偏差）。每个观测图输出 noise log 文件，记录被改动的节点/边/标签/属性。非结构化图不做额外扰动，其抽取管线天然含实体重复、指称变体、关系抽取错误与类型推断错误。

3）查询生成：采用 LPG + Cypher（Neo4j / FalkorDB 通用）。从官方算子集与生产查询中抽取 29 个核心功能算子（23 分析型 + 5 管理型；表 8 分五类：数据访问 Scan/Seek；遍历匹配 Expand/VarLengthExpand/ShortestPath/Repeat/Optional/Anti/Triadic；连接与集合 HashJoin/Apply/CartesianProduct/Argument/Union；过滤投影 Filter/Project/Distinct；聚合控制 Aggregate/Unwind/Sort/Limit/Skip/Top；数据修改 Create/Merge/Delete/Set/Foreach）。模板分三阶段：Phase 1 基础骨架（值无关）、Phase 2 复杂度增强（路径逻辑、关系逻辑、复杂过滤，构成 NoAgg 集）、Phase 3 聚合扩展（Sum/Min/Max/Avg/Count，构成 Agg 集）。扰动感知采样器按用户指定的"干净区域/噪声区域"比例在图上实例化模板；再用 LLM 将 Cypher 重写为自然语言问题，形成文本-查询配对实例。对答案数 <32 的查询保留原样，否则改写为布尔验证任务（从真答案采正例、从无关实体采负例，逐候选判断是否满足约束）。管理类查询模板覆盖 Create/Merge/Delete/Set/Foreach，每个模板含 Pre-validation + Update + Post-validation；批次由参数化骨架 → 参数实例化（注入合法 ID 与属性）→ 批次组装三步生成，标准 K=5 步，包含 Uniform（同一算子重复）与 Mixed（插入/删除交错）两类。

4）任务形式化：Task I 鲁棒分析查询——设潜在干净图 G*、观测图 G̃=Φ(G*)，模型 f_θ 基于 q 与 G̃ 输出答案或形式化查询，真值 a*=Exec(q, G*)，目标为 min_θ L(f_θ(q, G̃), a*)。Task II 动态数据管理序列编辑——初始状态 G_0，每步 t 接收修改指令 m_t 与验证查询 q_t，H_t=⟨G_0,m_1,…,m_t⟩，G_t=Apply(G_{t-1}, m_t)，a_t=Exec(q_t, G_t)，预测 â_t=argmax P_θ(a|q_t,H_t)，指标为逐步准确率 L_step=(1/T)ΣI(â_t=a_t)，会惩罚中间状态跟踪错误。

5）评测设置：Oracle Cypher 在 Neo4j 上分别于干净图与扰动图执行（干净图结果为目标答案，扰动图结果作为"仅能观测噪声"方法的上界）。指标：NoAgg 用 Jaccard/F1；Boolean 用 Accuracy；Agg 用 MdRE、MSLE、sMAPE；管理用 MLRE、MSLE、sMAPE。基线：Text-to-Cypher（Neo4j-Text2Cypher、GPT-5.1-Codex、DeepSeek-V3.2、Qwen3-Coder-480B）与 GraphRAG（Qwen3-0.6B 稠密三元组检索器，top-15）。传统 CQA 方法与通用向量库被排除（无法执行完整 Cypher / 仅相似检索）。非结构化数据另比较 GraphRAG、HippoRAG2、ToG-RAG，报告 token 级 F1 与 MSLE。
AI.result: 结构化域分析查询：Text-to-Cypher 整体优于 GraphRAG（后者在 NGD-BI 上 F1 仅 0.001，NGD-Prime 聚合 MdRE 达 705.7），因为结构化执行可取回完整匹配而 GraphRAG 依赖 top-k 稠密检索、易漏证据。但 Text-to-Cypher 受观测噪声上界约束：NGD-Fin 无聚合 Jaccard 分别为 Oracle 0.448、Qwen3-Coder 0.441、GPT-5.1-Codex 0.358、DeepSeek-V3.2 0.345、Neo4j-Text2Cypher 0.319、GraphRAG 0.004；聚合 MSLE Oracle 0.355，而 GPT-5.1-Codex 15.9、DeepSeek-V3.2 20.9、Qwen3-Coder 22.7、Neo4j-Text2Cypher 45.6、GraphRAG 52.5。附录一致/不一致子集拆分显示：答案在扰动后不变的一致性子集上各模型误差接近 0，而在答案被噪声改变的不一致子集上急剧劣化（如 NGD-Prime 聚合 MdRE 0.237–0.582，MSLE 12.3–14.2；GraphRAG MdRE 993.6），说明"观测数据与潜在真值之间的差距"是核心瓶颈——既有 CQA 工作只考虑缺失边（开放世界假设），而本文表明噪声边与属性污染同样致命，且推翻了"仅删除边即可"的简单去噪范式。布尔查询：GraphRAG 大幅提升并与 Text-to-Cypher competitive，说明候选式 formulation 收窄了检索空间、稠密检索更可靠，而 Text-to-Cypher 需更复杂 Cypher 逻辑反而不便。管理/动态任务：Text-to-Cypher 表现较好（可生成显式编辑操作），但存在误差累积，早期错误更新会级联传播到后续状态；GraphRAG 因在上下文中推理完整编辑历史反而缓解级联错误（尽管绝对误差仍大，如 NGD-Fin MLRE 5.129、NGD-Prime MSLE 41.8）。非结构化域：GraphRAG 最优（NGD-MCP Agg MSLE 0.169 / NoAgg F1 0.194；NGD-Econ 0.673 / 0.242），优于 HippoRAG2（1.050 / 0.022；2.138 / 0.040）与 ToG-RAG（0.359 / 0.013；3.809 / 0.212），说明直接检索文本化三元组比从原始段落重建推理图证据更强，但绝对性能仍低（最佳 NoAgg F1 < 0.25）。失败案例揭示两类模式：Text-to-Cypher 的符号执行无法从缺失边恢复（噪声图返回 8807 vs 干净真值 7957）或误解 schema/类型（把 Cotinine 当作 molfunc 实体，答案 0）；GraphRAG 因 top-k 截断导致聚合失败（平均点赞数真值 23.7056，输出 Zero；工具计数真值 12，只数到 3）以及多跳路径断裂（无法保留完整 followed_by 链）。
AI.conclusion: NGDBench 确立了"超越被动记录检索、在潜在图结构上做神经推断"的数据管理新范式：它通过五域统一 LPG、干净潜在图与扰动观测图配对、完整 Cypher 与动态管理操作，把噪声鲁棒性与状态一致性纳入可复现评测协议。实验显示现有 LLM Text-to-Cypher 与 GraphRAG 范式均无法同时满足精确执行、完整召回、抗噪与动态状态跟踪要求：符号执行路径受观测噪声上界限制，检索路径受 top-k 截断与结构断裂限制。作者由此提出未来研究议程：噪声感知查询（噪声感知建模与恢复潜在真值）、序列编辑中的误差累积控制、以及面向下一代神经数据管理系统的标准化评测协议。局限：动态管理负载目前仅覆盖结构化图（对抽取型知识图谱的增删改需要事实依据与领域校验，暂难定义）；尚未评估执行效率、内存开销、不确定性校准与证据质量；NL 问题由 LLM 自动生成，存在一定生成偏置。

title: Conversational Demand Response: Bidirectional Aggregator-Prosumer Coordination through Agentic AI
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Code available at: https://github.com/RedaElMakroum/cdr
summary: Residential demand response depends on sustained prosumer participation, yet existing coordination is either fully automated, or limited to one-way dispatch signals and price alerts that offer little possibility for informed decision-making. This paper introduces Conversational Demand Response (CDR), a coordination mechanism where aggregators and prosumers interact through bidirectional natural language, enabled through agentic AI. A two-tier multi-agent architecture is developed in which an aggregator agent dispatches flexibility requests and a prosumer Home Energy Management System (HEMS) assesses deliverability and cost-benefit by calling an optimization-based tool. CDR also enables prosumer-initiated upstream communication, where changes in preferences can reach the aggregator directly. Proof-of-concept evaluation shows that interactions complete in under 12 seconds. The architecture illustrates how agentic AI can bridge the aggregator-prosumer coordination gap, providing the scalability of automated DR while preserving the transparency, explainability, and user agency necessary for sustained prosumer participation. All system components, including agent prompts, orchestration logic, and simulation interfaces, are released as open source to enable reproducibility and further development.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"会话式需求响应"（Conversational Demand Response, CDR），利用智能体AI（LLM代理）在聚合商与 prosumer（产消者）之间建立双向自然语言协调机制。作者构建两层多智能体架构：聚合商智能体负责组合级调度与上游消息路由，prosumer 侧 HEMS 编排器通过调用基于MILP优化的子智能体工具量化灵活性可行性与成本收益，再以自然语言呈现给用户并获得批准后执行。概念验证显示交互延迟低于12秒、单次不超过3.5万token，全部代码（提示词、编排逻辑、优化器、仿真接口）已开源。
AI.motivation: 要实现2030年500 GW的需求响应容量，住宅侧产消者的持续参与是关键，但自愿参与率很少超过20%。文献综述表明，交互质量、沟通清晰度、信息可解释性是决定持续参与的关键因素，复杂性、控制感缺失与努力成本是主要障碍。当前聚合商-产消者接口存在三重结构性缺陷：(1) 缺乏透明度与可解释性——产消者只收到调度信号，不清楚请求内容及补偿是否反映其真实灵活性价值；(2) 缺乏实时适应性——聚合商无法根据产消者当前状况调整请求，产消者也无法在激活前传达变化的约束；(3) 交互仍是单向的——产消者只能服从或退出，无法协商条件或主动提供灵活性。完全自动化虽降低认知负荷却损害长期参与所需的透明度与用户自主权；而既有LLM研究（家庭侧对话式HEMS、聚合商侧多智能体/数字孪生）两条技术路线彼此割裂，尚无工作弥合该协调缺口。
AI.method: 提出两层多智能体系统：（1）聚合商智能体——接收市场信号或运营指令，从注册容量中筛选目标家庭，构造含时段、目标功率与补偿率的DR事件；不评估家庭级可行性（刻意分工，可行性留在本地），并对上游消息分类路由：资产更新与偏好变更直接应用，合约修改或投诉则升级处理。（2）prosumer侧HEMS——层级式编排器采用ReAct模式迭代推理与行动，将任务委派给按负载划分的专精子智能体（家电智能体为单轮交互，返回结构化建议）；编排器有常规调度模式与DR事件模式两种，DR模式下解析请求、推理最适合响应的资产、委派子智能体评估，并将技术结果翻译为包含请求细节、可交付容量、预期影响与补偿的会话式说明，经产消者批准后提交承诺。（3）电池子智能体以MILP优化器为可调用工具：24小时时域、15分钟分辨率（96时段），目标函数最小化净购电成本、电池退化成本与峰值放电正则项，约束包括每时段能量平衡（含PV）、SoC递推与上下限、放电不超过负荷（禁止DR事件外电池上网）、峰值跟踪、充放电与购售电互斥的Big-M约束，以及自发自用优先约束。DR可行性采用双重求解：先求无DR义务基线，再加入 p_dis ≥ p_DR 约束重解；若不可行则用二分搜索确定最大可交付水平；当日请求则将请求到达前的时段锁定为基线解（既成动作不可逆）。优化器输出可行性判定（完全/部分/不可行）、参与经济性与SoC轨迹。所有智能体使用GPT-OSS-120B（开启推理、温度为0）经Cerebras API（最高2500 tok/s）服务，优化器用PuLP求解；每个场景在独立上下文的隔离会话中运行以避免信息泄漏。基准测试覆盖6个场景（下游：接受、拒绝、5 kW高目标请求；上游：可用性变更、偏好修改、新资产注册），每个重复5次。
AI.result: 下游场景需3–5次推理迭代、2–4次工具调用，平均7.8–9.8秒；接受场景3.6±0.5迭代/23.4k tokens/8.3±2.1秒，高目标场景3.4±0.5迭代/21.8k/7.8±2.2秒且通过PV预充电实现3 kW完全可行，拒绝场景开销最高（5.0±0.7迭代、34.2±6.0k tokens、9.8±1.9秒），因其仍需执行完整可行性流程再额外组织拒绝解释。上游场景单次迭代、无工具调用，1.1–1.7秒、1.3–1.7k tokens。所有场景均未超过12秒与35,000 tokens，重复运行输出一致。下游示例中3 kW/17:00–19:00请求获完全可行、净收益1.13欧元、SoC 30%→43%，经用户批准后提交承诺并闭环更新组合；上游示例中度假偏好变更被HEMS确认并传播至聚合商重新优化组合。仿真参数：15 kWh电池、8 kW充放电、往返效率92%、SoC 20–90%、初始30%、上网电价0.04 €/kWh、退化成本0.015 €/kWh、DR补偿0.20 €/kWh、PV预测8.5 kWh/天。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM能力已足以支撑聚合商与产消者之间的双向自然语言DR协调，两个方向均可在秒级完成，架构同时具备自动化DR的可扩展性与非技术用户所需的透明度、可解释性与用户自主权。CDR并非替代常规自动控制，而是叠加一层会话式交互以提升参与意愿并使系统可读；实际部署需将此类接口集成进公用事业与聚合服务平台。云端推理带来的延迟与隐私问题可借边缘AI与模型量化实现本地部署加以缓解。局限与后续工作包括：并发多家庭负载下的延迟仍待验证；需要现场试验对比会话式与传统DR界面对产消者参与度的影响；扩展至多家庭组合协调是自然的下一步；该会话式协调模式有望推广至更高电网层级（如DSO-TSO交互）。全部系统组件已开源以支持复现与后续扩展。

title: Human-Data Interaction, Exploration, and Visualization in the AI Era: Challenges and Opportunities
summary: The rapid advancement of AI is transforming human-centered systems, with profound implications for human-AI interaction, human-data interaction, and visual analytics. In the AI era, data analysis increasingly involves large-scale, heterogeneous, and multimodal data that is predominantly unstructured, as well as foundation models such as LLMs and VLMs, which introduce additional uncertainty into analytical processes. These shifts expose persistent challenges for human-data interactive systems, including perceptually misaligned latency, scalability constraints, limitations of existing interaction and exploration paradigms, and growing uncertainty regarding the reliability and interpretability of AI-generated insights. Responding to these challenges requires moving beyond conventional efficiency and scalability metrics, redefining the roles of humans and machines in analytical workflows, and incorporating cognitive, perceptual, and design principles into every level of the human-data interaction stack. This paper investigates the challenges introduced by recent advances in AI and examines how these developments are reshaping the ways users engage with data, while outlining limitations and open research directions for building human-centered AI systems for interactive data analysis in the AI era.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了AI时代人机交互数据系统面临的挑战与研究方向，涵盖大规模异构多模态数据处理、大型基础模型引入的不确定性、延迟与可扩展性问题，以及现有交互范式的局限性，旨在为人机协作分析系统的设计提供新的框架与思路。
AI.motivation: AI的快速发展正在深刻改变以人为中心的系统，传统的人机交互范式面临前所未有的挑战，包括大规模异构多模态数据处理、基础模型引入的不确定性、以及对AI生成结果可靠性与可解释性的担忧，现有评估指标和交互范式已不足以应对这些变化。
AI.method: 本文采用综述性研究方法，系统分析AI技术进步带来的挑战，探讨人机协作分析流程的重新定义，并结合认知、感知与设计原则提出新的研究框架。
AI.result: 识别出核心挑战包括：感知延迟不对齐、可扩展性约束、现有交互范式的局限性、以及AI生成洞见的可靠性与可解释性不确定；提出需要超越传统效率与可扩展性指标，重新定义人机在分析工作流中的角色，并从认知、感知、设计层面重构人机交互系统。
AI.conclusion: 构建AI时代以人为中心的交互式数据分析系统需要从根本上重新思考人机协作模式，将认知、感知与设计原则融入人机交互栈的各个层面，这是未来研究的重要方向。

title: Why Ethereum Needs Fairness Mechanisms that Do Not Depend on Participant Altruism
summary: Ethereum's ideals of decentralization and censorship resistance are undermined in practice, motivating ongoing efforts to reestablish these properties. Existing proposals for fairness mechanisms depend on the assumption that a sufficient fraction of block proposers adhere to Ethereum's protocols as intended. We refer to such proposers as altruistic, as this behavior may come at the cost of reduced revenue. Prior analyses indicate that a consistent share of 91 percent of proposers delegate block construction to centralized services, effectively signing externally constructed blocks blindly, and are thus not considered altruistic. To assess whether the remaining 9 percent of proposers genuinely exhibit altruistic behavior, we conducted an empirical analysis and found that an additional 6.1 percent also interact with such external services. Further, we found that less than 1.4 percent of proposers consistently acted in accordance with Ethereum's decentralization and censorship resistance objectives. These findings suggest that relying solely on the mere presence of altruistic proposers is insufficient to ensure that proposed fairness mechanisms reestablish Ethereum's ideals, highlighting the need for additional incentive- or penalty-based mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证分析发现以太坊中仅有不足1.4%的区块提议者持续践行去中心化和抗审查的利他行为，表明单纯依赖利他主义者无法保障公平机制的有效性，需要引入激励或惩罚机制。
AI.motivation: 以太坊的去中心化和抗审查理想在实践中受到挑战，现有的公平机制假设存在足够比例的善意验证者（利他主义者），但需要实证验证这一假设是否成立。
AI.method: 实证分析。通过分析以太坊区块提议者的行为模式，识别其是否使用外部区块构建服务（中心化服务），从而评估真正符合去中心化和抗审查理想的利他主义者的比例。
AI.result: 研究发现：91%的区块提议者将区块构建委托给中心化服务；额外的6.1%也使用外部服务；真正持续按照以太坊去中心化和抗审查行事的提议者不足1.4%。
AI.conclusion: 单纯依赖利他主义验证者的存在不足以确保公平机制重新确立以太坊的去中心化和抗审查目标，需要额外的激励或惩罚机制来保障这些理想的实现。

title: EigenData: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Platform for Function-Calling Data Synthesis, Auditing, and Repair
summary: Function-calling agents -- large language models that invoke tools and APIs -- require high-quality, domain-specific training data spanning executable environments, backing databases, and diverse multi-turn trajectories. We introduce EigenData, an integrated, self-evolving platform that automates the full data lifecycle through a multi-agent architecture. A top-level orchestrator, EigenCore, coordinates three specialized sub-systems: DatabaseAgent for realistic domain database construction, CodingAgent for verified executable environment generation with iterative test-debug loops, and DataAgent for multi-turn trajectory synthesis with self-evolving prompt optimization. Cross-component feedback ensures consistency across all artifacts. We apply EigenData to audit and repair the Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard (BFCL-V3), identifying systematic errors in function schemas, implementations, and reference trajectories, automatically correcting them through coordinated schema refinement, code-level bug fixes, and trajectory modification, and introducing an outcome-aware evaluation protocol that assesses task success via database-state correctness rather than turn-level trajectory matching. We demonstrate that the repaired benchmark, coupled with outcome-aware metrics, produces model rankings substantially better correlated with human judgments of functional correctness.

AI.tldr: EigenData是一个集成、自进化的多智能体平台，自动化完成函数调用智能体的训练数据全生命周期。通过协调DatabaseAgent、CodingAgent和DataAgent三个子系统，分别负责领域数据库构建、可执行环境生成和多轮轨迹合成。该平台应用于BFCL-V3基准测试的审计与修复，引入了基于数据库状态正确性的结果感知评估协议，显著提升了模型排名与人类判断的相关性。
AI.motivation: 函数调用智能体需要高质量、领域特定的训练数据，涵盖可执行环境、支持数据库和多样化的多轮交互轨迹。现有基准测试（如BFCL-V3）存在函数模式、代码实现和参考轨迹方面的系统性错误，缺乏可靠的数据质量保障手段。
AI.method: 提出EigenData平台，采用多智能体架构：顶层编排器EigenCore协调三个专用子系统——DatabaseAgent负责构建逼真的领域数据库；CodingAgent通过迭代测试-调试循环生成可验证的可执行环境；DataAgent负责多轮轨迹合成并进行自进化提示优化。跨组件反馈机制确保所有产物的一致性。引入结果感知评估协议，通过数据库状态正确性而非轨迹匹配来评估任务成功。
AI.result: 对BFCL-V3进行审计，识别并修正了函数模式、代码实现和参考轨迹中的系统性错误。修复后的基准测试配合结果感知指标，产生的模型排名与人类对功能正确性的判断具有更高的相关性。
AI.conclusion: EigenData证明了自动化数据生命周期管理在函数调用智能体训练中的可行性；结果感知评估协议相比轨迹匹配能更准确反映模型的实际功能表现，为构建高质量函数调用基准提供了新范式。

title: RoboLayout: Differentiable 3D Scene Generation for Embodied Agents
summary: Recent advances in vision language models (VLMs) have shown strong potential for spatial reasoning and 3D scene layout generation from open-ended language instructions. However, generating layouts that are not only semantically coherent but also feasible for interaction by embodied agents remains challenging, particularly in physically constrained indoor environments. In this paper, RoboLayout is introduced as an extension of LayoutVLM that augments the original framework with agent-aware reasoning and improved optimization stability. RoboLayout integrates explicit reachability constraints into a differentiable layout optimization process, enabling the generation of layouts that are navigable and actionable by embodied agents. Importantly, the agent abstraction is not limited to a specific robot platform and can represent diverse entities with distinct physical capabilities, such as service robots, warehouse robots, humans of different age groups, or animals, allowing environment design to be tailored to the intended agent. In addition, a local refinement stage is proposed that selectively reoptimizes problematic object placements while keeping the remainder of the scene fixed, improving convergence efficiency without increasing global optimization iterations. Overall, RoboLayout preserves the strong semantic alignment and physical plausibility of LayoutVLM while enhancing applicability to agent-centric indoor scene generation, as demonstrated by experimental results across diverse scene configurations.

AI.tldr: RoboLayout是一个扩展自LayoutVLM的框架，通过集成可达性约束和局部优化阶段，实现可由具身智能体导航和操作的室内场景布局生成。该方法能够适配不同类型的智能体（如服务机器人、仓库机器人、不同年龄段的人类或动物），同时保持语义一致性和物理合理性。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型(VLM)在空间推理和3D场景布局生成方面展现出潜力，但在物理约束的室内环境中生成既语义一致又可被具身智能体交互的布局仍具挑战性。
AI.method: RoboLayout通过三个核心改进实现：(1)扩展LayoutVLM框架，增加智能体感知推理能力；(2)将显式可达性约束集成到可微布局优化过程中；(3)引入局部优化阶段，选择性重新优化有问题的物体放置，同时保持场景其余部分不变，提高收敛效率。
AI.result: 实验结果表明RoboLayout在多样化场景配置下成功生成可导航、可操作的室内布局，保持了LayoutVLM的强语义对齐和物理合理性，同时增强了智能体中心室内场景生成的适用性。
AI.conclusion: RoboLayout成功实现了语义一致性与智能体可交互性的统一，通过可配置的智能体抽象和局部优化策略，为不同物理能力的智能体定制环境设计提供了灵活解决方案。

title: Traversal-as-Policy: Log-Distilled Gated Behavior Trees as Externalized, Verifiable Policies for Safe, Robust, and Efficient Agents
summary: Autonomous LLM agents fail because long-horizon policy remains implicit in model weights and transcripts, while safety is retrofitted post hoc. We propose Traversal-as-Policy: distill sandboxed OpenHands execution logs into a single executable Gated Behavior Tree (GBT) and treat tree traversal -- rather than unconstrained generation -- as the control policy whenever a task is in coverage. Each node encodes a state-conditioned action macro mined and merge-checked from successful trajectories; macros implicated by unsafe traces attach deterministic pre-execution gates over structured tool context and bounded history, updated under experience-grounded monotonicity so previously rejected unsafe contexts cannot be re-admitted. At runtime, a lightweight traverser matches the base model's intent to child macros, executes one macro at a time under global and node-local gating, and when stalled performs risk-aware shortest-path recovery to a feasible success leaf; the visited path forms a compact spine memory that replaces transcript replay. Evaluated in a unified OpenHands sandbox on 15+ software, web, reasoning, and safety/security benchmarks, GBT improves success while driving violations toward zero and reducing cost. On SWE-bench Verified (Protocol A, 500 issues), GBT-SE raises success from 34.6% to 73.6%, reduces violations from 2.8% to 0.2%, and cuts token/character usage from 208k/820k to 126k/490k; with the same distilled tree, 8B executors more than double success on SWE-bench Verified (14.0%58.8%) and WebArena (9.1%37.3%).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Traversal-as-Policy：把沙箱 OpenHands 执行日志蒸馏成一棵可执行的"门控行为树"(GBT)，在任务落在覆盖范围内时以"树遍历"（而非自由生成）作为长程控制策略；每个节点是一个状态条件化的动作宏，宏级选择受轨迹约束、基元级执行受确定性安全门控，并用一个紧凑的"脊柱记忆"取代 transcript 回放。在 15+ OpenHands 基准上同时实现成功率大幅提升、违规率降至近零与推理成本下降。
AI.motivation: 1) LLM 智能体的长程策略仍隐含在模型权重与对话 transcript 中，部署出的其实是"隐式策略"，难以调试、审计与认证；2) 现有长程改进（ToT、Reflexion、Meta-Policy Reflexion）仍以自由生成为中心，日志只是临时上下文，未被编译成可执行工件；3) 主流 guardrail（运行时校验器、guardian 模型）多为人工指定规则/提示，不可扩展，且对只在运行轨迹中才暴露的长尾、上下文相关失败无感知；4) 安全多为"事后追补"（先执行再评判），易被 prompt 注入与摘要操纵绕过。作者的核心问题是：能否把海量执行日志蒸馏为一个单一、可执行、可验证的工件，同时承担长程控制、事前安全与紧凑状态表示，而无需更新权重？
AI.method: 离线阶段（training-free）：(a) Behavior Path Extractor 用文件系统/进程/网页/工具族等可观测环境增量做确定性宏分割（LLM 仅离线生成宏摘要，不参与边界判定），并对触及高风险原语或涉不安全的轨迹做"抽象稳定性测试"（P=5 次提示扰动，边界 Jaccard≥0.9），不稳定轨迹被排除；(b) 由成功轨迹构建单根 GBT-Basic，节点存描述、粗粒标签、离散风险等级与行为签名 σ=(σ_disc,σ_cont)，按"三方一致"合并规则（σ_disc 精确相等、cos(σ_cont)≥0.92、描述相似≥0.85），已带 node-local gate 的节点禁止合并以防语义别名，强制无环；(c) 全局 guardrail：对 T_hard（写/删、进程派生、网络发送、敏感读取）构造结构化 ctx（primitive_type、args、resource_ids、workspace_roots、net_dest、proc_meta、payload_meta、H=4 的近期高风险历史），由确定性 RuleGates 与固定分类器（Llama-Guard-3-8B, T=0）组成的 ContentGates 做执行前检查；(d) 不安全轨迹经确定性回放收缩为最小违规窗口，映射到最小覆盖宏子序列并合成 node-local gate；gate 更新遵循"经验接地单调性"（曾被拒的 ctx 永不可再放行）且良性误报率受 ε_benign（全局 0.01 / 节点 0.02）约束。在线阶段：GBT-Traverser 包装 agent 循环，先用冻结原型相似度路由器（21 个任务族、δ_fam=0.55、T_fam=0.05）选族，低于阈值则弃权（covered=0）；每步由基模型提出"意图级"下一宏，遍历器匹配子节点（θ_low=0.70/θ_high=0.78 三段式：高置信推进、脆弱推进、safe exploration→covered=0），每次只执行一个宏，且每个高风险基元须同时通过全局与节点级门控（Allowed = HardGateOK ∧ GateOK）；停滞或反复触发门控时做风险感知恢复——按环境签名（cos≥0.80）过滤可行成功叶子、用确定性前置条件 pre(v,env) 过滤，并在族子树内以边权 c(v→u)=1+0.5·risk_level(u) 的 Dijkstra 求深度≤8 的最短路径；脊柱记忆（已访问宏序列 + 节点局部 env 摘要，200–300 token）取代完整 transcript 回放。离线自进化 GBT-SE 仅在 covered=1 的失败上操作：冻结模型在脊柱上回溯定位最早可修复节点 v*，通过检索类比成功叶（R=50）导入后继宏，子节点评分 score=1.0·sim_text+0.5·success_rate（按资源族/风险/签名分桶聚类统计），新子节点继承父节点全部 gate，且须通过"成功不退化"与"不安全不可再放行"两套回归测试。
AI.result: Protocol A（跨基准蒸馏、基准级 hold-out；每实例 3 次 T=0 多数投票，Wilson 95% CI）：SWE-bench Verified（500 issues）SR 34.6%→73.6%（coverage 86.0%），违规 2.8%→0.2%，不安全成功 1.2%→0.0%，Tok/Chars 208k/820k→126k/490k；仅加全局 guardrail 仅 38.8%/0.8%，说明"veto 不能替代控制骨架"。WebArena（812）SR 19.7%→66.9%（cov 78.0%），违规 3.4%→0.2%，不安全成功 1.0%→0.0%，Tok/Chars 94k/360k→52k/205k；guardrail-only 19.3% 基本无提升，印证主要失败模式是策略漂移与停滞。GPQA（448，禁网）Acc 58.7%→87.3%（cov 73.0%），违规 0.2%、不安全成功 0.0%。覆盖率条件化审计显示增益集中于 covered=1（80.2/80.4/97.9 vs covered=0 的 32.9/19.0/58.7），同子集配对审计（表14）排除"coverage 只是挑简单题"的解释，且在 guardrail 失败样本上 coverage 仍高（表15）。配对 McNemar 检验（表5）b/c = 192/18、410/24、137/11，p 均 <1e-28。执行者解耦（Protocol B，5 折）：llama-3-8b SWE 12.6%→46.4%，Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking SWE 14.0%→58.8%、WebArena 9.1%→37.3%、GPQA 34.0%→60.5%，同时 Tok/Chars 下降。跨框架插件化：SWE-Agent 36.0→64.8、AutoCodeRover 31.6→60.2、Aider 28.8→55.0。安全基准：Agent-SafetyBench 44.2→72.3、AgentHarm HarmScore 71.8→9.6、ASB ASR-d 64.4→7.0、RR 8.8→78.4 且 PNA-d 保持 70.4。消融：去掉 node-local gate 仍达 72.0/64.7（证明主增益来自遍历而非拦截）；恢复机制把 Stall 从 17.0% 降至 13.4%，Rec-Succ 62.7%、RecLen 3.1；spine 记忆在 8k/16k/32k 上下文下稳定（72.6/73.4/73.6），远超 transcript 回放（44.8/55.4/60.6）；SE 消融（去类比检索、去经验统计项、去回归测试）均退化，但所有变体的不安全 ctx 再放行数均为 0/18,400；运行间标准差亦下降（1.3/1.5/0.9 → 0.7/0.9/0.6）。
AI.conclusion: 长程 agent 策略可被外化为一个模型外、可执行、可审计的工件：GBT 的遍历（加恢复）在覆盖范围内决定实际执行的宏骨架，而安全通过仅读取结构化 ctx 的执行前确定性门控实现，并借"经验接地单调性"与回归测试在自进化中保持不可放行已拒不安全上下文。证据显示"guardrail 只能否决、遍历才能治理"，且同一棵树可让 8B 级执行器显著超过自身原生表现，支持"可复用对象是策略工件而非某组权重"的论断。边界与局限：保证仅在 covered=1 成立，域外只主张基元级安全；安全子集是有界历史、近似且保守的，并非 S_spec 的完备实现，"近零违规"同时受 monitor 覆盖面制约；宏抽象是单点杠杆（分割误差/签名碰撞会错置安全局部性），且对 T_hard 相关轨迹的抽象稳定性只是启发式检验；树随域扩张会膨胀（匹配歧义、保守拦截、检索开销）；新工具/新动作面需更新 ctx schema 与 monitor 集，否则可能"安全但无效"或"有效但欠规范"。误用风险包括从不安全日志蒸馏会继承偏见并降低有害工作流自动化门槛。部署建议：始终配合强 monitor/checker、对高风险动作保留人工复核、把 gate/ctx 覆盖视为显式工程要求、审计蒸馏树与语料的隐私与偏见，并配合签名化门控库、可复现回放套件与灰度发布实现"安全差异"报告。

title: Talk Freely, Execute Strictly: Schema-Gated Agentic AI for Flexible and Reproducible Scientific Workflows
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) can now translate a researcher's plain-language goal into executable computation, yet scientific workflows demand determinism, provenance, and governance that are difficult to guarantee when an LLM decides what runs. Semi-structured interviews with 18 experts across 10 industrial R&D stakeholders surface 2 competing requirements--deterministic, constrained execution and conversational flexibility without workflow rigidity--together with boundary properties (human-in-the-loop control and transparency) that any resolution must satisfy. We propose schema-gated orchestration as the resolving principle: the schema becomes a mandatory execution boundary at the composed-workflow level, so that nothing runs unless the complete action--including cross-step dependencies--validates against a machine-checkable specification.
  We operationalize the 2 requirements as execution determinism (ED) and conversational flexibility (CF), and use these axes to review 20 systems spanning 5 architectural groups along a validation-scope spectrum. Scores are assigned via a multi-model protocol--15 independent sessions across 3 LLM families--yielding substantial-to-near-perfect inter-model agreement (Krippendorff a=0.80 for ED and a=0.98 for CF), demonstrating that multi-model LLM scoring can serve as a reusable alternative to human expert panels for architectural assessment.
  The resulting landscape reveals an empirical Pareto front--no reviewed system achieves both high flexibility and high determinism--but a convergence zone emerges between the generative and workflow-centric extremes. We argue that a schema-gated architecture, separating conversational from execution authority, is positioned to decouple this trade-off, and distill 3 operational principles--clarification-before-execution, constrained plan-act orchestration, and tool-to-workflow-level gating--to guide adoption.

AI.tldr: 研究针对LLM在科学工作流中面临的确定性vs灵活性权衡问题，通过访谈18位专家和多模型评分20个系统，提出schema-gated架构作为解决方案，并验证了多模型LLM评分作为评估工具的可行性。
AI.motivation: LLM能将研究者的自然语言目标转换为可执行计算，但科学工作流要求的确定性、溯源性和治理难以在LLM自主决策时得到保障。现有系统无法同时满足"确定性、受约束的执行"与"对话灵活性、无工作流僵化"这两个竞争性需求。
AI.method: 采用半结构化访谈（18位专家，10个工业R&D利益相关方）识别需求；将确定性执行(ED)和对话灵活性(CF)作为两个核心维度；采用多模型协议（3个LLM家族，15个独立会话）对20个系统进行评分；使用Krippendorff α系数评估模型间一致性。
AI.result: 多模型评分显示高度一致性：ED的Krippendorff α=0.80，CF的α=0.98，证明多模型LLM评分可作为人类专家面板的替代方案。经验帕累托前沿揭示：没有系统同时实现高灵活性和高确定性，但在生成式与工作流中心极端之间存在收敛区域。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出了schema-gated架构作为解决执行确定性(ED)与对话灵活性(CF)之间权衡的方案，并提炼出3条操作原则：澄清后执行、受约束的计划-执行编排、以及工具到工作流级别的门控。该架构通过分离对话权限与执行权限来解耦这一权衡，为LLM在科学工作流中的治理提供了可行的设计指导。

title: Space-efficient B-tree Implementation for Memory-Constrained Flash Embedded Devices
comment: Extended version of CoopIS 2024 paper. 19 pages
summary: Small devices collecting data for agricultural, environmental, and industrial monitoring enable Internet of Things (IoT) applications. Given their critical role in data collection, there is a need for optimizations to improve on-device data processing. Edge device computing allows processing of the data closer to where it is collected and reduces the amount of network transmissions. The B-tree has been optimized for flash storage on servers and solid-state drives, but these optimizations often require hardware and memory resources not available on embedded devices. The contribution of this work is the development and experimental evaluation of multiple variants for B-trees on memory-constrained embedded devices. Experimental results demonstrate that even the smallest devices can perform efficient B-tree indexing, and there is a significant performance advantage for using storage-specific optimizations.

AI.tldr: This paper presents B-tree variants optimized for memory-constrained embedded IoT devices, showing that even smallest devices can perform efficient indexing with significant performance gains from storage-specific optimizations.
AI.motivation: Small IoT devices collect data for agricultural, environmental, and industrial monitoring, requiring efficient on-device data processing. While B-trees have been optimized for flash storage on servers and SSDs, these optimizations typically require hardware and memory resources unavailable on embedded devices, creating a need for lightweight B-tree variants.
AI.method: Developed and experimentally evaluated multiple B-tree variants specifically designed for memory-constrained embedded devices.
AI.result: Experimental results demonstrate that even the smallest devices can perform efficient B-tree indexing, and storage-specific optimizations provide significant performance advantages.
AI.conclusion: B-trees can be effectively implemented on memory-constrained embedded IoT devices with proper storage-specific optimizations, enabling efficient local data processing and reducing network transmissions.

title: Parallelization Strategies for Dense LLM Deployment: Navigating Through Application-Specific Tradeoffs and Bottlenecks
summary: Breakthroughs in the generative AI domain have fueled an explosion of large language model (LLM)-powered applications, whose workloads fundamentally consist of sequences of inferences through transformer architectures. Within this rapidly expanding ecosystem, dense LLMs--those that activate all model parameters for each token generation--form the foundation for advanced expert-based variants. Dense models continue to dominate because of their strong generalization ability, scalability, ease of fine-tuning, and versatility across diverse tasks. In LLM inference systems, performance is mainly characterized by latency, response time, and throughput (i.e., tokens generated per unit of time). Latency and throughput are inherently coupled: optimizing for one often comes at the expense of the other. Moreover, batching strategies and parallelism configurations, which are essential when dense model parameters exceed device memory capacity, can significantly affect both latency and overall system throughput. This paper (i) investigates the workloads of two representative dense LLMs--Llama-3.1-70B and Llama-3.1-405B, focusing in particular on intra-node parallelization schemes, (ii) analyzes how input characteristics, batching, and parallelism strategies influence latency flexibility and the latency-throughput tradeoff, and (iii) identifies key performance bottlenecks that inform design choices for meeting service-level agreements (SLAs) and sustaining inference quality. Our empirical evaluations reveal that Tensor Parallelism (TP) improves the latency objectives while Pipeline Parallelism (PP) is better-suited for throughput-oriented applications. We highlight that their hybrid usage by controlling the TP and PP degrees provides control over the latency-throughput interplay.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了两种dense LLMs（Llama-3.1-70B和Llama-3.1-405B）推理系统的工作负载特性，探讨了并行化策略对延迟-吞吐量权衡的影响，并识别了满足SLA的关键性能瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI和大语言模型应用的爆发式增长，LLM推理系统的性能优化变得至关重要。延迟和吞吐量之间存在内在耦合关系，优化其中一个通常会损害另一个。此外，当模型参数超过设备内存容量时，并行策略的配置会显著影响系统性能。
AI.method: 研究方法包括：(i) 对两种代表性dense LLMs进行工作负载分析，重点关注节点内并行化方案；(ii) 分析输入特征、批处理和并行策略如何影响延迟灵活性和延迟-吞吐量权衡；(iii) 实证评估Tensor Parallelism (TP)和Pipeline Parallelism (PP)的性能表现。
AI.result: 实证评估表明：Tensor Parallelism (TP)改善了延迟指标，而Pipeline Parallelism (PP)更适合吞吐量导向的应用场景。通过控制TP和PP的度数，可以灵活控制延迟-吞吐量之间的权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: 混合使用TP和PP能够提供对延迟-吞吐量权衡的精细控制，为满足服务级别协议(SLA)和维持推理质量的设计选择提供了重要参考。

title: Tool-Genesis: A Task-Driven Tool Creation Benchmark for Self-Evolving Language Agent
summary: Research on self-evolving language agents has accelerated, drawing increasing attention to their ability to create, adapt, and maintain tools from task requirements. However, existing benchmarks predominantly rely on predefined specifications, which limits scalability and hinders truly autonomous evolution. While recent studies attempt to dynamically generate tools, they primarily emphasize downstream performance, resulting in a "black-box" evaluation that makes it difficult to attribute failures to specific causes. To address this, we propose Tool-Genesis, a diagnostic benchmark designed to quantify agent capabilities across multiple dimensions, including interface compliance, functional correctness, and downstream utility. Tool-Genesis evaluates whether agents can construct task-relevant tools solely from abstract requirements (without preset specifications) and use them to solve realistic problems. Crucially, we find that even state-of-the-art models struggle to produce precise tool interfaces or executable logic in a one-shot setting. These minor initial flaws are amplified through the pipeline, leading to a sharp degradation in downstream metrics. We hope Tool-Genesis will guide future research toward training and steering models to synthesize persistent, general-purpose tools that better address real-world challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Tool-Genesis：一个面向自进化语言智能体的"任务驱动工具创建"诊断基准。它要求智能体仅依据抽象任务需求（不给预定义接口/schema）自行生成 MCP 工具接口与可执行实现，并通过四级评测体系（表面合规/服务可执行、Schema 语义保真度、单元测试功能正确性、下游任务效用）把失败原因逐层归因，同时用 oracle 归一化的成功率量化与参考工具的效用差距。实验覆盖 GPT/Claude/Gemini/Qwen3/DeepSeek/Kimi 等模型，发现即使最强模型在 one-shot 下也无法产出精确接口与可执行逻辑，早期微小缺陷沿流水线被放大导致下游指标断崖式下跌；ReAct 式 Code-Agent 修复可带来大幅提升但深层验证（L3/L4）仍是瓶颈；用该基准微调 Qwen3-8B 能在各层级获得一致增益，说明其也可作为训练信号。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用评测遵循"reason–call–execute"范式，假定工具接口/schema 预先给定；近期的工具创建基准虽尝试动态生成工具，但主要只看下游结果，形成"黑盒"评测，无法把失败归因到需求理解、接口设计、实现逻辑或调用策略中的哪一环。三大脱节：(1) spec-first，接口契约推断能力未被系统测量；(2) 关注工具集规模/多样性而非"场景闭合"的工具箱构建与可复用性；(3) 评测信号以结果为中心，单元测试覆盖与归因粒度不一。作者希望把"工具创建"从一次性脚本升格为可复用、可维护的持久工具资产这一自进化智能体的核心机制，并建立可解耦"工具生成 vs 工具使用"的诊断式评测协议。
AI.method:
1) 形式化：将工具创建建模为 MCP 接口上的条件生成问题 P(s,e|x)=P(s|x)·P(e|s)，分解为"工具接口预测(TI)"与"工具物化(TM)"两阶段；TM 分 Oracle 物化（给定真值 schema）与级联物化（给定预测 schema）两种设置以隔离工程能力与端到端能力。
2) 数据集构建四阶段：MCP 服务器爬取（GLMA/Smithery 聚合站、GitHub、HuggingFace Toucan，2025年8–9月）→ 四级过滤（结构校验、可执行校验、去重聚类[complete-link 层次聚类、相似度阈值0.9、留存121个]、LLM 语义审计[剔除需外部凭证或沙箱等级L3–L5者]，最终86个可执行服务器/508个工具/24个领域）→ Toucan 式 LLM 任务与轨迹生成（breadth/depth 扩展、拒绝采样、1–5 Likert 多维打分全维>3 且 solvable，轨迹在沙箱实跑以剔除"幻觉成功"，complete=true 且 conciseness>3）→ 单元测试生成（从可回放调用抽取 (tool, inputs, expected)，每服务器最多100条，LLM 补充合成；参数合法性过滤+嵌入余弦≥0.9 去重）。
3) 四级指标：L1 Compliance（OpenAI tool-calling 格式严格校验）与 Server Execution（3次启动取平均）；L2 Schema-F1（function_name+args 序列化后用 all-MiniLM-L6-v2 嵌入，二分图最大权匹配，阈值τ计正确，算 P/R/F1）；L3 UT_soft/UT_hard（结构化 JSON key-path 重叠 F1 与输出嵌入相似度各占一半，soft 仅标准正例测试、hard 额外纳入边界/负例测试）；L4 下游效用（固定 qwen3-14b-instruct 作为代理求解器，分别配备生成工具与真值参考工具，LLM-as-a-Judge 打分，报告 oracle 归一化 SR=(1-s_gt)/(1-s_gen+ε)）。另定义 Signal–Validation Alignment (SVA) 衡量中间验证信号对下游成功预测力（含零信号惩罚项）。
4) 实验：14 个模型（gpt-4o/4.1-mini/4.1/5.1、claude-haiku-3.5、gemini-3-flash-preview、Qwen3 4B–235B、deepseek-v3.2、Kimi-K2）两种推理策略 Direct（一次性生成 TI+TM）与 Code-Agent（ReAct think→act→observe，最多10步，可在沙箱执行并自检产物）；统一解码设置 max_tokens=40960, temperature=0, top_p=1。
5) 微调探索：以 DeepSeek-V3.2 跑 Code-Agent 收集约1000条工具创建轨迹，严格过滤后留500条（Direct 直出样本 + Repair 补丁样本），teacher-forcing 方式微调 Qwen3-8B（3 epochs，AdamW+cosine+warmup，lr 约2e-5，序列长4k–8k），训练/评测按 server-disjoint 划分以防泄漏。
6) 人工质检：3名研究生级标注者两周多轮检查（服务器一致性、任务-工具匹配、轨迹有效性、单测覆盖），交叉一致性检查 registry↔task↔trajectory↔tests，双人一致方接受，Cohen's κ=0.85。
AI.result: Direct 设定下模型普遍很弱：即使最强模型 Server Execution 仅 0.14–0.76、Schema-F1 0.12–0.69、UT_hard 最高 0.161、SR 最高 0.372（gpt-5.1）；小型 Qwen3（8B/4B）几乎归零（Exec 0.012/0.000，SR 0.012/0.000）。Code-Agent 修复带来跨层级一致提升：Gemini-3-Flash Exec 0.140→0.977、Schema-F1 0.116→0.912、UT_hard 0.129→0.255、SR 0.103→0.581；gpt-5.1 SR 0.372→0.604；Kimi-K2 SR 0.585；Qwen3-235B SR 0.287→0.472（文中另给 0.193→0.622 的软SR口径）。三条结论：(i) 闭环修复产生阶跃式端到端收益；(ii) 高 Compliance/Schema-F1 必要但不充分，存在"效用转化瓶颈"（Qwen3-32B Direct 下 Exec 0.938、Schema-F1 0.880 但 SR 仅 0.535）；(iii) 修复收益依赖模型规模且会改变族内排名（Qwen3-32B 在 Direct 下优于 235B，Code-Agent 下被反超）。验证级联分析显示 Direct 下 235B 仅 31.60% 过 L1、9.47% 过 L4，Code-Agent 提升至 91.36%/30.01%，早期结构性失败减少后瓶颈集中于 L3/L4。SVA：Direct 下 235B Schema 0.19、UT_hard 0.14（8B 近零），Code-Agent 下 235B 升至 0.58，存在 8B→14B 的规模阈值。微调 Qwen3-8B：Direct 下 Compliance 0.686→0.826、Schema-F1 0.011→0.046、SR 0.012→0.026；Code-Agent 下 Compliance 0.718→0.906、Schema-F1 0.653→0.736、UT_hard 0.456→0.533、SR 0.336→0.399，说明基准同时是有效训练信号。
AI.conclusion: Tool-Genesis 通过"仅给抽象需求、要求自行推导契约并生成可机检 schema"的设定，加上覆盖合规→可执行→schema 保真→功能正确（含负例/边界单测）→下游效用的全生命周期协议，把自进化智能体的"工具创建"从黑盒结果评测转为可归因的诊断评测，并给出 oracle 归一化上界来刻画生成工具与参考工具之间的效用差距。核心结论是：早期微小的接口/逻辑缺陷会在流水线中被显著放大，因此能力提升的关键在于引导模型合成持久、可复用、场景闭合的通用工具资产；未来方向包括模型训练与推理引导（提升一次性接口精度与实现健壮性）、把 SVA 类信号作为可预测的验证代理、以及在固定预算下的执行反馈利用与修复策略优化。

title: Real-Time AI Service Economy: A Framework for Agentic Computing Across the Continuum
summary: Real-time AI services increasingly operate across the device-edge-cloud continuum, where autonomous AI agents generate latency-sensitive workloads, orchestrate multi-stage processing pipelines, and compete for shared resources under policy and governance constraints. This article shows that the structure of service-dependency graphs, modelled as DAGs whose nodes represent compute stages and whose edges encode execution ordering, is a primary determinant of whether decentralised, price-based resource allocation can work reliably at scale. When dependency graphs are hierarchical (tree or series-parallel), prices converge to stable equilibria, optimal allocations can be computed efficiently, and under appropriate mechanism design (with quasilinear utilities and discrete slice items), agents have no incentive to misreport their valuations within each decision epoch. When dependencies are more complex, with cross-cutting ties between pipeline stages, prices oscillate, allocation quality degrades, and the system becomes difficult to manage. To bridge this gap, we propose a hybrid management architecture in which cross-domain integrators encapsulate complex sub-graphs into resource slices that present a simpler, well-structured interface to the rest of the market. A systematic ablation study across six experiments (1,620 runs, 10 seeds each) confirms that (i) dependency-graph topology is a first-order determinant of price stability and scalability,(ii) the hybrid architecture reduces price volatility by up to 70-75% without sacrificing throughput, (iii) governance constraints create quantifiable efficiency-compliance trade-offs that depend jointly on topology and load, and (iv) under truthful bidding the decentralised market matches a centralised value-optimal baseline, confirming that decentralised coordination can replicate centralised allocation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文给出"智能体服务市场"的统一框架：把跨设备–边缘–云的多阶段AI服务流水线建模为带容量约束的服务依赖DAG，并证明其"叶块族（leaf-block family）"的层状性（laminarity）是决定性结构条件——层状（树/串并联）时可行域为多拟阵、估值满足毛替代（GS），存在Walrasian均衡且可由VCG实现代理级DSIC精确分配；出现交叉（crossing）时精确性与真值性同时失效。作者提出跨域集成商（integrator）封装的混合管理架构：叶块重合时导出精确标量接口（瓶颈容量），必须消除交叉时导出"内部暴露"（内层多拟阵区域），以牺牲准入量为代价恢复精确性。节点级评估32,020次运行验证了该结构性预测：交叉实例在14.7%高负载轮次中丧失精确性，封装后降至0并使中位时延降低16–17%（计入翻译开销前）。
AI.motivation: 自主AI智能体正在成为经济行为体：它们生成任务、采购服务、组合多步流水线并跨设备–边缘–云竞购资源，且负载由智能体自身决策塑造，编排不再天然集中化。但中心化控制跨管理域不可行，纯价格市场在存在服务依赖DAG时又会因资源互补性而失稳：依赖结构（树、串并联、交叉）决定精确性、激励相容性与价格稳定性。此外还有治理约束（信任、数据驻留、跨域合规）、截止期约束的时延敏感估值、节点/边资源类型异构等问题。已有工作要么假设可替代的独立资源（拍卖/双拍卖），要么假设单一所有者下的中心优化，均未回答"什么样的依赖结构允许去中心化价格机制既精确又可被理性执行，以及当结构不满足时需要何种架构来恢复该性质"。论文提出的核心问题正是：去中心化定价在何种条件下能精确且真实地协调自主智能体，其服务依赖必须满足什么。
AI.method:
【模型】服务依赖DAG G_res，节点容量为整数，请求槽/吞吐令牌 x_l 在叶上计数并在所有祖先约束上加载（Definition 1），可行域 X_res={x≥0: x(L_v)≤C_v}，L_v为v可达叶集；治理以逐叶坐标上界 x_l≤u_l 表达，X_t=X_res∩X_gov；社会福利为时延折扣价值减提供者成本与外部性，效用拟线性。

【理论链条】命题1：叶块族层状（树、两端串并联为充分条件）时秩函数 f(S)=min_{A覆盖}ΣC_v 次模、单调、归一，X_res 为多拟阵，基多胞形为紧分配；逐叶截断保持多拟阵性，秩 f'(S)=min_T{f(T)+Σ_{l∈S\T}u_l}。引理1：切片封装下每任务单位需求、任务可加分离、切片属性纪元内固定时，任务估值单位需求且满足GS（Gul–Stacchetti），代理聚合估值为卷积即OXS赋值估值，满足GS且M♮-凹。命题2：多拟阵供给+M♮-凹/GS需求下存在Walrasian均衡（M♮-凸相交算法），精确福利最大化可多项式时间计算（关于n、K、log V_max），代理级DSIC由"整代理移除"的Clarke pivot之VCG支付实现，个体理性、弱预算平衡；不提供联盟策略无关与跨纪元保证。存在性边界比GS域更锐利：层状族、两层状族之并、或叶序上的区间族给出全幺模矩阵，清算价格每轮存在；之外可失败。命题3：集成商将非叶节点划分为不相交簇，四条件（单一同质切片且容量=簇内瓶颈、导出单位在内部调度中可互换、无簇间外部耦合、单入单出接口）下商图为树/串并联则代理侧可行域多拟阵；引理2证明导出容量即内部可行域的投影。命题4：多资源"目录接口"——资源可分解（Leontief成比例配方）时目录秩次模；当且仅当组内配方完全相同时精确，否则按可计算因子 K_c−Σλ_(j)/λ_(j+1) 过承诺；命题5：内层暴露总是可用（任何P⊆F的多拟阵，如预留盒），保持GS/DSIC，福利代价仅当P=F时为零。三层混合架构：跨域集成商 / 本地市场 / 市场间协调，并列出失效模式（多输出集成商、非可互换单位、跨节点耦合制造交叉、多入口出口）。

【评估】8节点三实例（同一节点集与容量向量，仅叶块族不同）：T为有根树、X为T加一条弧造成{l2,l3}与{l1,l2}交叉、S为并行扇（叶块全部重合）。人口90/90/45使三者在均匀叶混合下同负载ρ=1.35。市场清算用tâtonnement，两档拥塞标定；对比臂分三层：A为不可部署参照最优（真值零队列最优、事后前缀最优），B为单域规划器（value-greedy、Kubernetes式优先级rank、价值排序张贴价、EDF、随机装箱），C为可跨域部署规则（到达序/截止期优先/需求响应张贴价、混合臂、升价诊断臂）。消融四个可移除组件：结构S、架构H（子图收缩+EMA平滑）、治理G（坐标帽与跨节点耦合）、机制M。指标：精确性缺口、配置率、相对事后前缀最优的福利、需求加权价格变异系数σ_p、激励证书（整叶块秩的次模性与单位性）、LP整数性存在性检查。激励实验用VCG整代理Clarke pivot做单代理遮蔽与联合策略搜索；另含配方结构实验、录制的真实LLM工具调用智能体工作负载（单录制与两录制合成，交叉）、以及单容器三层的仿真回放校准。
AI.result: 【结构】层状实例T、S上Edmonds贪心精确性缺口恒为0；交叉实例X在高负载下14.7%[12.4,17.0]的轮次偏离该轮精确最优，最差轮达精确最优的0.953，配置率X高负载0.925对T 0.954；S因K_c减半而配置率更低（0.754），说明T与X之间为容量与负载精确匹配。【存在性与精确性边界】生成族扫描：层状、单交叉、双层状、奇圈区间序族全幺模为真（在81个幺模实例的32,400轮中全部为整数解，正间隙仅在非幺模的18个奇圈非区间族出现，均匀/偏斜混合下分别占8.2%/0.9%轮次）；60个"交叉但幺模"实例存在性全清，但贪心在全部60个上不精确，最差轮为整数最优的0.875，且缺口不随交叉数加深（均值0.986–0.993）——存在性与精确性是两条不同边界。【架构】X上内层暴露把精确性缺口由0.1470[0.1242,0.1698]降至0、证书由失败转为通过，并使交叉实例与树在代理侧不可区分；零翻译开销下高负载中位时延降低16.3%（T，15.5ms）与17.0%（X）；代价是准入令牌减少20.38%/17.83%，无平滑时福利相对事后前缀最优下降0.065/0.029。S上（命题3成立）收缩反而多准入12.57令牌、福利+6.81 a.u.，但慢8.9%（每路径计价节点5→3）。平滑（EMA β=0.8）把agent面对的价格CV降到白噪声值√((1−β)/(1+β))=0.3333附近，并在全部六个实例×负载单元降低burn-in后价格CV（H(1)=150.99, p≈1e−34）；收缩对价格CV的合并效应为null（H(1)=0.960, p=0.327），其可分辨效应在时延、福利与丢弃率上。忠实性探针：若以子图节点分裂最大流作为标量，S上宣称150令牌而设备仅通过100，实际准入67.43对可交付50，过承诺17.45令牌/轮。【治理】坐标帽在T、S上保持多拟阵且精确性缺口为0；X上仅当帽消除某个叶（使残余块嵌套）才修复交叉（归零l4时缺口仍为0.7505；辖区帽关闭l3、l4后修复并使X高负载中位时延降4.5%，覆盖损失32.5点）。信任阈值与角色帽在评估工作点不binding。跨节点联合令牌预算不是坐标式的：在T上制造交叉（原本为0的缺口升至0.1440，十种子全数证书失败），在X上加深至0.1780；按域切分可恢复精确性，代价为每轮少9.87令牌、福利−1.19 a.u.，滞留的跨域需求闭式为0.2275令牌/轮（约2%）。【机制与对照】中负载下市场在全部六个单元领先两个真值无关张贴价（0.003–0.032）；高负载下与静态张贴价持平（到达序领先两格但幅度≤0.020，落后两格、持平两格；截止期优先在每格差异≤0.0004），落后于需求响应张贴价（4/6格领先，最多0.0389；2格落后0.009与0.014），落后于价值排序张贴价（5/6高负载格领先，最多0.073）。若张贴价档位取自另一负载（预先设定），市场在全部可测格领先0.99–5.32 a.u.。Kubernetes式rank在全部六个高负载格落后市场0.015–0.099；在陡峭拥塞标定下顺序改变（静态张贴价在三个高负载格领先市场）。【激励】VCG整代理Clarke pivot下，代理级后悔在α=1时为0且任何遮蔽均为正（α=0.5时T达0.0858、S达0.0867）；联合策略搜索在T、S的20个争用点上最大收益低于浮点下限8e−15，而在X上证书失败，13个精确性失效点出现正收益（评估点均值0.151、最大0.364，十种子均存在非真实argmax）。tâtonnement市场本身在争用下可被操纵（T上12/20点、X上9/20点，最差均值收益0.194与0.169，多为高报10–30%，T上可获利运行比例从满容量4%升至十分之一容量94%），但在S上从不可操纵——说明真值保证属于VCG在层状区域上的精确分配规则，而非市场本身。【配方与真实工作负载】单配方时贪心比1.0000为恒等式，双配方降至0.974/0.985/0.993（容量6/9/12），成比例配方臂在五个比例上精确达到命题4(iii)的闭式因子；真实录制的智能体工作负载中，单录制（plan→两个并行工具调用→aggregate，单汇点、族层状）配置率0.900、缺口为0、证书40/40通过，而两录制合成（共享工具阶段、族交叉）配置率0.558、缺口0.026、证书40/40失败。【稳定性与仿真】层状性并不排序稳定性：T与S均为层状但彼此差异大于X与T的差异，四类稳定性测量中仅"均衡检查"小幅区分X与T；交换界在两个层状实例的31,360次扰动中全部成立，在交叉实例8,000次中被超越4次。仿真模型低估时延对负载的敏感性约5.2倍（弹性0.0496对实测0.2597）、尾部更轻，回放中后端推理排队主导时延（中位等待为0、负载依赖在服务时间），云容器被杀后完成率归零而仿真无失效模型仍准入98.7%。翻译开销δ_enc在T、X上消耗31–41ms的时延收益，且任意正开销下福利收益为负；陡峭标定下68%的时延优势可在50ms开销下存活。【总体】结论一致：拓扑是一阶决定因子；封装降低价格波动（主要来自EMA低通而非市场内生）且不牺牲吞吐的前提是接口忠实于瓶颈；治理带来可量化的效率—合规权衡；真实报告下市场可复现中心化价值最优，但张贴价类规则在部分高负载单元更优且无需预置档位。
AI.conclusion:
论文给出的可操作判据是结构性的：当服务依赖图的叶块族层状（树与串并联为充分条件）时，可行域为多拟阵，估值在切片封装下满足毛替代，精确福利最大化可多项式计算并由VCG以代理级DSIC实现，去中心化定价可复现中心化配置质量；一旦出现交叉，精确性与真值性同时失效，但清算价格的存在性仍可保留（区间/全幺模族），因此"稳定性"与"精确性"必须分开诊断。架构上的补救是跨域集成商封装：叶块重合时导出精确标量瓶颈接口，必须消除交叉时改用内层暴露（保守多拟阵），代价是准入量与翻译开销；治理作为结构组件只在重塑叶块时影响精确性，跨节点耦合（如数据驻留规则）会制造交叉，须以按域切分恢复。局限：纯仿真（单机制仿真台、无生产部署）、单容器三层回放仅校准相对负载响应、图形为风格化、时变容量与跨纪元博弈未建模、无联盟策略无关性与运营方/集成方可信度；开放问题包括混合发价机制下集成商采购的AND-OR容量刻画、机制运营方与集成商的诚信、异质切片类型下的真实升价实现。

【提示】所给"摘要"（提及六实验、1,620次运行、价格波动下降70–75%）与arXiv全文不一致：全文为节点级32,020次运行、消融27,410+1,680次，且价格CV的下降主要由EMA平滑解释而收缩的合并效应为null（p=0.327）。以上分析以全文为准。

title: JAWS: Enhancing Long-term Rollout of Neural Operators via Spatially-Adaptive Jacobian Regularization
summary: Data-driven surrogate models improve the efficiency of simulating continuous dynamical systems, yet their autoregressive rollouts are often limited by instability and spectral blow-up. While global regularization techniques can enforce contractive dynamics, they uniformly damp high-frequency features, introducing a contraction-dissipation dilemma. Furthermore, long-horizon trajectory optimization methods that explicitly correct drift are bottlenecked by memory constraints. In this work, we propose Jacobian-Adaptive Weighting for Stability (JAWS), a probabilistic regularization strategy designed to mitigate these limitations. By framing operator learning as Maximum A Posteriori (MAP) estimation with spatially heteroscedastic uncertainty, JAWS dynamically modulates the regularization strength based on local physical complexity. This allows the model to enforce contraction in smooth regions to suppress noise, while relaxing constraints near singular features to preserve gradients, effectively realizing a behavior similar to numerical shock-capturing schemes. Experiments demonstrate that this spatially-adaptive prior serves as an effective spectral pre-conditioner, which reduces the base operator's burden of handling high-frequency instabilities. This reduction enables memory-efficient, short-horizon trajectory optimization to match or exceed the long-term accuracy of long-horizon baselines. Evaluated on the 1D viscous Burgers' equation, our hybrid approach improves long-term stability, shock fidelity, and out-of-distribution generalization while reducing training computational costs.

AI.tldr: JAWS（Jacobian-Adaptive Weighting for Stability）是一种概率式（MAP/异方差不确定度）正则化方法：把神经算子学习表述为带空间异方差不确定度的最大后验估计，用可学习的空间容差图 s2(x) 逐点调制局部 Jacobian Frobenius 范数惩罚，在光滑区强制收缩以抑制误差累积，在激波等奇异区放松约束以保留高频梯度，行为类似数值激波捕捉/自适应人工黏性。结合梯度分离（stop-gradient）与短窗 Pushforward 轨迹优化，JAWS 充当"谱预条件器"，使 k=5 的短窗训练在内存与精度上匹配甚至超越 k=10 的长窗基线。
AI.motivation: 神经算子（FNO、DeepONet 等）在自回归长时间滚动预测中会因误差累积与分布漂移导致谱爆炸、物理发散。现有两类稳定化手段各有缺陷：(1) 硬约束（如谱归一化 Spectral Normalization）强制全局 Lipschitz 上界，均匀压制高频分量，造成过度平滑，类似"过量人工黏性"，抹平激波等关键物理细节；(2) 均匀 Jacobian 惩罚（惩罚 Frobenius 范数）忽略了物理场稳定需求的强空间异质性（光滑区 vs 激波前沿）。同时，长窗 Pushforward（时间捆绑/轨迹优化）虽能显式纠正漂移，但 BPTT 需存储 k 步计算图，显存随 O(k·N) 线性增长，高分辨率 3D 模拟不可行。核心矛盾在于：渐近稳定要求 Jacobian 全局收缩，而保真度要求在局部奇异点映射"膨胀"以保留高频结构，即"收缩-耗散困境"。
AI.method: 理论上从误差传播线性化 ε_{t+1}≈J(u_t)ε_t 出发，说明全局统一约束必然在稳定性与局部保真度之间二选一，因此需要空间自适应正则。方法上，JAWS 将算子学习重写为带空间异方差不确定度的 MAP 问题：轻量辅助头 H_φ 从骨干网络深层特征（detach 后）输出对数方差场 s1(x)、s2(x)；数据似然项为 ½e^{-s1}‖u-û‖²，稳定性先验项为 ½e^{-s2}‖J(x)‖_F²，另有 ½(s1+s2) 复杂度惩罚防止 s→∞ 的平凡解。局部 Jacobian Frobenius 范数用 Hutchinson 迹估计器（Rademacher 探针 + VJP）以 O(1) 次反向传播近似（单样本，Rademacher 最小方差，Adam 平滑）。结构上实施"结构化信息瓶颈"：s1 退化为全局标量、仅 s2 保留空间自适应场，以避免非凸坍缩；并对进入 H_φ 的隐藏特征做梯度隔离，避免正则项产生"寄生梯度"污染骨干网络。混合训练框架中，JAWS 正则仅施加于基步 k=1（拓扑非对称，避免不确定度被回传的混沌时序噪声污染），多步 Pushforward 损失在 StopGrad(û_{t+1}) 分支上计算，复合损失 L=L_JAWS+λΣ_{k=2}^K‖u_{t+k}-û_{t+k}‖²。骨干网络：1D 用周期性卷积网络，2D 用 FiLM-UNet，以运动黏度 ν（与 Re 成反比）经 MLP 生成 FiLM 仿射参数，替代全局 Z-score 归一化以保留物理尺度差异并支持 Re=400 的 OOD 外推。
AI.result: 1D 粘性 Burgers（伪谱解，2000 训练/500 测试轨迹，Δt=0.01，ν∈[0.005,0.02]）：相对 L2 误差在第 50/100/200 步分别为 JAWS-S 7.3%/9.8%/14.9%，显著优于 Spectral Norm（10.0%/17.4%/30.3%）、Baseline（9.1%/14.8%/25.0%）与 JAWS-G（7.6%/12.3%/20.3%）；波数能谱显示 JAWS-S 在高频尾部保留 ~1e-6 的能量（而非基线的 ~1e-8 噪声地板），以精确保留激波前沿，同时整体谱半径被压缩至 ~0.35 的安全区间；消融显示模型在真实激波位置 x≈0.79 自动降低 e^{-s2}、并在强对流区提高 e^{-s1}，实现数据驱动的自适应激波捕捉；JAWS+PF(5) 相比 PF(10) 显著抑制激波轨迹上的误差热点。2D 圆柱绕流（训练 Re∈{100,200,300}，测试外推 Re=400，200 步≈40 s）：JAWS-S+PF(5) 相对 L2 误差 0.106、RMSE 0.104，约为次优 PF(k=10)（0.374）的 1/3.5；显存 14.22 GB、训练 76.41 min，远低于 PF(k=10) 的 23.44 GB/113.15 min（Baseline 仅 3.02 GB/7.59 min 但误差 0.767；Spectral Norm+PF(5) 误差 0.431）；宏观量上恢复下游湍动能峰值与 x/D=8.0 处尾流速度剖面，阻力-升力相图精确闭合于 CFD 真实极限环，PSD 中 Strouhal 数频率无漂移。附录还显示对 σ∈[0,0.3] 高斯输入噪声的鲁棒性（误差曲线近乎平坦）、OOD 初始化（高/低黏度、高频）单步泛化，以及 s1/s2 从不同初始化收敛到一致最优值（损失景观凸性）。
AI.conclusion: JAWS 建立了一个概率式正则化框架，把 aleatoric 不确定度转化为空间自适应谱调制机制：利用 MAP 目标与异方差不确定度，自动学习"在光滑区严格收缩、在激波/陡梯度区放松"的局部容差，突破了全局 Lipschitz 约束与局部物理保真之间的固有矛盾；通过梯度分离使不确定度估计与长时程梯度解耦，使短窗（k=5）Pushforward 即可获得与长窗基线相当或更优的长时间精度，大幅缓解自回归训练的显存瓶颈。在 1D Burgers（激波捕捉）与 2D 圆柱绕流 Re=400（OOD 泛化）上验证了长期自回归稳定性、高频动态保留、极限环吸引子结构锁定与计算效率。论文亦指出 Re≈190 以上真实绕流本应发生三维 Mode A/Mode B 分叉，数据由单层 z 网格（准二维）生成，属于"伪物理"流形，JAWS 的稳定化优势在该受限设定下尤为显著；未来工作为扩展至非结构化网格与三维湍流。

title: Querying with Conflicts of Interest
summary: Conflicts of interest often arise between data sources and their users regarding how the users' information needs should be interpreted by the data source. For example, an online product search might be biased towards presenting certain products higher than in its list of results to improve its revenue, which may not follow the user's desired ranking expressed in their query. The research community has proposed schemes for data systems to implement to ensure unbiased results. However, data systems and services usually have little or no incentive to implement these measures, e.g., these biases often increase their profits. In this paper, we propose a novel formal framework for querying in settings where the data source has incentives to return biased answers intentionally due to the conflict of interest between the user and the data source. We propose efficient algorithms to detect whether it is possible for users to extract relevant information from biased data sources. We propose methods to detect biased information in the results of a query efficiently. We also propose algorithms to reformulate input queries to increase the amount of relevant information in the returned results over biased data sources. Using experiments on real-world datasets, we show that our algorithms are efficient and return relevant information over large data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个处理数据源与用户之间利益冲突的形式化框架，当数据源因利益驱动返回有偏结果时，用户仍能从中提取相关信息。框架包含检测、识别和查询重写三类算法，并通过真实数据集验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 数据系统与其用户之间存在利益冲突，例如在线产品搜索可能按收益而非用户偏好排序。数据系统缺乏实施无偏措施的动力（因为偏见通常增加利润），导致用户无法获得符合其查询意图的结果。
AI.method: 1）设计形式化框架建模数据源有偏返回结果的情景；2）开发高效算法检测用户是否可从有偏数据源提取相关信息；3）提出方法识别查询结果中的有偏信息；4）设计算法对输入查询进行重写，以提高返回结果中的相关信息量。
AI.result: 实验在真实数据集上验证了算法的效率，表明其能够在大规模数据上有效返回相关信息。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架和算法能够有效应对数据源利益冲突问题，帮助用户从不透明的有偏结果中获取有价值的信息，为解决信息系统中的偏见问题提供了新的研究思路。

title: A Lock-Free Work-Stealing Algorithm for Bulk Operations
summary: Work-stealing is a widely used technique for balancing irregular parallel workloads, and most modern runtime systems adopt lock-free work-stealing deques to reduce contention and improve scalability. However, existing algorithms are designed for general-purpose parallel runtimes and often incur overheads that are unnecessary in specialized settings. In this paper, we present a new lock-free work-stealing queue tailored for a master-worker framework used in the parallelization of a mixed-integer programming optimization solver based on decision diagrams. Our design supports native bulk operations, grows without bounds, and assumes at most one owner and one concurrent stealer, thereby eliminating the need for heavy synchronization. We provide an informal sketch that our queue is linearizable and lock-free under this restricted concurrency model. Benchmarks demonstrate that our implementation achieves constant-latency push performance, remaining stable even as batch size increases, in contrast to existing queues from C++ Taskflow whose latencies grow sharply with batch size. Pop operations perform comparably across all implementations, while our steal operation maintains nearly flat latency across different steal proportions. We also explore an optimized steal variant that reduces latency by up to 3x in practice. Finally, a pseudo workload based on large-graph exploration confirms that all implementations scale linearly. However, we argue that solver workloads with irregular node processing times would further amplify the advantages of our algorithm.

AI.tldr: 针对基于决策图的MIP求解器的master-worker框架，设计了一种受限并发模型（单所有者+单窃取者）的专用无锁工作窃取队列，实现常数延迟的push和几乎平坦的steal延迟，显著优于通用运行时队列。
AI.motivation: 现有通用并行运行时的无锁工作窃取队列在专门化场景中存在不必要的开销。本文针对一种特定的master-worker框架——基于决策图的混合整数规划(MIP)优化求解器的并行化，设计了专用的无锁工作窃取队列。
AI.method: 提出一种新的无锁工作窃取队列，支持原生批量操作、无限增长，并限制为最多一个所有者和一个并发窃取者，从而消除重量级同步需求。提供了队列可线性化且无锁的 informal 证明。
AI.result: 基准测试表明：1) push操作实现常数延迟且随批量大小增加保持稳定，而C++ Taskflow队列延迟随批量增长急剧上升；2) pop操作在各实现中表现相当；3) steal操作在不同窃取比例下保持几乎平坦的延迟；4) 优化后的steal变体延迟降低高达3倍；5) 大图探索的伪工作负载确认所有实现都线性扩展。
AI.conclusion: 本文算法在处理不规则节点处理时间的求解器工作负载时将展现出更大优势。

title: Real Faults in Model Context Protocol (MCP) Software: a Comprehensive Taxonomy
summary:
The rapid adoption of foundation models has significantly expanded the capabilities of software systems, enabling them to perform complex language, reasoning, and interaction tasks that were previously difficult to automate. However, this progress has also introduced novel challenges that were largely absent in previous generations of software. In particular, the increasing integration of foundation models with external tools and resources raises new concerns regarding reliability, security, and robustness. The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has recently been proposed to standardize interactions between AI-based software systems, software tools, and external resources. Despite its growing adoption, there remains limited systematic understanding of real-world faults in MCP-based software systems.
  In this paper, we present the first large-scale taxonomy of faults in MCP servers, comprising five high-level fault categories derived from empirical evidence. To evaluate the completeness and generalizability of this taxonomy, we conduct a survey of MCP practitioners with diverse roles and experience levels. The results confirm that all identified fault categories occur in practice and reveal distinct characteristics that differentiate MCP-specific faults from non-MCP faults.
  Overall, this study provides actionable insights for researchers and practitioners by identifying the most error-prone and critical components of MCP-based systems. These insights can inform the development of more robust, reliable, and secure AI-enabled software systems that rely on MCP.

AI.tldr: First large-scale empirical study presenting a taxonomy of 5 fault categories in MCP servers, validated through practitioner surveys, providing insights for building more robust AI-enabled software systems.
AI.motivation: The rapid adoption of foundation models has introduced new challenges around reliability, security, and robustness when integrating them with external tools/resources via MCP, yet there is limited systematic understanding of real-world faults in MCP-based systems.
AI.method: Developed a taxonomy of faults in MCP servers through empirical evidence, then validated it via a survey of MCP practitioners with diverse roles and experience levels.
AI.result: A taxonomy of 5 high-level fault categories for MCP servers, validated by practitioners to confirm all categories occur in practice and reveal distinct characteristics differentiating MCP-specific faults from non-MCP faults.
AI.conclusion: This study presents the first large-scale empirical analysis of faults in MCP-based software systems, offering a comprehensive taxonomy with 5 high-level fault categories validated through practitioner surveys. It provides actionable insights for improving reliability, security, and robustness of AI-enabled systems using MCP.

title: Reasoning Models Struggle to Control their Chains of Thought
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is a promising tool for detecting misbehaviors and understanding the motivations of modern reasoning models. However, if models can control what they verbalize in their CoT, it could undermine CoT monitorability. To measure this undesirable capability -- CoT controllability -- we introduce the CoT-Control evaluation suite, which includes tasks that require models to solve problems while adhering to CoT instructions, e.g., reasoning about a genetics question without using the word 'chromosome'. We show that reasoning models possess significantly lower CoT controllability than output controllability; for instance, Claude Sonnet 4.5 can control its CoT only 2.7% of the time but 61.9% when controlling its final output. We also find that CoT controllability is higher for larger models and decreases with more RL training, test-time compute, and increased problem difficulty. CoT controllability failures extend even to situations in which models are given incentives (as opposed to direct requests) to evade CoT monitors, although models exhibit slightly higher controllability when they are told they are being monitored. Similarly, eliciting controllability by adversarially optimizing prompts does not meaningfully increase controllability. Our results leave us cautiously optimistic that CoT controllability is currently unlikely to be a failure mode of CoT monitorability. However, the mechanism behind low controllability is not well understood. Given its importance for maintaining CoT monitorability, we recommend that frontier labs track CoT controllability in future models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型的思维链(CoT)可控性问题，发现当前推理模型的CoT可控性远低于输出可控性（如Claude Sonnet 4.5仅为2.7%），这意味着模型难以按要求控制其内部推理过程。虽然这目前不会威胁CoT监控的有效性，但研究者呼吁前沿实验室持续跟踪这一能力。
AI.motivation: 研究背景：思维链(CoT)监控是检测现代推理模型不当行为的有前景工具，但模型若能控制其在CoT中表达的内容，可能会破坏CoT的可监控性。研究动机是衡量这种不良能力——CoT可控性——即模型是否能够按照指令控制其思维链的内容。
AI.method: 方法：引入Co-Control评估套件，包含多项任务，要求模型在遵守CoT指令的同时解决问题，例如在不使用"chromosome"一词的情况下进行遗传学问题推理。实验测试了多个推理模型，包括Claude Sonnet 4.5等，并比较了CoT可控性与输出可控性。
AI.result: 主要结果：推理模型的CoT可控性显著低于输出可控性。例如，Claude Sonnet 4.5的CoT可控性仅为2.7%，但输出可控性达61.9%。此外，CoT可控性随模型增大而提高，但随更多RL训练、推理时计算和问题难度增加而下降。即使在模型被给予激励（而非直接要求）规避CoT监控的情况下，CoT可控性失败仍然存在。告知模型其正在被监控时可控性略有提高，对抗性优化提示也不能显著提高可控性。
AI.conclusion: 结论：当前CoT可控性不太可能成为CoT可监控性的失败模式，这一结果令人谨慎乐观。但由于低可控性的机制尚不明确，鉴于其对维护CoT可监控性的重要性，建议前沿实验室在未来的模型中跟踪CoT可控性。

title: VDCook:DIY video data cook your MLLMs
summary:
We introduce VDCook: a self-evolving video data operating system, a configurable video data construction platform for researchers and vertical domain teams. Users initiate data requests via natural language queries and adjustable parameters (scale, retrieval-synthesis ratio, quality threshold). The system automatically performs query optimization, concurrently running real video retrieval and controlled synthesis modules. It ultimately generates in-domain data packages with complete provenance and metadata, along with reproducible Notebooks.
  Unlike traditional static, one-time-built datasets, VDCook enables continuous updates and domain expansion through its automated data ingestion mechanism based on MCP (Model Context Protocol)\cite{mcp2024anthropic}, transforming datasets into dynamically evolving open ecosystems. The system also provides multi-dimensional metadata annotation (scene segmentation, motion scoring, OCR ratio, automatic captioning, etc.), laying the foundation for flexible subsequent data `cooking' and indexing\cite{vlogger}.
  This platform aims to significantly lower the barrier to constructing specialized video training datasets through infrastructure-level solutions, while supporting community contributions and a governance-enabled data expansion paradigm. \textbf{Project demo:} https://screenapp.io/app/v/WP0SvffgsH

AI.tldr: VDCook是一个自进化的视频数据操作系统，通过自然语言查询和可调参数自动完成视频检索与合成，生成带有完整元数据和溯源的数据包，并基于MCP协议实现数据集的持续更新和动态扩展。
AI.motivation: 传统静态一次性构建的数据集难以满足垂直领域团队对专业化视频训练数据的需求，存在数据构建门槛高、缺乏动态更新机制、元数据不完整等问题。
AI.method: 系统采用MCP（模型上下文协议）实现自动化数据摄取机制，支持自然语言查询和可调参数（规模、检索-合成比、质量阈值），并行运行真实视频检索和受控合成模块，并提供多维元数据标注（场景分割、运动评分、OCR比例、自动字幕等）。
AI.result: VDCook能够自动执行查询优化，并发生成包含完整溯源和元数据的领域内数据包及可复现Notebooks，实现数据集的持续更新和领域扩展，将数据集转化为动态演进的开放生态系统。
AI.conclusion: VDCook通过基础设施级解决方案显著降低了构建专业化视频训练数据集的门槛，同时支持社区贡献和治理驱动的数据扩展范式，为视频数据管理提供了新的思路。

title: Efficient Vector Search in the Wild: One Model for Multi-K Queries
summary: Learned top-K search is a promising approach for serving vector queries with both high accuracy and performance. However, current models trained for a specific K value fail to generalize to real-world multi-K queries: they suffer from accuracy degradation (for larger Ks) and performance loss (for smaller Ks). Training the model to generalize on different Ks requires orders of magnitude more preprocessing time and is not suitable for serving vector queries in the wild. We present OMEGA, a K-generalizable learned top-K search method that simultaneously achieves high accuracy, high performance, and low preprocessing cost for multi-K vector queries. The key idea is that a base model properly trained on K=1 with our trajectory-based features can be used to accurately predict larger Ks with a dynamic refinement procedure and smaller Ks with minimal performance loss. To make our refinements efficient, we further leverage the statistical properties of top-K searches to reduce excessive model invocations. Extensive evaluations on multiple public and production datasets show that, under the same preprocessing budgets, OMEGA achieves 6-33% lower average latency compared to state-of-the-art learned search methods, while all systems achieve the same recall target. With only 16-30% of the preprocessing time, OMEGA attains 1.01-1.28x of the optimal average latency of these baselines.

AI.tldr: OMEGA是一种K可泛化学习的top-K搜索方法，通过在K=1上训练基础模型配合轨迹特征和动态细化程序，实现多K向量查询的高准确率、高性能和低预处理成本
AI.motivation: 当前为特定K值训练的模型无法很好地泛化到实际多K查询场景：较大K值时准确率下降，较小K值时性能损失。训练能够泛化到不同K值的模型需要数量级更多的预处理时间，不适合实际向量查询服务
AI.method: 核心方法包括：(1)使用轨迹特征在K=1上训练基础模型；(2)动态细化程序用于准确预测较大K值；(3)利用top-K搜索的统计特性减少过多模型调用以提高效率
AI.result: 在多个公开和生产数据集上的广泛评估表明，在相同预处理预算下，OMEGA相比最先进的学习搜索方法实现6-33%更低的平均延迟，同时所有系统达到相同的召回率目标；仅用16-30%的预处理时间，OMEGA达到这些基线最佳平均延迟的1.01-1.28倍
AI.conclusion: OMEGA能够在相同的预处理预算下实现6-33%的更低平均延迟，同时保持相同的召回率目标；在仅使用16-30%预处理时间的情况下，达到基线最佳平均延迟的1.01-1.28倍

title: Gathering Autonomous Mobile Robots Under the Adversarial Defected View Model
summary: This paper studies the gathering problem for a set of $N \ge 2$ autonomous mobile robots operating in the Euclidean plane under the distributed Look-Compute-Move model. We consider oblivious robots executing under the adversarial defected view model, in which an activated robot may observe only a restricted subset of robots due to adversarial visibility faults. Consequently, the information obtained during each Look phase may be incomplete and dynamically altered. The objective is to guarantee deterministic finite-time gathering at a location not known a priori despite such sensing restrictions. We present two distributed algorithms under distinct scheduling assumptions. In the fully synchronous (FSYNC) model, we prove finite-time gathering in the adversarial (4, 2) defected view setting, resolving a previously open case without requiring additional capabilities or coordinate agreement. In the asynchronous (ASYNC) model, we establish finite-time gathering under the general adversarial (N, K) defected view model, where an activated robot observes at most K of the other $N - 1$ robots for any $1 \le K < N - 1$. Both results hold under non-rigid motion. The proposed algorithm for the ASYNC model assumes agreement in the direction and orientation of one coordinate axis.

AI.tldr: 研究分布式自治移动机器人在 adversarial defected view 模型下的确定性有限时间聚集问题。在 FSYNC 模型下证明 (4,2) defected view 设置下的有限时间聚集，在 ASYNC 模型下证明 (N,K) defected view 模型下的有限时间聚集。
AI.motivation: 解决在感知受限情况下（adversarial visibility faults）的机器人聚集问题。现有研究未能完全解决 adversarial defected view 模型下的有限时间聚集，且不需要额外能力或坐标 agreement。
AI.method: 采用 Look-Compute-Move 模型，使用 oblivious robots，在 adversarial defected view 模型下设计分布式算法。FSYNC 模型针对 (4,2) 配置，ASYNC 模型针对一般 (N,K) 配置（K < N-1）。
AI.result: 在 FSYNC 模型下证明了 (4,2) defected view 设置下的有限时间聚集。在 ASYNC 模型下建立了一般 adversarial (N,K) defected view 模型下的有限时间聚集。两种结果均在非刚性运动条件下成立。
AI.conclusion: 成功解决了 adversarial defected view 模型下的确定性有限时间聚集问题，不需要额外能力或在 FSYNC 情况下不需要坐标 agreement。ASYNC 模型算法假设对坐标轴方向和方向达成一致。

title: XAI for Coding Agent Failures: Transforming Raw Execution Traces into Actionable Insights
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based coding agents show promise in automating software development tasks, yet they frequently fail in ways that are difficult for developers to understand and debug. While general-purpose LLMs like GPT can provide ad-hoc explanations of failures, raw execution traces remain challenging to interpret even for experienced developers. We present a systematic explainable AI (XAI) approach that transforms raw agent execution traces into structured, human-interpretable explanations. Our method consists of three key components: (1) a domain-specific failure taxonomy derived from analyzing real agent failures, (2) an automatic annotation system that classifies failures using defined annotation schema, (3) a hybrid explanation generator that produces visual execution flows, natural language explanations, and actionable recommendations. Through a user study with 20 participants (10 technical, 10 non-technical), we demonstrate that our approach enables users to identify failure root causes 2.8 times faster and propose correct fixes with 73% higher accuracy compared to raw execution traces. Importantly, our structured approach outperforms ad-hoc state of the art models explanations by providing consistent, domain-specific insights with integrated visualizations. Our work establishes a framework for systematic agent failure analysis, addressing the critical need for interpretable AI systems in software development workflows

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种针对LLM编码Agent的系统化可解释AI(XAI)方法，将原始执行轨迹转换为结构化人类可读解释，包含故障分类法、自动注释系统和混合解释生成器三个核心组件，实验证实在故障根因识别速度和修复方案准确率方面均显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: LLM-based编码Agent在自动化软件开发任务中展现出潜力，但经常以难以理解和调试的方式失败。通用LLM虽能提供临时性失败解释，但原始执行轨迹即使对经验丰富的开发者也难以解读。
AI.method: 提出三组件XAI方法：(1)基于实际Agent故障分析构建的领域特定故障分类法；(2)使用定义注释模式进行故障自动分类的注释系统；(3)生成可视化执行流程、自然语言解释和可操作建议的混合解释生成器。
AI.result: 用户研究（20名参与者：10名技术/10名非技术）表明：(1)用户识别故障根因速度快2.8倍；(2)提出正确修复方案的准确率提高73%；(3)结构化方法优于临时性最先进的模型解释，提供一致、领域特定的洞察和集成可视化。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了一个系统化的Agent故障分析框架，解决了软件开发生态系统中可解释AI的关键需求。通过将原始执行轨迹转换为结构化、可视化的解释，该方法显著提升了调试效率和问题修复准确率。

title: Evolving Medical Imaging Agents via Experience-driven Self-skill Discovery
summary: Clinical image interpretation is inherently multi-step and tool-centric: clinicians iteratively combine visual evidence with patient context, quantify findings, and refine their decisions through a sequence of specialized procedures. While LLM-based agents promise to orchestrate such heterogeneous medical tools, existing systems treat tool sets and invocation strategies as static after deployment. This design is brittle under real-world domain shifts, across tasks, and evolving diagnostic requirements, where predefined tool chains frequently degrade and demand costly manual re-design. We propose MACRO, a self-evolving, experience-augmented medical agent that shifts from static tool composition to experience-driven tool discovery. From verified execution trajectories, the agent autonomously identifies recurring effective multi-step tool sequences, synthesizes them into reusable composite tools, and registers these as new high-level primitives that continuously expand its behavioral repertoire. A lightweight image-feature memory grounds tool selection in a visual-clinical context, while a GRPO-like training loop reinforces reliable invocation of discovered composites, enabling closed-loop self-improvement with minimal supervision. Extensive experiments across diverse medical imaging datasets and tasks demonstrate that autonomous composite tool discovery consistently improves multi-step orchestration accuracy and cross-domain generalization over strong baselines and recent state-of-the-art agentic methods, bridging the gap between brittle static tool use and adaptive, context-aware clinical AI assistance. Code will be available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: MACRO：一种自进化的医学影像智能体，通过「经验驱动的自技能发现」把静态工具编排转为自主复合工具发现——从已验证的成功轨迹中挖掘高频多步工具序列，合成为可复用的复合工具（新的高层动作原语），并用轻量图像特征记忆做视觉-临床上下文检索、以 GRPO 强化其调用，在 REFUGE2（青光眼）、MITEA（心脏病）、RAM-W600（骨侵蚀）上超越通用 VLM 与现有医学智能体基线。
AI.motivation: 临床影像判读本质上是多步、工具密集、需验证的过程（检测→分割→定量→纵向对比）。但现有 LLM 医学智能体的工具集与调用策略在部署后完全静态：医院间采集协议、报告模板、患者分布与诊断需求会漂移，预定义工具链在域偏移下性能急剧退化，且需要专家重新分解设计、人工重写流程；智能体只是「工具使用者」而非「工具学习者」，缺乏从交互经验中自主发现、验证并内化新的多步例程的机制。作者类比临床医生会把经验沉淀为可复用诊断常规（如病灶测量、跨切片验证、纵向对比的固定序列），提出让智能体也从交互经验中「长出」自己的多步动作抽象库，即从静态工具组合转向经验驱动的工具发现。
AI.method:
形式化：将智能体-环境交互建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），状态扩展为 (s_t, M_t)（环境状态 + 经验记忆），观测 o_t = (x, h_{<t}, e_{<t}, m_t)，动作空间 A_t = 原子工具 T ∪ 动态增长的复合工具集 C_t ∪ {answer}。

三大支柱：
(1) 经验驱动的图像特征记忆（§3.2）。先用强教师 VLM（DeepSeek）带工具执行采集高质量演示轨迹 τ_i（离策略轨迹自举），既作 SFT 监督又作记忆种子。记忆条目 m = (prompt 上下文 p, 工具序列 t, 摘要结果 r, 冻结视觉编码器提取的图像特征 f)。检索时以余弦相似度 sim(f_q, f_m) 排序，取 top-k 作为 in-context 示例注入提示，实现视觉条件化的工具选择。轨迹被分解为步级条目在线写回，且仅在最终预测正确时写入（Eq.2 质量门控）。
(2) 复合工具发现（§3.3）。从成功轨迹中提取工具调用序列，挖掘跨样本反复出现的连续子序列，当频次 freq(c) > 阈值 τ 时注册为复合工具 C = {c | freq(c) > τ}；每个复合工具 c = (c_1,...,c_L) 是原子工具的有序元组，可在动作空间中作为单一高层动作被调用。注册表随训练在线更新，使动作空间本身成为累积经验的函数。
(3) 两阶段策略优化（§3.4）。Stage 1 监督冷启动：以学生自身执行上下文 ô_t 构造目标（学生无梯度生成动作并在环境中执行，反馈反映学生分布），最小化 L_SFT 交叉熵，缓解行为克隆的暴露偏差；每回合预测正确即同步更新 M 与 C。Stage 2 GRPO 强化：对每个输入采样 G 条 on-policy 轨迹，逐步奖励 R_t = 1 当该步调用的工具名序列 g_t 中存在与某复合工具 c 精确匹配的连续子序列（c ⊑ g_t），否则 0（稀疏、任务对齐的组合奖励）；用组归一化优势 A_i^(g) = (R-μ)/(σ+ε) 与 PPO 式裁剪目标 + β·KL(π_θ||π_ref) 更新，参考策略为 Stage 1 后冻结的模型。轨迹级正确性作为延迟全局信用分配信号，用于扩充 M 与 C。基座模型为 Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct，LoRA (r=8, α=32, dropout 0.1)，AdamW，SFT lr 5e-5、GRPO lr 5e-6。工具集包含 segment_optic_disc、segment_optic_cup、canny_edge、convert_color_space 等。
