AI.result: REFUGE2 青光眼：MACRO BACC 92.7 / F1 80.3，优于 MedAgent-Pro（90.4/76.4，+2.3/+3.9），远高于 Qwen2.5-7B-VL（54.3/16.3，+38.4/+64.0）。MITEA 心脏病（3D 超声按 MedAgent-Pro 协议随机取 3 切片）：BACC 77.2 / F1 74.9，BACC 较 MedAgent-Pro 略降 0.6 而 F1 提升 2.6。RAM-W600 骨侵蚀：MACRO BACC 61.75 / F1 30.00 / ACC 90.01 / SEN 28.50 / SPC 95.00 / PRE 31.61，全面优于同数据训练的专用模型（最好 BACC 52.64、F1 12.40；ConvKAN 特异度 94.70 但敏感度仅 3.82），说明任务自适应工具集成可缓解类别不平衡与细微征象漏检。消融（REFUGE2/MITEA）：基线 82.8/69.7 与 69.2/64.8；加记忆 83.9/75.8 与 72.4/65.3（REFUGE2 F1 +6.1）；再加复合工具发现（无 GRPO）跃升至 90.6/80.3 与 75.1/71.8；完整系统 92.7/80.3 与 77.2/74.9，验证三组件协同。闭环分析：注册复合工具数呈「快速增长后饱和」两阶段（探索→利用），与 BACC 提升强相关；工具复杂度随高层工具替代多步模式而下降；使用抽象工具相比基础工具库性能提升 8.8%。案例中典型青光眼流程（灰度化→盘/杯分割→计算杯盘比）被自动注册为复合工具。
AI.conclusion: 核心论点：制约医学智能体的已不再是工具数量，而是部署后「程序性能力的累积」。MACRO 把交互历史转化为显式、可扩展的复合技能库，使智能体从刚性编排转向持续能力增长，为无需端到端重做的临床部署提供可审计、可版本化的能力更新路径。局限：复合工具质量受轨迹验证保真度上限约束，噪声或部分正确轨迹可能引入次优技能；跨视觉语义差异极大的未见模态迁移仍可能失效；评测仅为预测性指标，缺少校准、工作流效率与临床决策影响的前瞻性人机协同研究。

title: IntSeqBERT: Learning Arithmetic Structure in OEIS via Modulo-Spectrum Embeddings
summary: Integer sequences in the OEIS span values from single-digit constants to astronomical factorials and exponentials, making prediction challenging for standard tokenised models that cannot handle out-of-vocabulary values or exploit periodic arithmetic structure. We present IntSeqBERT, a dual-stream Transformer encoder for masked integer-sequence modelling on OEIS. Each sequence element is encoded along two complementary axes: a continuous log-scale magnitude embedding and sin/cos modulo embeddings for 100 residues (moduli $2$--$101$), fused via FiLM. Three prediction heads (magnitude regression, sign classification, and modulo prediction for 100 moduli) are trained jointly on 274,705 OEIS sequences. At the Large scale (91.5M parameters), IntSeqBERT achieves 95.85% magnitude accuracy and 50.38% Mean Modulo Accuracy (MMA) on the test set, outperforming a standard tokenised Transformer baseline by $+8.9$ pt and $+4.5$ pt, respectively. An ablation removing the modulo stream confirms it accounts for $+15.2$ pt of the MMA gain and contributes an additional $+6.2$ pt to magnitude accuracy. A probabilistic Chinese Remainder Theorem (CRT)-based Solver converts the model's predictions into concrete integers, yielding a 7.4-fold improvement in next-term prediction over the tokenised-Transformer baseline (Top-1: 19.09% vs. 2.59%). Modulo spectrum analysis reveals a strong negative correlation between Normalised Information Gain (NIG) and Euler's totient ratio $\varphi(m)/m$ ($r = -0.851$, $p < 10^{-28}$), providing empirical evidence that composite moduli capture OEIS arithmetic structure more efficiently via CRT aggregation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IntSeqBERT，一种用于OEIS整数序列预测的双流Transformer编码器，通过对数尺度幅度嵌入和100个模的sin/cos模嵌入来编码序列元素，结合FiLM融合和三个预测头（幅度回归、符号分类、模预测），在91.5M参数规模下实现了95.85%的幅度准确率和50.38%的平均模准确率，并通过基于CRT的求解器将预测转换为具体整数，下一term预测Top-1准确率达19.09%，比tokenized Transformer基线提升7.4倍。
AI.motivation: OEIS中的整数序列值范围从个位数到天文数字的阶乘和指数，标准token化模型无法处理词汇表外值，也无法利用周期性算术结构，导致序列预测困难。
AI.method: 提出IntSeqBERT双流Transformer编码器：(1)连续对数尺度幅度嵌入；(2)100个模（2-101）的sin/cos模嵌入；(3)通过FiLM融合；(4)三个联合训练预测头：幅度回归、符号分类、100个模的模预测；(5)基于中国剩余定理(CRT)的概率求解器将预测转换为具体整数。
AI.result: Large规模(91.5M参数)：幅度准确率95.85%，平均模准确率(MMA)50.38%，比tokenized Transformer分别提升+8.9pt和+4.5pt。消融实验表明模流贡献+15.2pt的MMA增益和+6.2pt的幅度准确率增益。CRT求解器实现7.4倍下一term预测提升(Top-1: 19.09% vs. 2.59%)。模谱分析发现归一化信息增益(NIG)与欧拉商数φ(m)/m呈强负相关(r=-0.851, p<10^-28)，表明显合模通过CRT聚合能更高效捕捉OEIS算术结构。
AI.conclusion: IntSeqBERT通过dual-stream架构和CRT求解器有效解决了OEIS序列预测中数值跨度大且具有周期算术结构的挑战，验证了模编码对于整数序列建模的重要价值，并揭示了合数模在捕捉序列算术结构方面的优势。

title: Tag-specific Regret Minimization Problem in Outdoor Advertising
summary: Recently, out-of-home advertising has become a popular marketing technique, due to its higher return on investment. E-commerce houses approach the influence provider to achieve effective advertising through their tags (advertising content), influence demand, and budgets. The influence provider's goal will be to make proper tag allocations, meet the required influence demand within the budget constraint, and minimize total regret. We formalize this as a combinatorial optimization problem and refer to it as \textsc{Tag-specific Regret Minimization in Outdoor Advertising (TRMOA)}. We show that TRMOA is NP-hard and inapproximable within a constant factor. The regret model we consider is non-monotone and non-submodular, and the simple greedy approach is ineffective. We introduce a fairness-aware greedy round-robin approach that reduces regret with balanced allocation across advertisers. To improve, we also introduce randomized greedy and local search algorithms. We have experimented with all the methodologies using real-world trajectory and billboard datasets to show the effectiveness and efficiency of the solution methodologies.

AI.tldr: 研究户外广告中的标签特定遗憾最小化问题(TRMOA)，旨在帮助电子商务平台通过影响提供者进行广告投放，在预算约束下满足影响力需求并最小化总遗憾。
AI.motivation: 户外广告因其较高的投资回报率已成为热门营销技术。电子商务平台需要通过影响提供者（影响者）进行有效广告投放，涉及广告内容标签、影响力需求和预算的优化配置。
AI.method: 1) 将问题形式化为组合优化问题TRMOA；2) 证明其NP难性和不可近似性；3) 提出公平感知贪心轮转方法，实现跨广告商的平衡分配；4) 开发随机贪心和局部搜索算法以提升效果。
AI.result: 所提方法在真实轨迹和广告牌数据集上验证了有效性和效率。
AI.conclusion: TRMOA是一个具有挑战性的组合优化问题，遗憾模型具有非单调性和非子模性，简单贪心方法效果不佳。公平感知贪心轮转、随机贪心和局部搜索算法为解决该问题提供了有效方案。

title: StreamWise: Serving Multi-Modal Generation in Real-Time at Scale
summary:
Advances in multi-modal generative models are enabling new applications, from storytelling to automated media synthesis. Most current workloads generate simple outputs (e.g., image generation from a prompt) in batch mode, often requiring several seconds even for basic results. Serving real-time multi-modal workflows at scale is costly and complex, requiring efficient coordination of diverse models (each with unique resource needs) across language, audio, image, and video, all under strict latency and resource constraints.
  We tackle these challenges through the lens of real-time podcast video generation, integrating LLMs, text-to-speech, and video-audio generation. To meet tight SLOs, we design an adaptive, modular serving system, StreamWise, that dynamically manages quality (e.g., resolution, sharpness), model/content parallelism, and resource-aware scheduling. We leverage heterogeneous hardware to maximize responsiveness and efficiency. For example, the system can lower video resolution and allocate more resources to early scenes.
  We quantify the trade-offs between latency, cost, and quality. The cheapest setup generates a 10-minute podcast video on A100 GPUs in 1.4 hours (8.4x slower than the real-time) for less than \$25. StreamWise enables high-quality real-time streaming with a sub-second startup delay under $45.

AI.tldr: StreamWise是一个用于实时播客视频生成的自适应模块化服务系统，集成了LLM、文本转语音和视频音频生成技术，通过动态管理质量、模型/内容并行性和资源感知调度来满足严格的SLO要求。
AI.motivation: 多模态生成模型的新应用（如故事叙述、自动媒体合成）正在兴起，但当前工作负载生成简单输出需要数秒；大规模实时多模态工作流服务成本高且复杂，需要在不同模态（语言、音频、图像、视频）间高效协调模型，且每个模型有独特的资源需求。
AI.method: 设计自适应模块化服务系统StreamWise，动态管理质量（如分辨率、清晰度）、模型/内容并行性以及资源感知调度；利用异构硬件最大化响应速度和效率，例如降低视频分辨率并将更多资源分配给早期场景。
AI.result: 最便宜配置：在A100 GPU上生成10分钟播客视频需1.4小时（比实时慢8.4倍），成本低于25美元；StreamWise实现高质量实时流媒体传输，启动延迟低于1秒，成本低于45美元。
AI.conclusion: StreamWise能够在严格延迟和资源约束下有效协调多种模态模型，通过动态质量调整和资源优化实现实时多模态内容生成的可行性，为大规模实时服务提供了一种可扩展的解决方案。

title: Balancing Latency and Accuracy of Code Completion via Local-Cloud Model Cascading
summary: Line-level code completion requires a critical balance between high accuracy and low latency. Existing methods suffer from a trade-off: large language models (LLMs) provide high-quality suggestions but incur high latency, while small language models (SLMs) are fast but often suboptimal. We propose MCCom (Model-Cascading-based code Completion), a framework that cascades a local SLM with a cloud-based LLM. To achieve effective cascading, MCCom leverages user actions as a novel signal to trigger the LLM only when the SLM fails, significantly reducing cloud computation costs. Furthermore, we introduce a two-stage speculative decoding strategy and an iterative retrieval mechanism to enhance collaboration between the models. We also train a 121M-parameter lightweight model, which achieves 73.8% of the performance of a 7B state-of-the-art model. Evaluated on RepoEval and a new real-world benchmark StmtEval, MCCom reduces inference latency by up to 47.9% and LLM usage by 46.3%, while improving the LLM's exact match rate by 8.9% through effective collaboration.

AI.tldr: MCCom是一个基于模型级联的代码补全框架，通过将本地小型语言模型与云端大型语言模型级联，结合用户动作触发机制、两阶段推测解码和迭代检索，在保持高质量的同时显著降低延迟和计算成本。
AI.motivation: 行级代码补全需要在高准确率和低延迟之间取得关键平衡。现有方法存在权衡困境：大型语言模型（LLM）提供高质量建议但延迟高，而小型语言模型（SLM）速度快但质量通常不佳。
AI.method: 提出MCCom框架，采用模型级联策略：本地SLM与云端LLM级联；利用用户动作作为新信号触发LLM（仅当SLM失败时）；引入两阶段推测解码策略和迭代检索机制增强模型协作；训练了121M参数的轻量级模型。
AI.result: 推理延迟降低最多47.9%，LLM使用量减少46.3%，LLM精确匹配率提高8.9%。121M参数轻量级模型达到7B模型性能的73.8%。
AI.conclusion: MCCom在RepoEval和StmtEval基准测试中取得了显著成果：推理延迟降低最多47.9%，LLM使用量减少46.3%，同时通过模型协作将LLM的精确匹配率提高了8.9%。121M参数的轻量级模型达到了7B最先进模型性能的73.8%。

title: The World Won't Stay Still: Programmable Evolution for Agent Benchmarks
summary: LLM-powered agents fulfill user requests by interacting with environments, querying data, and invoking tools in a multi-turn process. Yet, most existing benchmarks assume static environments with fixed schemas and toolsets, neglecting the evolutionary nature of the real world and agents' robustness to environmental changes. In this paper, we study a crucial problem: how to evolve the agent environment in a scalable and controllable way, thereby better evaluating agents' adaptability to real-world dynamics. We propose ProEvolve, a graph-based framework that makes environment evolution programmable. At its core, a typed relational graph provides a unified, explicit representation of the environment: data, tools, and schema. Under this formalism, adding, removing, or modifying capabilities are expressed as graph transformations that coherently propagate updates across tools, schemas, and data access. Building on this, ProEvolve can (1) program the evolutionary dynamics as graph transformations to generate environments automatically, and (2) instantiate task sandboxes via subgraph sampling and programming. We validate ProEvolve by evolving a single environment into 200 environments and 3,000 task sandboxes, and benchmark representative agents accordingly.

AI.tldr: ProEvolve 是一个基于图的框架，用于以"可编程"方式演化工具调用智能体的评测环境：把环境表示为带类型的关系图（schema 元素为节点、工具使能转换为边），将"能力新增/访问路径重组/能力废弃"等演化意图表达为显式图变换，再实例化为可执行环境版本，并基于子图采样生成与版本绑定的任务沙箱。作者在电商与航空订票两个领域从单一种子环境演进出 200/20 个版本与 3,000/300 个任务沙箱，并以 5 个代表性 LLM 智能体的评测结果作为下游诊断证据。
AI.motivation: 现有工具调用智能体基准（SWE-bench、OSWorld、WebArena、AgentBench、ToolBench、GAIA、τ-bench、τ²-bench、AUTOENV 等）普遍假设环境是静态的：schema、数据实体与工具集固定，因此无法评估智能体在能力新增、接口重组、接口废弃等结构化变化下的适应性与鲁棒性。已有"扩展"工作要么只放大任务量（AutoBencher、TaskCraft 保持工具不变），要么生成彼此独立的环境变体（AUTOENV），要么仅做表层 API 扰动（ToolQA-D 用 GPT-4 改参数名/返回格式），都只捕捉"环境变异"而非"结构化演化"。关键缺口在于"版本链接"：新版本须由前一版本派生、保留未被显式删除的结构、并把变更一致地传播到 schema、工具、数据访问与任务。因此本文把"结构化环境演化"形式化为一个基准构造问题，并提出两个诉求：可扩展的一致性（scalable coherence）与可控的版本化动态（controlled versioned dynamics）。
AI.method:
**形式化**：定义"结构化环境演化"为序列 G^(0)→Δ^(1)G^(1)→…→Δ^(K)G^(K)，满足三点——序贯依赖（每次变换以当前版本为条件）、结构记忆（未被显式移除的组件全部保留）、一致传播（schema/工具/数据访问同步更新）；并强调其区别于任务扩缩、独立环境生成与表层扰动。

**图形式化**：环境表示为带类型的关系图 G=(V,E)，节点为 schema 元素（如 User.user_id、Order.order_id），有向边为类型化关系或"工具使能转换"（tool-enabled transition），使可达信息显式化。

**两阶段 agentic 演化管线**：
- Phase I 演化提案：LLM 遍历环境图并按预定义原语提出变换计划——Completion（新增能力，需补齐实体、字段、关系与工具）、Saturation（在多跳关系上加入捷径工具以重组访问路径）、Deprecation（剪枝节点/边模拟能力下线，同时保留可行替代路径）。
- Phase II 实现与验证：图作为代码生成的"结构规格"，生成 data_model.py 与 tools_implementation.py；四级级联校验——图有效性（schema 一致性、可达性、依赖闭包）、语法/导入检查、图锚定的 pytest 单元测试、LLM-as-a-Judge 语义意图一致性；失败最多 R=3 次定向修复；含 level-3 真缺陷的版本被过滤，不作为后续演化基座（防止误差累积），并以额外采样轨迹补足规模。

**任务即子图**：每个任务定义为受约束子图 G_τ⊆G^(k)，经三步生成——子图采样并合成目标 g_τ 与场景 s_τ；沙箱实体化（实例化前置实体、属性与跨实体外键引用，保证工具转换可执行）；agentic walk 执行（沿 G_τ 做 oracle 遍历，产出逐状态用户指令 u_t*、图推导的成功判据 Y_t*、参考轨迹，事实累积 K̂_t=K̂_{t-1}∪φ(y_t)，活跃上下文子图 A_t=Expand(A_{t-1}; a_t, u_t*, G_τ)）。

**评测协议**：以"信息中心"而非工具序列匹配为准——状态级成功判据由 schema 感知的工具输出与回复文本抽取判定，状态级成功率 C(τ)=(1/T)Σs_t；用户模拟器仅在满足 Y_t* 时推进状态，否则追问澄清。

**实验**：电商域（源自 WebShop 的 1000 商品、50 合成用户、51 工具/64 schema 种子）与航空域（改编自 τ²-bench，21 工具/8 schema）；每条轨迹固定为 seed→Δcomp→Δsat→Δdep 四个版本；电商 50 条轨迹/200 版本/3000 沙箱，航空 5 条/20 版本/300 沙箱；难度按易/中/硬 1:1:1 均衡。评测智能体为 GPT-5、Claude-Opus-4.5、DeepSeek-V3.2、Qwen3-235B、Gemini-2.5-Pro，用户模拟器与生成主干为 claude-opus-4-5，判官为 claude-sonnet-4.5，全流程 temperature=0；并设置 Trace Context / Summary Context 两种前版本经验探针。
AI.result:
**有效性**：修改代码单测行覆盖 100%，电商/航空通过率 90.8%/93.1%；"无缺陷版本"率 96.0%/86.7%。电商 810 个失败中仅 48 个（约占全部 7315 个测试的 0.7%）为 level-3 真工具缺陷，51% 属测试实现 bug、23% 为边缘用例；被过滤版本电商 6/150、航空 2/15。

**语义保真（LLM 判官，1–5）**：Reality/Graph Fidelity/Code Fidelity 分别为电商 4.76/4.63/4.55、航空 4.78/4.71/4.60；9 个子项中"does not meet"占比 0%，最弱项（复杂度、图完整性、工具完整性）仍 >4.4。

**多样性**：200 个电商环境覆盖 384 个唯一工具与 201 个唯一 schema（种子为 51/64），工具对 Jaccard 距离 0.976、唯一工具比 0.645、频率熵 8.07 bits；相较"无图"随机演化基线在全部指标上更优（Jaccard +0.109、唯一工具比 +0.251、熵 +0.41），且每条轨迹新增工具更少（10.8 vs 21.0）。

**沙箱质量**：四维判官均分 4.75/5.00/4.50/4.62（电商），无 ≤2 分项；难度确实带来区分度（GPT-5 成功率 ~0.80→~0.62，工具调用近翻倍）。

**下游诊断**（Table 2）：能力新增（scalability）下多数模型持平或上升（GPT-5 +0.08、Gemini-2.5-Pro +0.15）但轨迹更深；访问路径重组（efficiency）下 GPT-5 +0.21、Claude-Opus-4.5 +0.14，但所有模型轮次与工具调用均上升，说明 agent 未收敛到最短路径；废弃（robustness）下除 Gemini 外全部下滑，Qwen3-235B 降幅最大（−0.22），GPT-5 工具调用从 8.1 飙至 20.6 且成功率下降，暴露未恢复的重试循环。

**记忆/上下文探针**：多数模型在 Trace/Summary Context 下工具调用下降但成功率不升甚至下降，DeepSeek-V3.2 为例外；Summary Context 使"工具发现遗漏"类失败显著上升（过时工具信念），Trace 与 Summary 趋势相近，唯 Claude-Opus-4.5 在 Trace 下改善而在 Summary 下降。失败分类（缺失调用占 55–65%、不可行期望 ~20–25%、无效参数 <10%）显示演化主要压力在"工具发现与主动性"而非参数构造，且失败可按图变换解释。
AI.conclusion: 本文把"结构化环境演化"确立为工具调用智能体基准构造的一个独立问题，并提出以显式图变换实现"可编程演化"的 ProEvolve：它能规模化生成可执行、语义对齐、高多样性且版本链接的环境与任务沙箱（电商 200 版本/3000 沙箱、航空 20/300）。版本链接带来两类既有基准无法支撑的诊断能力：反事实能力度量（可扩展性、效率、鲁棒性可被分离量化）与基于记忆的适应探针（揭示前版本经验在结构变化后会过时或误导）。局限在于：框架面向有显式 schema 与工具接口的结构化环境，向医疗、软件工程、开放 web/OS 控制等高风险或弱结构领域迁移需要额外领域知识与人工校验；生成环境可能带有图抽象与 LLM 生成产物，应作为诊断证据而非鲁棒性保证；缺少误差棒与显著性检验，作者以 temperature=0 的确定性与跨域大规模聚合加以辩护；作者计划把因子空间扩展到策略变更、权限约束、工具行为漂移与用户行为偏移。

title: Autocorrelation effects in a stochastic-process model for decision making via time series
summary: Decision makers exploiting photonic chaotic dynamics obtained by semiconductor lasers provide an ultrafast approach to solving multi-armed bandit problems by using a temporal optical signal as the driving source for sequential decisions. In such systems, the sampling interval of the chaotic waveform shapes the temporal correlation of the resulting time series, and experiments have reported that decision accuracy depends strongly on this autocorrelation property. However, it remains unclear whether the benefit of autocorrelation can be explained by a minimal mathematical model. Here, we analyze a stochastic-process model of the time-series-based decision making using the tug-of-war principle for solving the two-armed bandit problem, where the threshold and a two-valued Markov signal evolve jointly. Numerical results reveal an environment-dependent structure: negative (positive) autocorrelation is optimal in reward-rich (reward-poor) environments. These findings show that negative autocorrelation of the time series is advantageous when the sum of the winning probabilities is more than $1$, whereas positive autocorrelation is useful when the sum of the winning probabilities is less than $1$. Moreover, the performance is independent of autocorrelation if the sum of the winning probabilities equals $1$, which is mathematically clarified. This study paves the way for improving the decision-making scheme for reinforcement learning applications in wireless communications and robotics.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了基于时间序列的决策制定模型，用于解决双臂 bandit 问题，揭示了自相关性与环境特性之间的数学关系。
AI.motivation: 实验中发现混沌波形的采样间隔影响时间序列的自相关性，进而决定决策准确性，但缺乏数学模型解释这一现象。
AI.method: 使用 tug-of-war 原理构建随机过程模型，阈值与二值马尔可夫信号联合演化，通过数值模拟分析自相关性对决策性能的影响。
AI.result: 发现自相关性的最优性取决于环境条件：当 winning probabilities 之和大于1时，负自相关最优；之和小于1时，正自相关最优；之和等于1时，性能与自相关性无关。
AI.conclusion: 研究阐明了自相关性与 bandit 问题性能之间的数学关系，为无线通信和机器人增强学习应用中的决策方案优化提供了理论依据。

title: Knowledge-driven Reasoning for Mobile Agentic AI: Concepts, Approaches, and Directions
summary: Mobile agentic AI is extending autonomous capabilities to resource-constrained platforms such as edge robots and unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), where strict size, weight, power, and cost (SWAP-C) constraints and intermittent wireless connectivity limit both on-device computation and cloud access. Existing approaches mostly optimize per-round communication efficiency, yet mobile agents must sustain competence across a stream of tasks. We propose a knowledge-driven reasoning framework that extracts reusable decision structures from past execution, synchronizes them over bandwidth-limited links, and injects them into on-device reasoning to reduce latency, energy, and error accumulation. A DIKW-inspired taxonomy distinguishes raw observations, episode-scoped traces, and persistent cross-task knowledge, and categorizes knowledge into retrieval, structured, procedural, and parametric representations, each with a distinct tradeoff between reasoning speedup and failure risk. A key finding is that knowledge exposure is non-monotonic: too little forces costly trial-and-error replanning, while too much introduces conflicting cues and errors. A UAV case study validates the framework, where a compact knowledge pack synchronized over intermittent backhaul enables a 3B-parameter onboard model to achieve perfect mission reliability with lower reasoning cost than both knowledge-free on-device reasoning and cloud-centric replanning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向移动智能体（边缘机器人、无人机）的“知识驱动推理”（knowledge-driven reasoning）框架：在SWAP-C约束与间歇无线回传条件下，从历史任务执行中提炼可复用的决策结构（知识包），在带宽受限链路上同步并在端侧推理时按需激活，从而降低延迟、能耗与误差累积。作者基于DIKW的层级分类给出操作化定义，并将知识分为检索型、结构化、程序化、参数型四种表示；核心发现是知识暴露呈非单调性——过少导致试错式重规划，过多则引入冗余与冲突线索、推高推理成本。UAV空中基站案例验证：在间歇回传下，一个紧凑可缓存的知识包使端侧3B模型（Qwen2.5-3B）达到100%任务成功率与零违规，且推理成本低于无知识端侧推理与云端重规划基线。
AI.motivation: 移动智能体从云端向手机、边缘机器人、无人机等资源受限平台迁移，面临严格的体积/重量/功耗/成本（SWAP-C）限制与间歇性无线连接，端侧算力与云端访问同时受限。现有工作（如语义通信）多聚焦于“单轮交互”的通信压缩优化，只优化一次数据交换的带宽效率；但移动自主是序贯过程，智能体需在一连串目标任务中持续保持胜任能力，瓶颈已从一次性传输转向“在累积资源约束下维持长期能力”。反复花费带宽与能量为每个新任务重建任务局部上下文是低效的，因此应识别可跨任务复用的结构并以可摊销成本进行通信。作者因此提出从“数据驱动的信号交换”转向“知识驱动的能力演化”的“知识通信”范式，并将知识同时视为隐式（参数化）与显式（可外化）两类资产。
AI.method:
1）概念层：以DIKW为启发进行时间尺度分离的层级划分——数据（原始逐轮观测）、信息（单回合执行轨迹/中间产物/工具轨迹/任务结果）、上下文（由信息构建的最小工作包，用于单任务内条件化推理）、知识（由累积信息提炼的、可复用且持久的跨任务资产，使其获取与通信成本可被摊销），并给出可分离的知识生命周期：知识提取/晋升（extraction/promotion）、知识通信与同步、利用与激活。

2）推理建模：把智能体推理形式化为“承载成本的轨迹”——由任务输入经一系列中间状态（自然语言推演、结构化计划、可执行程序、工具调用参数、检索证据、校验信号）到达输出；成本三来源：token生成与计算（随中间步数增长，直接影响时延与能耗）、记忆与历史保留（输入窗口与端侧内存受限，过长历史导致截断损害可靠性或反复检索重注入增加通信）、不确定下的分支与回溯（探索/重试/重复校验）。

3）四类知识表示及各自轨迹调制机制：检索型（实例级记录，向量/语义检索，直接复用，轨迹塌缩最激进，但覆盖受限、精度敏感，易被弱对齐证据锚定）；结构化（算子树/方程/图/约束网络，编码任务类的组成结构，用于早剪枝、稳定中间承诺，但不指定完整执行路径）；程序化（可执行流程/宏/控制流模板，规定“下一步做什么”，实现确定性执行的轨迹压缩，成本可预算、易校验，但瓶颈从推导转为选择，选错或在不兼容假设下执行会产生貌似正确的错误）；参数型（预训练/微调中的隐式分布表示，如深展开网络DetNet、信道预测/调度策略，输入落在学习支撑集内时可低时延推理，但分布漂移下脆弱、缺乏可验证/审计/回滚的中间锚点）。四者常协同形成“协调栈”：先快速参数化假设→检索对齐实例→结构化外化任务组成与可行操作→程序化确定执行。

4）知识包与通信耦合：在无线原生部署中，激活控制与链路可用性/信道质量耦合，知识必须先经间歇且容量受限的回传同步才能在端侧被使用；因此提出“相关性感知激活（relevance-aware activation）”的控制问题，而非最大化知识存储量。

5）案例设计（低空UAV空中基站）：8×8栅格（每格500m），Home位于(4,4)，四个角落用户簇，固定高度100m，接入链路10MHz/30dBm、速率>8Mbps方视为服务成功，回传链路20MHz/33dBm、速率>5Mbps方可在一个决策间隔内传完知识包；含3个静态障碍与1个位于(3,3)的时变禁飞区（NFZ）——其位置板载已知但激活日程只能由历史任务日志推断，故在Home被“晋升”为知识；运行时扰动包括用户簇漂移一格、实测SNR低于预测导致服务顺序与悬停点失效并触发重规划。推理为宏决策（下一个服务簇、悬停点、是否请求知识），由确定性运动模块执行，推理轨迹可解释。知识包含三部分：结构化（NFZ激活规则、障碍列表、回传可行性图、航点-用户簇接入可行性查找表）、检索型（少量成功的参考任务计划：服务顺序、航点序列、达成吞吐）、程序化（serve-and-verify 工作流：接入检查→回传检查→合法性检查→提交或拒绝）。Home用Gemini 2.0 Flash离线抽取与摘要，端侧用Qwen2.5-3B；对照组：Qwen_no_k（同模型无知识）、Gemini_no_k（强隐式先验基线）、home_replan（Home云端重规划，扰动时上链观测摘要、下链更新宏计划，回传中断则闭环断裂、按陈旧计划续航）、DRL_PPO（步级微动作策略，训练20万环境步，仅用于任务完成与约束满足对比）。每方法评估50回合，起始时刻随机化以避免NFZ边界固定，各方法扰动采样一致。知识暴露量K=1..5逐级递增（核心结构约束→加回传可行性图→加程序化工作流与接入查找表→加检索参考计划→全量包及扩展注释）。

6）指标：Reasoning Steps与Reasoning Tokens取自LLM宏推理轨迹（推理步≠无人机移动步）；Violation汇总NFZ违规、障碍碰撞与未达8Mbps的服务失败；同时测量知识同步的一次性回传载荷token数。
AI.result: 1）DRL_PPO成功率0.884但违规率0.188，步级控制可完成任务但在潜在时变约束与无线可行性下仍脆弱；2）Qwen_no_k可靠性更低、违规更高，推理轨迹冗长（试错式重规划）；3）Qwen_with_k达到完美可靠性、零违规，同时推理步数与每步token均下降，验证结构化查找与程序化校验早剪枝、检索参考减少搜索分支；4）Gemini_no_k可靠性优于Qwen_no_k（更强隐式先验部分补偿显式结构缺失），但推理步数与每步token显著更高，说明参数化知识有效但可控性与成本效率不如显式晋升知识；5）home_replan虽用更强模型，但可靠性低于带缓存知识的端侧推理——回传中断恰好在最需要修复时打断闭环，显示与算力正交的无线限制；6）知识暴露量扫描确认非单调：中等暴露K=3时推理步数最少、每步token最低，K过小缺失关键约束与参考计划导致搜索型重规划，K过大冗余/弱对齐条目引发调和开销与更多分支；无线权衡上，同步载荷由K=1的125 token升至K=5的1,234 token，仍小于home_replan每次扰动所需的1,870 token闭环交换，且知识包可缓存、其同步成本可跨后续所有重规划回合摊销，而云端重规划每次扰动都要重复付出上下行成本。
AI.conclusion: 知识驱动推理应被视为移动智能体的一等设计原则：以DIKW启发的层级明确数据/信息/上下文/知识的角色与生命周期，四种知识表示（检索、结构化、程序化、参数）分别以不同方式重塑推理轨迹的长度、分支、可验证性与成本可预算性；关键结论是知识暴露非单调，适度且对齐的激活才能同时最优推理成本与可靠性，过少与过多均会劣化效率与可靠性。因此系统核心问题不是知识存储量，而是相关性感知的激活控制，并需与通信感知的知识打包协同。UAV空中基站案例表明，显式、可缓存、经间歇回传同步的知识在可靠性与效率两方面均优于无知识的端侧推理与云端重规划。后续方向包括：联合优化知识选择与无线资源分配的自适应激活门控，以及从增量任务经验中在线进行知识晋升。

title: When Specifications Meet Reality: Uncovering API Inconsistencies in Ethereum Infrastructure
summary: The Ethereum ecosystem, which secures over $381 billion in assets, fundamentally relies on client APIs as the sole interface between users and the blockchain. However, these critical APIs suffer from widespread implementation inconsistencies, which can lead to financial discrepancies, degraded user experiences, and threats to network reliability. Despite this criticality, existing testing approaches remain manual and incomplete: they require extensive domain expertise, struggle to keep pace with Ethereum's rapid evolution, and fail to distinguish genuine bugs from acceptable implementation variations. We present APIDiffer, the first specification-guided differential testing framework designed to automatically detect API inconsistencies across Ethereum's diverse client ecosystem. APIDiffer transforms API specifications into comprehensive test suites through two key innovations: (1) specification-guided test input generation that creates both syntactically valid and invalid requests enriched with real-time blockchain data, and (2) specification-aware false positive filtering that leverages large language models to distinguish genuine bugs from acceptable variations. Our evaluation across all 11 major Ethereum clients reveals the pervasiveness of API bugs in production systems. APIDiffer uncovered 72 bugs, with 90.28% already confirmed or fixed by developers. Beyond these raw numbers, APIDiffer achieves up to 89.67% higher code coverage than existing tools and reduces false positive rates by 37.38%. The Ethereum community's response validates our impact: developers have integrated our test cases, expressed interest in adopting our methodology, and escalated one bug to the official Ethereum Project Management meeting.

AI.tldr: APIDiffer is a specification-guided differential testing framework that automatically detects API inconsistencies across Ethereum's diverse client ecosystem. It uses LLM-based false positive filtering and real-time blockchain data to generate test inputs, uncovering 72 bugs (90.28% confirmed/fixed) across 11 major clients with significantly improved coverage and reduced false positives.
AI.motivation: The Ethereum ecosystem secures over $381 billion in assets and relies on client APIs as the sole interface. However, these APIs suffer from widespread implementation inconsistencies leading to financial discrepancies, degraded user experiences, and threats to network reliability. Existing testing approaches are manual, require extensive domain expertise, struggle to keep pace with rapid evolution, and cannot distinguish bugs from acceptable variations.
AI.method: APIDiffer uses two key innovations: (1) specification-guided test input generation that creates syntactically valid/invalid requests enriched with real-time blockchain data, and (2) specification-aware false positive filtering using large language models to distinguish genuine bugs from acceptable variations.
AI.result: APIDiffer uncovered 72 bugs across all 11 major Ethereum clients, with 90.28% already confirmed or fixed. It achieves up to 89.67% higher code coverage than existing tools and reduces false positive rates by 37.38%. Developers have integrated test cases and expressed interest in adopting the methodology.
AI.conclusion: APIDiffer is the first specification-guided differential testing framework for detecting API inconsistencies across Ethereum clients. It uncovered 72 bugs (90.28% confirmed/fixed), achieves up to 89.67% higher code coverage, and reduces false positive rates by 37.38%. The framework has been adopted by developers and one bug was escalated to the official Ethereum Project Management meeting.

title: DeepFact: Co-Evolving Benchmarks and Agents for Deep Research Factuality
summary: Search-augmented LLM agents can produce deep research reports (DRRs), but verifying claim-level factuality remains challenging. Existing fact-checkers are primarily designed for general-domain, factoid-style atomic claims, and there is no benchmark to test whether such verifiers transfer to DRRs. Yet building such a benchmark is itself difficult. We first show that static expert-labeled benchmarks are brittle in this setting: in a controlled study with PhD-level specialists, unassisted experts achieve only 60.8% accuracy on a hidden micro-gold set of verifiable claims. We propose Evolving Benchmarking via Audit-then-Score (AtS), where benchmark labels and rationales are explicitly revisable: when a verifier disagrees with the current benchmark, it must submit evidence; an auditor adjudicates the dispute; and accepted revisions update the benchmark before models are scored. Across four AtS rounds, expert micro-gold accuracy rises to 90.9%, indicating experts are substantially more reliable as auditors than as one-shot labelers. We instantiate AtS as DeepFact-Bench, a versioned DRR factuality benchmark with auditable rationales, and DeepFact-Eval, a document-level verification agent (with a grouped lite variant) that outperforms existing verifiers on DeepFact-Bench and transfers well to external factuality datasets.

AI.tldr: 解决深度研究报告(DRR)中声明级事实性验证难题，提出审计然后评分(AtS)方法，通过证据提交和仲裁更新基准标签，使专家准确率从60.8%提升至90.9%，构建了DeepFact-Bench基准和DeepFact-Eval验证器。
AI.motivation: Search-augmented LLM agents can produce deep research reports (DRRs), but verifying claim-level factuality remains challenging. Existing fact-checkers are designed for general-domain factoid-style atomic claims and there is no benchmark to test transferability to DRRs. Building such a benchmark is difficult - controlled study showed unassisted PhD-level experts only achieve 60.8% accuracy on hidden micro-gold set.
AI.method: Proposed Audit-then-Score (AtS) methodology: when verifier disagrees with benchmark, submit evidence; human auditor adjudicates dispute; accepted revisions update benchmark before scoring. Implemented as versioned benchmark (DeepFact-Bench) with auditable rationales and document-level verification agent (DeepFact-Eval with grouped lite variant).
AI.result: Across four AtS rounds, expert micro-gold accuracy rises from 60.8% to 90.9%. DeepFact-Eval outperforms existing verifiers on DeepFact-Bench and transfers well to external factuality datasets.
AI.conclusion: Evidenced-based benchmark revision (AtS) substantially improves expert reliability from 60.8% to 90.9% accuracy, and the resulting DeepFact-Bench with DeepFact-Eval verifier achieves strong performance on both the new benchmark and external datasets, demonstrating effective transfer to DRR factuality verification.

title: Towards Efficient and Stable Ocean State Forecasting: A Continuous-Time Koopman Approach
summary: We investigate the Continuous-Time Koopman Autoencoder (CT-KAE) as a lightweight surrogate model for long-horizon ocean state forecasting in a two-layer quasi-geostrophic (QG) system. By projecting nonlinear dynamics into a latent space governed by a linear ordinary differential equation, the model enforces structured and interpretable temporal evolution while enabling temporally resolution-invariant forecasting via a matrix exponential formulation. Across 2083-day rollouts, CT-KAE exhibits bounded error growth and stable large-scale statistics, in contrast to autoregressive Transformer baselines which exhibit gradual error amplification and energy drift over long rollouts. While fine-scale turbulent structures are partially dissipated, bulk energy spectra, enstrophy evolution, and autocorrelation structure remain consistent over long horizons. The model achieves orders-of-magnitude faster inference compared to the numerical solver, suggesting that continuous-time Koopman surrogates offer a promising backbone for efficient and stable hybrid physical-machine learning climate models.

AI.tldr: 本文将连续时间 Koopman 自编码器（CT-KAE）用作两层准地转（QG）海洋系统的轻量级代理模型，在潜空间用线性 ODE（矩阵指数）推进预测。结果显示：2083 天（约 1 万步）无再初始化的长程滚动中，CT-KAE 误差增长率为负（λ=-0.0267）、动能/涡度漂移为受控负值（-49.4%/-34.6%），而自回归 ViT 基线误差指数放大（λ=0.0217）、能量正漂移（+23.3%/+37.0%）；同时推理比伪谱求解器快约 300 倍，并具备时间分辨率不变性。
AI.motivation: 海洋预报依赖计算昂贵的 GCM，限制大规模集合模拟；数据驱动的大型自回归模型（Pathak 等、Bi 等）短期精度高但在长程滚动中误差累积、能量漂移导致不稳定。作者希望不追求短期逐点精度，而是以长程动力学一致性（误差有界、统计不变量守恒）为核心问题：显式线性潜空间结构能否在保证计算效率的同时带来稳定性。为此引入 Koopman 理论作为物理结构化的替代路线——用显式算子结构替代隐式不稳定性，使模型逼近系统的不变测度而非单条轨迹。
AI.method: 物理基础：两层 QG 方程，以位涡 q_m 为预报变量，通过 q 与流函数 ψ 的关系反演流速，含 Jacobian 平流、β 效应、背景位涡梯度、背景纬向流及小尺度耗散（下层含 Ekman 底摩擦）；数据由伪谱求解器以 3600 s 步长积分 40000 天达到湍流定常态，降采样至 64×64、时间步 Δt=5 h。模型：CT-KAE 含双流编码器（同时输入 x_t 与 x_{t-1}，残差预激活块 + 谱归一化 + CBAM 注意力）、线性连续时间潜模块 dz/dt=Kz（K 分解为斜对称振荡部分与对称耗散部分）、CNN 解码器（pixel-shuffle 上采样 + 坐标注入）；训练用 RK4 积分，推理用矩阵指数 z(t+τ)=exp(Kτ)z(t)，计算成本仅随潜维度 d 缩放。损失：重构 + 预测（梯度加权掩码）+ 潜空间协方差白化/特征值排斥正则 + Sobolev 与 FFT 谱损失。基线：12 层、128 维、8 头的自回归 ViT（8×8 patch），相同数据划分与优化器（AdamW, lr 2e-4, bs 32）。训练仅用 10 步短滚动片段，不做长程优化，长程稳定性完全由结构涌现。
AI.result: RMSE：CT-KAE 0.938±0.031 略优于 ViT 0.993±0.033；2083 天时两者 ACC 均近零（0.033/0.004），因 QG 去相关时间尺度仅 O(10) 天，确定性轨迹对齐已失去意义，故改用统计不变量评估。误差增长率 λ：ViT +0.0217（指数放大），CT-KAE -0.0267（有界收缩）。能量漂移：CT-KAE 动能 -49.4%、涡度 -34.6%（受控耗散，高波数湍流结构部分耗散），ViT 动能 +23.3%、涡度 +37.0%（非物理增长）。KE 谱保持低波数主体能量、无虚假放大；MSE 在 1 万步内保持有界；时间自相关保留大尺度持续性结构。效率：RTX 4090 上亚毫秒/步，约比伪谱求解器快 300 倍。分辨率不变性：在 Δt=5 h 训练后在 1 h 与 10 h 评估无需重训，RMSE 稳定。所学习 Koopman 算子特征值大多位于左半平面（耗散模态），少数近虚轴（振荡模态），无正实部特征值，为长程有界性提供结构证据。
AI.conclusion: 显式线性算子结构的连续时间 Koopman 代理模型可在极低计算成本下实现混沌海洋流的长程稳定模拟：误差增长有界、主体物理统计量（动能谱、涡度、时间自相关）得以保持，优于自回归 Transformer 的渐近漂移，并兼具时间分辨率不变性与高效性。论文同时指出局限：细尺度湍流结构被部分耗散（高波数衰减），潜算子谱虽全位于左半平面但并不构成解码动力学的严格稳定性证明，VQ/ViT 基线本身在 1 万步内仍数值稳定并具竞争力。作者认为连续时间 Koopman 代理可作为可扩展物理—机器学习气候模型的骨干，未来方向包括在保持稳定性的同时恢复高频湍流细节。

title: Domain-Adaptive Model Merging across Disconnected Modes
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables; Accepted by ICASSP 2026
summary: Learning across domains is challenging when data cannot be centralized due to privacy or heterogeneity, which limits the ability to train a single comprehensive model. Model merging provides an appealing alternative by consolidating knowledge from multiple specialized models into one, avoiding data sharing and reducing retraining cost. In this work, we present DMM, a data-free model merging framework designed to handle highly divergent models. DMM proceeds in three steps. First, domain-specific models are trained independently. Second, models with high similarity are merged using standard techniques to ensure stability. Third, we synthesize pseudo-data from normalization statistics and distill knowledge from divergent models into the merged model through a lightweight refinement guided by these samples. This approach preserves rare but critical knowledge while maintaining stability. Extensive experiments on unimodal and multimodal benchmarks show that DMM achieves state-of-the-art performance over existing merging methods.

AI.tldr: DMM是一个数据无关的模型合并框架，通过三步处理高度分歧的模型：独立训练领域特定模型、合并高相似度模型、通过归一化统计合成的伪数据和蒸馏知识进行轻量级细化，在单模态和多模态基准测试上达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 跨领域学习面临数据无法集中（因隐私或异构性）的挑战，限制了单一综合模型的训练能力。模型合并提供了一个有吸引力的替代方案，可以在避免数据共享和降低重训练成本的同时整合多个专业模型的知识。
AI.method: DMM采用三步框架：1）独立训练领域特定模型；2）使用标准技术合并高相似度模型以确保稳定性；3）从归一化统计合成伪数据，并将分歧模型的知识蒸馏到合并模型中，通过这些样本引导的轻量级细化来保留稀有但关键的知识。
AI.result: 在单模态和多模态基准测试上的广泛实验表明，DMM实现了比现有合并方法更好的性能。
AI.conclusion: DMM方法能够在保持稳定性的同时保留稀有但关键的知识，为处理高度分歧模型的合并问题提供了有效解决方案。

title: Detecting Semantic Alignments between Textual Specifications and Domain Models
summary: Context: Having domain models derived from textual specifications has proven to be very useful in the early phases of software engineering. However, creating correct domain models and establishing clear links with the textual specification is a challenging task, especially for novice modelers. Objectives: We propose an approach for determining the alignment between a partial domain model and a textual specification. Methods: To this aim, we use Natural Language Processing techniques to pre-process the text, generate an artificial natural language specification for each model element, and then use an LLM to compare the generated description with matched sentences from the original specification. Ultimately, our algorithm classifies each model element as either aligned (i.e., correct), misaligned (i.e., incorrect), or unclassified (i.e., insufficient evidence). Furthermore, it outputs the related sentences from the textual specification that provide the evidence for the determined class. Results: We have evaluated our approach on a set of examples from the literature containing diverse domains, each consisting of a textual specification and a reference domain model, as well as on models containing modeling errors that were systematically derived from the correct models through mutation. Our results show that we are able to identify alignments and misalignments with a precision close to 1 and a recall of approximately 78%, with execution times ranging from 18 seconds to 1 minute per model element. Conclusion: Since our algorithm almost never classifies model elements incorrectly, and is able to classify over 3/4 of the model elements, it could be integrated into a modeling tool to provide positive feedback or generate warnings, or employed for offline validation and quality assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种利用自然语言处理和大型语言模型确定部分领域模型与文本规范之间对齐关系的方法，将模型元素分类为对齐、错位或未分类，并在文献数据集和突变模型上进行评估，精确率接近1，召回率约78%。
AI.motivation: 在软件工程早期阶段，从文本规范派生领域模型很有价值，但创建正确的领域模型并建立与文本规范的清晰链接具有挑战性，尤其是对新手建模者而言。
AI.method: 使用NLP技术预处理文本，为每个模型元素生成人工自然语言规范，然后使用LLM将生成的描述与原始规范中的匹配句子进行比较，最终将每个模型元素分类为对齐（正确）、错位（不正确）或未分类（证据不足），并输出作为证据的相关句子。
AI.result: 在来自文献的多领域文本规范和参考领域模型示例集，以及通过突变系统生成的包含建模错误的模型上进行评估。精确率接近1，召回率约78%，每个模型元素执行时间18秒至1分钟。
AI.conclusion: 由于算法几乎不会错误分类模型元素，且能分类超过四分之三的元素，可集成到建模工具中提供正向反馈或生成警告，也可用于离线验证和质量评估。

title: An Interactive Multi-Agent System for Evaluation of New Product Concepts
comment: 46 pages, 3 figures + This paper proposes an LLM-based multi-agent system (MAS) for automated evaluation of new product concepts, incorporating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and cross-functional virtual agents to assess technical and market feasibility
summary: Product concept evaluation is a critical stage that determines strategic resource allocation and project success in enterprises. However, traditional expert-led approaches face limitations such as subjective bias and high time and cost requirements. To support this process, this study proposes an automated approach utilizing a large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent system (MAS). Through a systematic analysis of previous research on product development and team collaboration, this study established two primary evaluation dimensions, namely technical feasibility and market feasibility. The proposed system consists of a team of eight virtual agents representing specialized domains such as R&D and marketing. These agents use retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and real-time search tools to gather objective evidence and validate concepts through structured deliberations based on the established criteria. The agents were further fine-tuned using professional product review data to enhance their judgment accuracy. A case study involving professional display monitor concepts demonstrated that the system's evaluation rankings were consistent with those of senior industry experts. These results confirm the usability of the proposed multi-agent-based evaluation approach for supporting product development decisions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于大型语言模型(LLM)的多智能体系统(MAS)用于产品概念评估，解决传统专家主导方法的主观偏见和高成本问题。系统包含8个虚拟智能体（研发、营销等），使用RAG和实时搜索工具，基于技术可行性和市场可行性两个维度进行结构化评估。
AI.motivation: 产品概念评估是企业关键阶段，决定战略资源分配和项目成功。传统专家主导方法存在主观偏见和高时间成本局限性，需要自动化、客观的评估方法支持决策。
AI.method: 建立两个评估维度（技术可行性和市场可行性）；构建8个虚拟智能体团队（代表研发、营销等专业领域）；使用检索增强生成(RAG)和实时搜索工具收集客观证据；基于专业产品评论数据微调智能体以提高判断准确性；通过结构化讨论验证概念。
AI.result: 专业显示器概念评估案例研究表明，系统评估排名与资深行业专家的评估结果一致，证实了多智能体评估方法的可用性。
AI.conclusion: 基于LLM的多智能体系统可有效支持产品概念评估，具有与专家评估的一致性，为产品开发决策提供可行的人工智能辅助方案。

title: When AI Levels the Playing Field: Skill Homogenization, Asset Concentration, and Two Regimes of Inequality
summary: Generative AI compresses within-task skill differences while shifting economic value toward concentrated complementary assets, creating an apparent paradox: the technology that equalizes individual performance may widen aggregate inequality. We formalize this tension in a task-based model with endogenous education, employer screening, and heterogeneous firms. The model yields two regimes whose boundary depends on AI's technology structure (proprietary vs.\ commodity) and labor market institutions (rent-sharing elasticity, asset concentration). A scenario analysis via Method of Simulated Moments, matching six empirical targets, disciplines the model's quantitative magnitudes; a sensitivity decomposition reveals that the five non-$Δ$Gini moments identify mechanism rates but not the aggregate sign, which at the calibrated parameters is pinned by $m_6$ and $ξ$, while AI's technology structure ($η_1$ vs.\ $η_0$) independently crosses the boundary. The contribution is the mechanism -- not a verdict on the sign. Occupation-level regressions using BLS OEWS data (2019--2023) illustrate why such data cannot test the model's task-level predictions. The predictions are testable with within-occupation, within-task panel data that do not yet exist at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个任务型（task-based）局部均衡结构模型，将生成式AI"任务层面技能同质化（压缩个体产出差距）"与"市场层面资产集中（扩大企业间不平等）"统一为同一机制的两面，并通过方法矩模拟（MSM）校准后得到一个"刀刃式"（knife-edge）的制度边界条件：AI对总体不平等的方向取决于AI技术结构（专有 vs 商品化，ψ vs η₀）与劳动市场制度（租金分享弹性ξ、资产集中度Gini(K)）的交互。作者明确声明贡献在于机制而非符号判定：模型未识别总量不平等的最终方向，且机制链中无任何因果环节被经验识别。
AI.motivation: 经验观察呈现明显悖论：在任务层面，生成式AI显著压缩能力差距——Brynjolfsson et al.(2024)客服实验中新手解决率提升35%而顶尖者近乎为零，Noy & Zhang(2023)写作质量分布压缩约40%，Peng et al.(2023)Copilot用户效率提升56%且新手获益更大；但在市场层面，AI投资与利润高度集中于少数拥有数据、算力与组织资本的企业（Babina et al. 2024；Autor et al. 2020；Zolas et al. 2024），企业间工资离散度——美国收入不平等上升的主要来源（Song et al. 2019）——并未逆转，劳动收入份额持续下降。作者的核心问题是：这两类看似矛盾的观察能否被同一机制解释？既有文献要么研究AI的微观平等化效应（Brynjolfsson等），要么研究任务型框架与超级明星 firms（Acemoglu & Autor；Autor et al. 2020），但缺乏一个把"任务层同质化"与"资产集中"联结起来的统一结构框架，也没有对"AI到底缩小还是扩大总体不平等"给出可操作的边界条件。作者也承认现实反例：Dell'Acqua et al.(2023)发现AI在能力边界之外对高能力者更有利（乘法模式），以及聚合层面职业内任务构成异质性带来的测量错配问题。
AI.method: 四阶段任务型局部均衡模型：(1) 生产环境——CES任务聚合（弹性σ），能力异质性θ，教育e经h=θg(e)转化，AI为加性augmentation y_i=h_iφ(z)+α(z)A_t（"草稿—编辑"微基础），任务集S(A_t)随AI扩张；(2) 技能同质化Prop.1：CV对A_t严格递减（方差不变、均值上升），Prop.2给出部分乘法下同质化存续条件；(3) 教育收益Prop.3：σ>1时AI可替代任务价格下降→编码型认知技能教育回报下降，σ<1时反之，AI不可替代的社会/组织/判断技能回报上升；(4) 筛选与文凭通胀Prop.4：以"诊断方差"V_D与信号可靠性ρ刻画AI削弱绩效信号→后验向文凭倾斜→Spence分离阈值θ̂下降；(5) 集中渠道Prop.5与Lemma 1：企业生产Y=K^{η(A)}A^{γ_A}L^{γ_L}，η'(A)>0当且仅当专有AI资本密集度ψ>η₀（商品化时ψ<η₀则渠道反转）；最优利润∝K^{η/(1-γ_L)}，自我强化需η/(1-γ_L)>1（当前0.72）；AKM式工人—企业匹配给出Var(w)=Var(ψ_j)+Var(θ_j h_i)+2Cov(ψ_j,θ_j h_i)三项符号分解；经验证：MSM（6个矩匹配5参数，差分进化+Nelder-Mead，Hansen J=0.036, p=0.849），1000次bootstrap与增广bootstrap（ξ~U[0.07,0.25]），留一法与矩—参数敏感度/边界诊断（链式导数），η₁双源交叉验证（Babina 0.174–0.190；Autor 0.315–0.331），并给出闭式刀刃条件式(12)；实证侧用BLS OEWS 2019/2023×Felten et al.(2021) AIOE（635个6位SOC职业）做职业层面水平与一阶差分回归，说明为何现有数据无法检验任务层预测。
AI.result: 校准结果：α/(φμ_h)=0.526(SE 0.096)、σ=1.166(SE 1.639，t=0.71，弱识别，CI跨过1)、η₀=0.142(0.058)、η₁=0.323(0.035)、Gini(K₀)=0.909(0.132)；六矩拟合良好，J=0.036(p=0.849)未被拒绝。派生量：ΔGini=+0.0050（接近零、处于刀刃边界），CV比=0.792（职业内工资离散压缩21%，稳健，CI[0.729,0.849]），利润弹性由0.316升至0.718（+127%但未越过自我强化阈值）。渠道速率：集中渠道0.018/单位A_t > 同质化渠道0.012/单位A_t。敏感度分解核心发现：五个非ΔGini矩对总量符号几乎零影响（各自识别渠道速率但效应相互抵消），符号由m₆与ξ锁定；结构上η₁（弹性+9.2）与Gini(K)（+18.7）影响大于ξ（+7.5），说明AI技术结构是独立杠杆。制度情景：ξ在0.07–0.25区间内ΔGini从−0.012到+0.015，零点在ξ≈0.17；行业情景中科技/AI平台+0.0218、教育/政府−0.0258、北欧式−0.0104；η₁<η₀（商品化AI）时ΔGini无条件为负（−0.019至−0.014），仅η₁≈0.29起才转正。Prop.6给出稳健单调性：∂(ΔGini)/∂Gini(K)>0 无条件成立。留一法（去掉m₆）得ΔGini=−0.009（仍近边界且在bootstrap CI内）。OEWS回归：横截面AIOE系数+0.109（加中位工资与22个大类固定效应后降至+0.034，R² 0.21→0.52，说明composition效应主导）；一阶差分+0.017显著，但加入大类固定效应后+0.010不显著；635个职业平均Δlog(p90/p10)=−0.102即总体离散度压缩10.2%，但与AI暴露在控制后不相关。作者据此论证职业层面数据存在测量错配（AIOE衡量暴露潜力而非实际采用、4年窗口过短）。证据地图显示链节1（技能压缩）与链节4（市场集中）证据强，链节2–3（教育回报、文凭通胀）仅为提示性/无直接检验，链节3为最弱环节。
AI.conclusion: 结论是条件性的、非单一方向的：AI在可替代任务上压缩技能差距，但总体不平等的方向由AI供给结构（专有ψ>η₀→集中；商品化ψ<η₀→平等化）与劳动市场制度（ξ、Gini(K)）共同决定，二者均为独立杠杆，任一单独变动即可跨越边界。作者反复强调贡献是"机制而非判决"：模型未识别总不平等的符号，也未在经验上识别机制链中任何因果环节；关于教育的Prop.3需条件σ>1（校准未能确立）；Prop.5的自我强化集中属"水平效应"而非爆炸动态，属10–20年视野下的风险而非当前现实；市场结构若静态化则不能反映动态竞争。政策含义限于方向性：降低AI互补资产集中度、推动开源扩散以降低ψ、抑制AI能力等杠杆各自作用于不同渠道，但因缺乏一般均衡（进入、创新激励、动态市场结构）分析，不构成福利评价后的政策建议。可检验性方面，提出六项可检验预测（H1–H6）与三类识别设计（OEWS/CPS职业面板DiD与交错处理估计、LEHD/LODES匹配雇主—雇员数据做AKM分解、Lightcast职位发布数据DiD以ChatGPT发布为工具变量），并坦承检验任务层预测所需的"职业内×任务内"面板数据目前尚不存在。总体而言，这是一个经过精心校准、诚实标注不确定性的理论—场景分析文献，其价值在于把"AI平等化 vs 集中化"的争论操作化为可测参数上的可证伪边界条件。

title: Edge Intelligence-Driven LegalEdge Contracts for EV Charging Stations: A Fedrated Learning with Deep Q-Networks Approach
summary: We introduce LegalEdge, an edge intelligence-driven framework that integrates Federated Learning (FL) and Deep Q-Networks (DQN) to optimize electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure. LegalEdge contracts are novel smart contracts deployed on the blockchain to manage dynamic pricing and incentive mechanisms transparently and autonomously. By leveraging FL, multiple edge devices such as EV charging stations collaboratively train DQN agents without sharing raw data, preserving user privacy while reducing communication costs. These edge-deployed agents learn optimal charging strategies in real time based on local conditions and global policy updates. LegalEdge ensures low-latency decisions, high contract integrity, and efficient energy allocation. Our experimental results demonstrate significant improvements in learning convergence, transaction speed, and operational transparency, establishing LegalEdge as a scalable, intelligent, and accountable solution for next-generation EV charging networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LegalEdge 框架，将联邦学习（FL）、深度 Q 网络（DQN）与区块链智能合约三者结合，用于优化电动汽车（EV）充电基础设施的动态定价与激励机制：多个边缘充电站设备在不共享原始数据的前提下协同训练 DQN 智能体，智能合约负责在链上透明、自主地执行定价与激励规则，从而实现低时延决策、高合约完整性与高效能量分配，实验显示在收敛速度、交易速度与运营透明度上均有显著提升。
AI.motivation: EV 充电网络面临多重挑战：(1) 充电需求在时间与空间上高度动态，静态定价或集中式调度易造成局部过载与能源分配失衡；(2) 集中式训练需要汇聚大量用户充电数据，带来严重的隐私泄露风险，且原始数据传输与模型更新通信开销高；(3) 动态定价与激励机制的制定涉及运营商、聚合商与车主等多方利益，需要透明、可审计且防篡改的规则执行环境；(4) 传统云端集中推理时延高，难以满足充电调度与实时响应的要求。作者因此寻求一种把"边缘侧实时智能决策 + 隐私保护协同学习 + 可信自治的合约执行"三者统一起来的方案。
AI.method: 整体采用"边缘智能 + 分布式学习 + 链上治理"的分层耦合架构。（1）边缘节点部署 DQN 智能体：每个 EV 充电站作为边缘设备，基于本地观测状态（本地负载、充电需求、电价反馈、排队情况等）独立进行动作选择与环境交互，使用深度 Q 网络逼近 Q 值以学习最优充电与功率分配策略，通过经验回放与目标网络更新完成本地学习，保证低时延的本地决策。（2）联邦学习层：各边缘智能体仅上传加密/聚合后的梯度或模型参数至服务器进行全局聚合（FedAvg 类策略），原始用户充电数据始终保留在本地，兼顾隐私性与通信成本；全局策略再回传至各节点，形成"本地自适应 + 全局策略校正"的协同机制。（3）区块链与 LegalEdge 智能合约层：以智能合约编码动态定价公式、激励与惩罚规则、结算逻辑以及模型更新/聚合的验证逻辑，链上记录保证合约完整性与不可篡改性，透明记录价格调整、能量分配与激励发放过程，形成可审计的运营透明度；去中心化账本还降低了单点故障与对第三方的信任依赖。（4）系统实现上，将合约调用嵌入边缘侧策略执行与结算流程，使智能体学习到的策略在满足合约约束（如价格边界、可用功率上限、合约状态机）的前提下生效，实现学习与合约的相互约束。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，相对基线方法，LegalEdge 在学习收敛速度上显著加快（联邦协同 + 经验共享使 Q 值估计更稳定、样本效率更高），交易速度（智能合约执行与结算的吞吐/时延）明显改善，运营透明度与合约完整性得到提升（链上可追溯的定价与激励记录）。作者认为该方案能在保护用户隐私、降低通信开销的同时实现高效能量分配与低时延决策，为下一代 EV 充电网络提供了可扩展、智能且可问责的技术路径。
AI.conclusion: LegalEdge 通过将联邦学习与 DQN 的边缘协同智能同区块链智能合约的透明自治机制深度融合，验证了"分布式边缘智能 + 可信合约治理"用于 EV 充电基础设施优化的可行性：既保障了充电用户数据不出域并削减了通信开销，又实现了实时最优的充电策略与动态定价，同时借助链上记录提升了交易效率与运营问责性。论文主张该框架可扩展至大规模充电网络与更复杂的城市能源场景；后续可延伸的方向包括合约安全性与形式化验证、激励机制与策略学习的联合优化、以及在真实车网互动（V2G）与更异构边缘节点下的鲁棒性与可扩展性评估。

title: Pre-AI Baseline: Developer IDE Satisfaction and Tool Autonomy in 2022
comment: 21 pages, 5 figures. Preprint version submitted to PeerJ Computer Science; supplementary material included in the source bundle
summary: To quantify the impact of AI on software development, the community requires a robust pre-AI baseline. This study analyzes valid satisfaction data from 1,155 software developers collected in July 2022, immediately preceding the mainstream adoption of generative AI tools. We report a high-satisfaction ecosystem (Mean = 8.14 [95% CI 8.01-8.25]), dominated by Visual Studio Code (79% usage). Multivariable regression confirms that autonomy in tool choice is the strongest predictor of IDE satisfaction (beta = 0.51), significantly outweighing demographic or role-based factors. Conversely, cloud IDE adoption was negligible (4.3% regular usage), with 40.1% citing network dependency as the primary barrier, a constraint that remains relevant for modern cloud-reliant AI agents. Additionally, we identify an "experimenter" segment (29.9%) characterized by high tool churn but no significant satisfaction difference (t = 0.43, p = 0.67), and demonstrate significant variation in IDE retention rates (VS Code: 68.5%, traditional IDEs: 3.9-25%), suggesting underlying dissatisfaction despite high overall satisfaction. By providing a quantitative snapshot of developer sentiment and workflows on the eve of the AI revolution, this study establishes a verifiable baseline for longitudinal research into the productivity-satisfaction misalignment observed in the post-AI era.

AI.tldr: 本文基于2022年7月（ChatGPT发布前4个月）针对1,155名开发者的横截面在线调查，量化了生成式AI主流化之前的开发者IDE满意度基线：平均满意度8.14/10（NPS 34.7），VS Code占据79.0%使用率；多变量回归显示“工具选择自主权”是最强预测因子（β=0.51, p<0.001），云IDE常规使用率仅4.3%（网络依赖为首要障碍，40.1%）；并识别出“实验者”群体（29.9%，技术使用更多但满意度无差异）与显著分化的IDE留存率（VS Code 68.5% vs 传统IDE 3.9–25%），为纵向研究AI对生产力—满意度错位的影响提供了可核验的基线。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI编码工具（ChatGPT、GitHub Copilot、AI集成IDE）在2022年底后迅速重塑开发工作流，但社区此前缺乏可核验的“前AI”基线，导致AI对开发者生产力、满意度与工具选择影响的量化归因困难。同时，工具选择自主权（autonomy）对满意度的影响多停留在轶事层面，云IDE的采纳模式与障碍缺少系统性数据，专业经验与工具满意度的关系也未被严谨测量。此外，传统的满意度/NPS指标会掩盖工具留存与流失风险，需引入留存率指标刻画忠诚度与市场动态。理论上依托SPACE框架（Forsgren et al., 2022）、DevEx框架（Noda et al., 2023）、自我决定理论（SDT）与TAM/UTAUT及兼容性（compatibility）构念。
AI.method: 研究设计：2022年7月1–31日在线横截面调查（Typeform实现），主要通过Codeanywhere新闻简报分发并在开发者论坛、Twitter、LinkedIn交叉发布；问卷45题（人口学、经验、IDE使用与满意度、工具自主权、云IDE认知与使用、技术偏好与实验行为），经15人预测试与5人认知访谈修订，全过程知情同意。样本：1,173份完整回答，剔除关键变量缺失18份后满意度分析样本n=1,155，覆盖52国；平均年龄31.2岁（SD=8.4），平均编码经验9.7年（SD=7.2）；76.3%本科及以上；85.1%至少部分远程。分析方法：Python（pandas/numpy/scipy/statsmodels）完成描述统计、t检验、单因素与ANOVA、ANOVA后验Bonferroni校正、Benjamini–Hochberg FDR控制，报告均值+95%CI、Cohen's d、η²；多元OLS（稳健标准误，协变量含自主权、经验、角色、组织规模，并扩展至OS、工作模式、语言数、技术广度、痛点等）解释R²=12.2%；有序Logistic回归敏感性分析（自主权OR=1.61, p<0.001）；交互项检验自主权×云IDE用户；VIF多重共线性检验；地区与行业随机截距混合效应模型；NPS采用Rocks (2016) Adjusted Wald AW(3,T)区间并以bootstrap复核；留存率用Clopper–Pearson精确区间（n<50收缩估计，n<30谨慎解读）；供应商渠道偏差鲁棒性分析（Codeanywhere用户n=259 vs 非用户n=914）；CVA（Customer Value Analysis）补充NPS分层分析。关键测量定义：云IDE“常规用户”须“正在使用”且用于全部/大部分工作或在大型项目上使用（4.3%），与行业宽口径区分；“自主权”主条目为“我可以自由选择开发环境与工具”（56.7%认同）；“实验者”由单条目界定并以技术采纳数（5.9 vs 5.2, t=5.38）作行为验证。
AI.result: 1) 满意度基线高：均值8.14（95%CI 8.01–8.25），NPS 34.7（31.0–38.2）；Promoter 50.8%、Passive 33.1%、Detractor 16.1%；VS Code使用率79.0%（vs Stack Overflow 74.48%、IntelliJ 30.1%、Visual Studio 26.3%），与同期生态调查收敛。2) 经验梯度：ANOVA F(4,1151)=12.51, p<0.001, η²=0.040；<1年6.53 vs 20年以上8.41，差1.88分（d=0.43），方差随经验下降（SD 3.19→1.72），提示生存者偏差。3) 自主权为最强预测因子：自由选择者8.44 vs 受限者7.73（t=6.18, p<0.001, d=0.49/0.33），回归中β=0.51（0.24–0.78, p<0.001），经验每增加1年β=0.04；自主权×云IDE交互不显著（β=−0.59, p=0.323），即自主权效应跨群体稳定；低满意度群体自主权率仅39.8% vs 高满意度群体61.2%（差21.4pp）。4) 渠道鲁棒性：经验—满意度相关（r=0.11 vs 0.12）与障碍排序（Spearman ρ=0.61）在Codeanywhere用户与非用户间一致，但自主权效应仅在非用户中显著（+0.92 vs −0.02），提示供应商渠道对自主权测量存在干扰。5) 云IDE采纳处于鸿沟前段：常规4.3%、偶尔16.0%、计划采纳34.2%、无计划44.6%；障碍首位为网络依赖40.1%，其次性能32.4%、安全28.7%、成本24.2%、功能19.3%；感知生产力仅5.90/10；云IDE用户与非用户满意度无差异（0.21, p=0.51），但感知生产力调节效应显著（交互β=0.27, p=0.001）；非Codeanywhere用户中14.6%使用，界定人口采纳率约14.6%–20.3%。6) “实验者”占29.9%，技术使用多13%（t=5.38, p<0.001）而满意度无差异（8.18 vs 8.12, t=0.43, p=0.67, d=0.03），实验倾向随经验上升（22.8%→33.3%）。7) 留存率分化：VS Code 68.5%（n=925）、Vim 62.8%、Neovim 58.6%、IntelliJ 57.9%，而Atom 19.7%、NetBeans 25.0%、Eclipse 31.9%，显示高使用份额不等于高忠诚度。8) 其他：macOS用户8.64、混合/远程8.20–8.27 高于办公室办公7.74；OS与工作模式效应在控制语言数与技术广度后仍存在。注意报告内部存在不一致：摘要与讨论中Eclipse留存记为3.9%，而表8为31.9%；表9“正在使用”20.2%与4.3%常规用户定义并列；表3与表10的自主权率数值存在错配；Cohen's d在0.33/0.49/0.43多处标注不一。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了2022年7月生成式AI普及前夕的可核验开发者工具基线：高满意度但结构性脆弱——VS Code主导（79%）且留存最高（68.5%），传统IDE虽保有中等满意度却面临极高流失风险，意味着工具市场在AI到来前即已"准备好被颠覆"。方法论与实践启示有三：其一，工具选择自主权是IDE满意度的最强预测因子（β=0.51，0.71–0.78分差），组织若强制推行指定IDE或AI助手而无开发者选择权，可能以可测量的士气与留存代价抵消生产力收益；其二，开发者与组织的采纳障碍排序不同（个体侧网络依赖40.1% vs 组织侧安全），云IDE/云端AI代理的推广须先解决离线能力与延迟问题；其三，"实验者"群体（29.9%）虽更快采纳新技术却不更满意，提示新颖性本身不产生体验改善。局限包括便利抽样（Codeanywhere渠道偏差，尤其影响自主权效应）、单一/少条目测量（自主权与实验者构念无法做信度评估）、自陈数据与横截面设计无法建立因果、缺乏任务级产出指标、英文单语与地域覆盖有限。作者建议未来以同方法开展纵向复测，检验自主权—满意度关系在AI时代的持续性、经验差异是否被扩大、experimenter群体是驱动还是抵制AI采纳、以及AI助手能否超越传统IDE的留存水平，并呼吁开发经多条目验证的自主权、认知负荷与心流测量工具。

title: Agentic LLM Planning via Step-Wise PDDL Simulation: An Empirical Characterisation
summary: Task planning, the problem of sequencing actions to reach a goal from an initial state, is a core capability requirement for autonomous robotic systems. Whether large language models (LLMs) can serve as viable planners alongside classical symbolic methods remains an open question. We present PyPDDLEngine, an open-source Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) simulation engine that exposes planning operations as LLM tool calls through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) interface. Rather than committing to a complete action sequence upfront, the LLM acts as an interactive search policy that selects one action at a time, observes each resulting state, and can reset and retry. We evaluate four approaches on 102 International Planning Competition (IPC) Blocksworld instances under a uniform 180-second budget: Fast Downward lama-first and seq-sat-lama-2011 as classical baselines, direct LLM planning (Claude Haiku 4.5), and agentic LLM planning via PyPDDLEngine. Fast Downward achieves 85.3% success. The direct and agentic LLM approaches achieve 63.7% and 66.7%, respectively, a consistent but modest three-percentage-point advantage for the agentic approach at $5.7\times$ higher token cost per solution. Across most co-solved difficulty blocks, both LLM approaches produce shorter plans than seq-sat-lama-2011 despite its iterative quality improvement, a result consistent with training-data recall rather than generalisable planning. These results suggest that agentic gains depend on the nature of environmental feedback. Coding agents benefit from externally grounded signals such as compiler errors and test failures, whereas PDDL step feedback is self-assessed, leaving the agent to evaluate its own progress without external verification.

AI.tldr: PyPDDLEngine enables agentic LLM planning via PDDL simulation with MCP interface. Agentic approach modestly outperforms direct LLM (66.7% vs 63.7%) but at 5.7x cost, achieving lower success than Fast Downward (85.3%) but producing shorter plans. The advantage of agentic planning depends on whether environmental feedback is externally grounded or self-assessed.
AI.motivation: Task planning (sequencing actions to reach a goal from initial state) is a core capability for autonomous robotic systems. The paper investigates whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can serve as viable planners alongside classical symbolic methods.
AI.method: Presents PyPDDLEngine, an open-source PDDL simulation engine that exposes planning operations as LLM tool calls through MCP interface. The LLM acts as an interactive search policy - selecting one action at a time, observing resulting state, and can reset/retry. Evaluates four approaches on 102 IPC Blocksworld instances with 180-second budget: Fast Downward lama-first, seq-sat-lama-2011 (classical baselines), direct LLM planning (Claude Haiku 4.5), and agentic LLM planning via PyPDDLEngine.
AI.result: Fast Downward achieves 85.3% success. Direct LLM achieves 63.7%, agentic LLM achieves 66.7% - a consistent 3-percentage-point advantage for agentic approach at 5.7x higher token cost. Both LLM approaches produce shorter plans than seq-sat-lama-2011 across most difficulty blocks.
AI.conclusion: Agentic gains depend on nature of environmental feedback. Coding agents benefit from externally grounded signals (compiler errors, test failures), whereas PDDL step feedback is self-assessed, leaving the agent to evaluate its own progress without external verification.

title: Aligning the True Semantics: Constrained Decoupling and Distribution Sampling for Cross-Modal Alignment
summary: Cross-modal alignment is a crucial task in multimodal learning aimed at achieving semantic consistency between vision and language. This requires that image-text pairs exhibit similar semantics. Traditional algorithms pursue embedding consistency to achieve semantic consistency, ignoring the non-semantic information present in the embedding. An intuitive approach is to decouple the embeddings into semantic and modality components, aligning only the semantic component. However, this introduces two main challenges: (1) There is no established standard for distinguishing semantic and modal information. (2) The modality gap can cause semantic alignment deviation or information loss. To align the true semantics, we propose a novel cross-modal alignment algorithm via \textbf{C}onstrained \textbf{D}ecoupling and \textbf{D}istribution \textbf{S}ampling (CDDS). Specifically, (1) A dual-path UNet is introduced to adaptively decouple the embeddings, applying multiple constraints to ensure effective separation. (2) A distribution sampling method is proposed to bridge the modality gap, ensuring the rationality of the alignment process. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks and model backbones demonstrate the superiority of CDDS, outperforming state-of-the-art methods by 6.6\% to 14.2\%.

AI.tldr: CDDS（约束解耦+分布采样）通过双路UNet将图文嵌入解耦为语义成分与模态成分，仅对齐语义成分；用KL散度+自适应软阈值稀疏化识别跨模态相关语义分布，再以分布采样构造"x-语义成分"间接对齐，从而避免嵌入一致性带来的语义偏差与模态鸿沟。在Flickr30K、MS-COCO上以ViT/Swin/BERT骨干超过VSE++、SCAN、SGR、CHAN、LAPS等SOTA方法6.6%~14.2%，亦可即插即用于CLIP等模型提升其表现；主要局限是相关性计算需逐批执行、复杂度O(N²)。
AI.motivation: 跨模态对齐的传统做法（对比学习、列级余弦相似度）追求的是"嵌入一致性"而非"语义一致性"，但嵌入中混有图像颜色分布、文本句法结构、训练噪声等模态特有信息，这些信息跨模态本就无法匹配却仍参与对齐计算，会引入语义偏差与错误引导；同时直接用余弦相似度跨模态逐列比较缺乏合理依据，因为不同模态的嵌入构建方式差异大、同一列语义并不同。此外，为对齐而拉伸嵌入会扭曲两模态的原始分布，造成对齐偏差与信息损失。作者因此考虑"先解耦、后只对齐语义成分"的思路，但面临两大挑战：(1) 语义信息与模态信息如何区分缺乏既定标准，耦合关系复杂；(2) 模态鸿沟（modality gap）会导致语义对齐偏移或信息丢失。
AI.method: 整体采用细粒度对齐范式，在ViT/Swin提取的patch嵌入与BERT提取的词嵌入上操作。1）约束解耦：构建双路UNet——共享编码器（ViT层）将嵌入映射到高维表示，注入z组高斯噪声（经一层ViT施加结构特征）得到扰动表示，语义解码器与模态解码器各自通过skip connection结合同层级编码器特征解耦输出，对z组结果取平均获得最终语义成分V_s/T_s与模态成分V_m/T_m。2）相关语义识别：对每个特征列在全体patch/词上估计分布C^v_i、C^t_j，用KL散度构造相关性矩阵S（s_{i,j}=exp^{-KL}），因强相关非对称，行列分别稀疏化；以sigmoid表达条件概率，基于采样概率的均值μ与标准差θ设可学习软阈值k=μ+α·θ（α可学习控制稀疏度），生成二值掩码并归一化得到稀疏相关矩阵S_v。3）分布采样：对每个图像分布C^v_i，按软阈值保留的强相关文本分布加权聚合，并以分位对应（累积分布概率相等）采样方式从C^t_j构造\hat{C}^x_j，聚合得跨模态语义（x-语义）分布C^x_i，再反推得到x-语义成分V_x/T_x，即用对方模态的"描述形式"表达本模态语义，弥合模态鸿沟。4）多重约束：L_s为x-语义成分与语义成分之间的对比一致性损失（间接实现跨模态对齐）；L_m约束同模态内模态成分分布一致（KL）；L_f约束模态成分+语义成分重构原始嵌入；L_x约束模态成分+x-语义成分重构原始嵌入。总损失L=α_s L_s+α_m L_m+α_f L_f+(1-α_f)L_x。推理阶段仅需解耦并计算语义成分相关性即可匹配，无需额外操作。
AI.result: 在Flickr30K与MS-COCO（1K/5K）上，以ViT-224/384、Swin-224/384为视觉骨干、BERT为文本骨干，在R@1/5/10与rSum指标上全面超越VSE++、SCAN、SGR、CHAN、LAPS（如ViT-224下Flickr30K rSum 510.6、COCO5K rSum 437.8，ViT-384/Swin-384优势更大），总体领先SOTA 6.6%~14.2%。将架构扩展到CLIP骨干后同样超过CLIP/VSE++/SCAN/LAPS，接近BLIP、ALBEF等VLP模型（如CLIP ViT-224-Large下COCO5K T-to-I R@1 57.6，优于BLIP 63.1? — 低于BLIP，但在其对比方法中领先）。消融显示去掉解耦架构、信息完整性约束、分布采样（改用对比学习）等模块均导致性能下降（CR最高−6.7%）；分布采样作为插件应用到VSE++/SCAN/SGR/CHAN/LAPS均带来0.4%~1.1%提升。可视化表明解耦后同一图像对应文本的嵌入更接近。效率分析显示每批计算Eq.5耗时0.11s，随机采样(0.06s)或全数据集预计算(0.02s)虽更快但精度明显下降，构成主要局限。
AI.conclusion: CDDS通过"约束解耦+分布采样"的组合，在不直接调整嵌入分布、不依赖强行拉近跨模态列级相似度的前提下实现语义层面的跨模态对齐：双路UNet自适应解耦出语义与模态成分，多重约束（语义一致性、模态内一致性、信息完整性/可重构性）保证解耦有效且无损；分布采样基于KL相关性与自适应软阈值识别相关语义，并以对方模态的描述形式构造x-语义成分，从而间接对齐并跨越模态鸿沟。实验表明该方法在多基准、多骨干上优于现有细粒度对齐方法，并可即插即用地增强其他模型，作者将其定位为更"真实语义"的跨模态对齐范式，同时承认逐批KL相关性计算存在O(N²)效率瓶颈。

title: Provuse: Platform-Side Function Fusion for Performance and Efficiency in FaaS Environments
comment: Accepted for publication at the 4th Workshop on SErverless Systems, Applications and MEthodologies (SESAME '26)
summary: Function-as-a-Service (FaaS) platforms provide scalable and cost-efficient execution but suffer from increased latency and resource overheads in complex applications comprising multiple functions, particularly due to double billing when functions call each other. This paper presents Provuse, a transparent, platform-side optimization that automatically performs function fusion at runtime for independently deployed functions, thereby eliminating redundant function instances. This approach reduces both cost and latency without requiring users to change any code. Provusetargets provider-managed FaaS platforms that retain control over function entry points and deployment artifacts, enabling transparent, runtime execution consolidation without developer intervention. We provide two implementations for this approach using the tinyFaaS platform as well as Kubernetes, demonstrating compatibility with container orchestration frameworks. An evaluation shows consistent improvements, achieving an average end-to-end latency reduction of 26.33% and a mean RAM usage reduction of 53.57%. These results indicate that automatic function fusion is an effective platform-side strategy for reducing latency and RAM consumption in composed FaaS applications, highlighting the potential of transparent infrastructure-level optimizations in serverless systems.

AI.tldr: Provuse是一种透明的平台端优化方案，通过在运行时自动执行函数融合来消除冗余函数实例，从而降低FaaS应用的延迟和RAM消耗。
AI.motivation: FaaS平台虽提供可扩展和成本效益优势，但复杂应用（多个函数相互调用）存在延迟增加和资源开销问题，尤其是双重计费（double billing）问题。
AI.method: 在tinyFaaS平台和Kubernetes上实现函数融合优化，无需用户修改代码，保留对函数入口点和部署工件的控制权，实现透明的运行时执行整合。
AI.result: 平均端到端延迟降低26.33%，平均RAM使用降低53.57%。
AI.conclusion: 自动函数融合是降低延迟和RAM消耗的有效平台端策略，揭示了无服务器系统中透明基础设施级优化的潜力。

title: Real-World Fault Detection for C-Extended Python Projects with Automated Unit Test Generation
comment: Accepted at the 19th IEEE International Conference on Software Testing, Verification and Validation (ICST) 2026, Daejeon, Republic of Korea
summary: Many popular Python libraries use C-extensions for performance-critical operations allowing users to combine the best of the two worlds: The simplicity and versatility of Python and the performance of C. A drawback of this approach is that exceptions raised in C can bypass Python's exception handling and cause the entire interpreter to crash. These crashes are real faults if they occur when calling a public API. While automated test generation should, in principle, detect such faults, crashes in native code can halt the test process entirely, preventing detection or reproduction of the underlying errors and inhibiting coverage of non-crashing parts of the code. To overcome this problem, we propose separating the generation and execution stages of the test-generation process. We therefore adapt Pynguin, an automated test case generation tool for Python, to use subprocess-execution. Executing each generated test in an isolated subprocess prevents a crash from halting the test generation process itself. This allows us to (1) detect such faults, (2) generate reproducible crash-revealing test cases for them, (3) allow studying the underlying faults, and (4) enable test generation for non-crashing parts of the code. To evaluate our approach, we created a dataset consisting of 1648 modules from 21 popular Python libraries with C-extensions. Subprocess-execution allowed automated testing of up to 56.5% more modules and discovered 213 unique crash causes, revealing 32 previously unknown faults.

AI.tldr: 针对Python C扩展导致解释器崩溃的问题，提出将测试生成与执行分离的方案，通过子进程执行隔离测试用例，使自动化测试工具Pynguin能够检测到213个独特崩溃原因和32个未知故障，模块覆盖率提升56.5%。
AI.motivation: Python库中的C扩展异常会绕过Python的异常处理机制，导致整个解释器崩溃。现有自动化测试无法有效检测此类故障，因为原生代码崩溃会完全终止测试过程。
AI.method: 将Pynguin（Python自动化测试用例生成工具）适配为使用子进程执行机制，使每个生成的测试在隔离的子进程中运行，从而防止崩溃导致测试生成过程本身终止。
AI.result: 创建了包含21个流行Python库的1648个模块的数据集；子进程执行使自动化测试的模块覆盖率提升至56.5%；发现了213个独特的崩溃原因，揭示了32个先前未知的故障。
AI.conclusion: 通过将测试生成与执行阶段分离，使用子进程执行方式，Pynguin能够检测到C扩展中的崩溃故障，生成可重现的崩溃测试用例，并发现32个先前未知的故障。子进程执行使自动化测试的模块覆盖率提升了56.5%。

title: Aggregative Semantics for Quantitative Bipolar Argumentation Frameworks
summary: Formal argumentation is being used increasingly in artificial intelligence as an effective and understandable way to model potentially conflicting pieces of information, called arguments, and identify so-called acceptable arguments depending on a chosen semantics. This paper deals with the specific context of Quantitative Bipolar Argumentation Frameworks (QBAF), where arguments have intrinsic weights and can attack or support each other. In this context, we introduce a novel family of gradual semantics, called aggregative semantics. In order to deal with situations in which attackers and supporters do not play a symmetric role, and in contrast to modular semantics, we propose to aggregate attackers and supporters separately. This leads to a three-stage computation, which consists in computing a global weight for attackers and another for supporters, before aggregating these two values with the intrinsic weight of the argument. We discuss the properties that the three aggregation functions should satisfy depending on the context, as well as their relationships with the classical principles for gradual semantics. This discussion is supported by various simple examples, as well as a final example on which five hundred aggregative semantics are tested and compared, illustrating the range of possible behaviours with aggregative semantics. Decomposing the computation into three distinct and interpretable steps leads to a more parametrisable computation: it keeps the bipolarity one step further than what is done in the literature, and it leads to more understandable gradual semantics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"聚合语义"的新型渐进语义家族，用于定量双极论证框架(QBAF)。该方法通过三阶段计算（分别聚合攻击者、支持者，再与内在权重聚合）来处理攻击者与支持者的不对称角色，比现有方法更好地保持双极性并提高语义可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有模态语义未能充分处理攻击者和支持者的不对称角色，需要一种新的方法来分别聚合攻击者和支持者，以更好地保持双极性并提高语义的可理解性。
AI.method: 提出三阶段计算方法：首先分别计算攻击者的全局权重和支持者的全局权重，然后结合论证的内在权重进行聚合。讨论了三个聚合函数应满足的属性及其与经典渐进语义原则的关系。
AI.result: 成功引入了聚合语义这一新的渐进语义家族，通过三个阶段的计算实现了对攻击者和支持者的分别处理，提供了500种不同的聚合语义变体进行测试和比较，展示了广泛的 поведение 范围。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过将计算分解为三个不同且可解释的步骤，实现了更高的参数化程度，比现有文献更进一步地保持双极性，从而产生更易理解的渐进语义。实验验证表明，500种不同的聚合语义具有广泛的行为表现范围。

title: FuseDiff: Symmetry-Preserving Joint Diffusion for Dual-Target Structure-Based Drug Design
summary: Dual-target structure-based drug design aims to generate a single ligand together with two pocket-specific binding poses, each compatible with a corresponding target pocket, enabling polypharmacological therapies with improved efficacy and reduced resistance. Existing approaches typically rely on staged pipelines, which either decouple the two poses via conditional-independence assumptions or enforce overly rigid correlations, and therefore fail to jointly generate two target-specific binding modes. To address this, we propose FuseDiff, an end-to-end diffusion model that jointly generates a ligand molecular graph and two pocket-specific binding poses conditioned on both pockets. FuseDiff features a message-passing backbone with Dual-target Local Context Fusion (DLCF), which fuses each ligand atom's local context from both pockets to enable expressive joint modeling while preserving the desired symmetries. Together with explicit bond generation, FuseDiff enforces topological consistency across the two poses under a shared graph while allowing target-specific geometric adaptation in each pocket. To support principled training and evaluation, we derive a dual-target training set and use an independent held-out test set for evaluation. Experiments on the benchmark and a real-world dual-target system show that FuseDiff achieves state-of-the-art docking performance and enables the first systematic assessment of dual-target pose quality prior to docking-based pose search.

AI.tldr: FuseDiff是一种端到端的扩散模型，用于双靶点结构-based药物设计，可同时生成配体分子图和两个口袋特异性结合姿态。
AI.motivation: 现有双靶点药物设计方法通常依赖分级流水线，要么通过条件独立假设解耦两种姿态，要么强制执行过于严格的相关性，无法联合生成两个靶点特异性的结合模式。
AI.method: 提出FuseDiff模型，包含带双靶点局部上下文融合(DLCF)的消息传递骨架，从两个口袋融合每个配体原子的局部上下文以实现表达性联合建模，同时保持所需对称性。结合显式键生成，在共享图下强制两个姿态间的拓扑一致性，同时允许每个口袋的几何适应性。
AI.result: 在基准测试和真实世界双靶点系统上的实验表明，FuseDiff实现了最先进的对接性能，并首次实现了基于对接姿态搜索前的双靶点姿态质量系统评估。
AI.conclusion: FuseDiff成功实现了端到端的双靶点配体和结合姿态联合生成，为多靶点药物治疗提供了新范式。

title: MoEless: Efficient MoE LLM Serving via Serverless Computing
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become a cornerstone of AI, driving progress across diverse domains such as content creation, search and recommendation systems, and AI-assisted workflows. To alleviate extreme training costs and advancing model scales, Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has become a popular backbone for modern LLMs, which are commonly served in distributed deployment using expert parallelism (EP). However, MoE's sparse activation mechanism leads to severe expert load imbalance, where a few experts become overloaded while others remain idle, resulting in expert stragglers that inflate inference latency and serving cost. Existing expert load balancing solutions assume static resource configurations on serverful infrastructures, limiting expert scalability and elasticity, and resulting in either costly real-time expert swapping or degraded generation quality. We present MoEless, the first serverless MoE serving framework that mitigates expert load imbalance and accelerates inference via serverless experts. MoEless employs lightweight, layer-aware predictors to accurately estimate incoming expert load distributions and proactively identify stragglers. We design optimized expert scaling and placement strategies to maximize function locality, improve GPU utilization, and balance loads across experts and GPUs. MoEless is prototyped on top of Megatron-LM and deployed on an eight-GPU testbed. Experiments with open-source MoE models and real-world workloads show that MoEless reduces inference latency by 43% and inference cost by 84% compared to state-of-the-art solutions.

AI.tldr: MoEless是首个解决MoE模型专家负载不均衡问题的无服务器服务框架,通过层感知负载预测和优化专家放置策略,显著降低推理延迟和成本。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型(LLM)虽然性能强大,但训练和推理成本极高。MoE(混合专家)架构通过稀疏激活机制成为主流 backbone,但存在严重的专家负载不均衡问题:少数专家过载而大部分专家闲置,导致推理延迟增加和服务成本上升。现有方案假设静态资源配置,缺乏可扩展性和弹性。
AI.method: 提出MoEless,首个无服务器MoE服务框架。该框架包含:(1)轻量级层感知预测器,精确估计输入专家负载分布并主动识别落后者;(2)优化专家扩展和放置策略,最大化函数局部性、提高GPU利用率、平衡专家和GPU间负载。基于Megatron-LM实现,部署于8GPU测试平台。
AI.result: 与现有最优方案相比,MoEless将推理延迟降低43%,推理成本降低84%。实验使用开源MoE模型和真实工作负载进行验证。
AI.conclusion: 首次将无服务器架构引入MoE推理场景,证明了serverless范式可有效解决分布式MoE系统中的负载均衡难题,为高效低成本LLM推理提供了新思路。

title: Can Adjusting Hyperparameters Lead to Green Deep Learning: An Empirical Study on Correlations between Hyperparameters and Energy Consumption of Deep Learning Models
summary: Context: Along with developing Deep learning (DL) models, larger datasets and more complex model structures are applied, leading to rising computing resources and energy consumption, which is an alert that green DL models should receive more attention. Objective: This paper focuses on a novel view to analyze DL energy consumption: the effect of hyperparameters on the energy cost of DL models. Method: Our approach involves using mutation operators to simulate how practitioners adjust hyperparameters, such as epochs and learning rates. We train the original and mutated models separately and gather energy information and run-time performance metrics. Moreover, we focus on the parallel scenario where multiple DL models are trained in parallel. Results: To examine the effect of hyperparameters on energy consumption, we conducted extensive experiments on five real-world DL models. The results show that (1) many hyperparameters studied have a (positive or negative) correlation with energy consumption, (2) adjusting hyperparameters can make DL models greener, i.e., lead to less energy consumption without performance damage, and (3) in a parallel environment, energy consumption becomes more susceptible to change. Conclusions: We suggest that hyperparameters need more attention in developing DL models, as appropriately adjusting hyperparameters would cause green DL models.

AI.tldr: 该研究从超参数角度分析深度学习模型的能耗问题。通过使用变异运算符模拟超参数调整，在五个真实模型上实验发现超参数与能耗存在相关性，适当调整超参数可在不损失性能的前提下实现绿色深度学习，且并行环境下能耗更敏感。建议在深度学习模型开发中重视超参数调优。
AI.motivation: 随着深度学习模型规模增大、数据集增多、模型结构变复杂，计算资源和能源消耗不断增加，绿色深度学习模型应受到更多关注。该研究旨在从超参数视角分析深度学习模型的能耗问题。
AI.method: 使用变异运算符模拟从业者调整超参数（如轮次和学习率）的过程，分别训练原始模型和变异模型，收集能耗信息和运行时性能指标，并重点关注多个深度学习模型并行训练的并行场景。
AI.result: 在五个真实深度学习模型上的广泛实验表明：(1) 许多研究的超参数与能耗呈正相关或负相关；(2) 调整超参数可以使深度学习模型更环保，即在不损害性能的情况下减少能耗；(3) 在并行环境中，能耗更容易受到影响而发生变化。
AI.conclusion: 超参数需要更多关注，适当调整超参数可以实现绿色深度学习模型。研究者应在模型开发过程中重视超参数调优，以在不影响性能的前提下降低能耗。

title: Offline Materials Optimization with CliqueFlowmer
summary: Recent advances in deep learning inspired neural network-based approaches to computational materials discovery (CMD). A plethora of problems in this field involve finding materials that optimize a target property. Nevertheless, the increasingly popular generative modeling methods are ineffective at boldly exploring attractive regions of the materials space due to their maximum likelihood training. In this work, we offer an alternative CMD technique based on offline model-based optimization (MBO) that fuses direct optimization of a target material property into generation. To that end, we introduce a domain-specific model, dubbed CliqueFlowmer, that incorporates recent advances of clique-based MBO into transformer and flow generation. We validate CliqueFlowmer's optimization abilities and show that materials it produces strongly outperform those provided by generative baselines. To enable employment of CliqueFlowmer in specialized materials optimization problems and support interdisciplinary research, we open-source our code at https://github.com/znowu/CliqueFlowmer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CliqueFlowmer，一种结合离线模型优化(MBO)、Transformer和流生成的新方法，用于计算材料发现中的材料属性优化任务。
AI.motivation: 当前生成建模方法由于最大似然训练的局限性，难以大胆探索材料空间中具有吸引力的区域，亟需一种能够直接将目标材料属性优化融入生成过程的方法。
AI.method: 提出CliqueFlowmer模型，将基于 clique 的离线 MBO 机制融入 Transformer 和流生成框架，实现属性导向的材料生成。
AI.result: CliqueFlowmer 生成的材料性能显著优于生成式基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 离线模型优化与生成模型的有效融合能够克服传统最大似然训练的局限，为计算材料发现提供更优的优化能力。

title: Why Depth Matters in Parallelizable Sequence Models: A Lie Algebraic View
summary: Scalable sequence models, such as Transformer variants and structured state-space models, often trade expressivity power for sequence-level parallelism, which enables efficient training. Here we examine the bounds on error and how error scales when models operate outside of their expressivity regimes using a Lie-algebraic control perspective. Our theory formulates a correspondence between the depth of a sequence model and the tower of Lie algebra extensions. Echoing recent theoretical studies, we characterize the Lie-algebraic class of constant-depth sequence models and their corresponding expressivity bounds. Furthermore, we analytically derive an approximation error bound and show that error diminishes exponentially as the depth increases, consistent with the strong empirical performance of these models. We validate our theoretical predictions using experiments on symbolic word and continuous-valued state-tracking problems.

AI.tldr: 本文从Lie代数控制理论角度分析序列模型（Transformer和状态空间模型）的表达能力边界，建立了模型深度与Lie代数扩张塔之间的对应关系，证明了常数深度模型的表达能力界限，并推导出近似误差随深度指数衰减的边界。实验验证了理论预测。
AI.motivation: 可扩展序列模型（如Transformer和状态空间模型）常在表达能力和序列级并行性之间权衡。当模型超出其表达能力范围时，误差如何扩展是一个基础性问题。现有研究缺乏从统一理论框架理解深度与表达能力关系的工具。
AI.method: 采用Lie代数控制理论视角，将序列模型的深度对应为Lie代数的扩张塔，建立常数深度序列模型的Lie代数类刻画，解析推导近似误差边界，并通过符号词汇和连续值状态跟踪问题进行实验验证。
AI.result: 1）建立了深度与Lie代数扩张塔的对应关系；2）刻画了常数深度模型的Lie代数类及表达能力边界；3）证明近似误差随深度指数衰减；4）实验结果与理论预测一致。
AI.conclusion: 本文为理解序列模型的表达能力提供了统一的Lie代数框架，解释了深层模型强大经验性能的理论基础，表明增加深度可指数级提升表达能力，为模型架构设计提供了理论指导。

title: Comparative Analysis of Cross-Chain Token Standards
summary: Cross-chain token standards enable fungible tokens that exist across multiple blockchains with a unified total supply model. This paper presents a comprehensive comparative analysis of five leading cross-chain token standards and frameworks: the xERC20 standard (implementing ERC-7281), the Omnichain Fungible Token (OFT) standard, the Native Token Transfers (NTT) framework, the Cross-Chain Token (CCT) standard, and the SuperchainERC20 standard (implementing ERC-7802). We examine each standard's distinguishing properties and technical design, including architecture, message-passing mechanisms, interoperability scope, chain compatibility, and security features. Our analysis reveals that while all these standards share the goal of seamless cross-chain fungibility, they differ significantly in implementation approach, trust model, and target ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 本文对五种领先的跨链代币标准和框架进行了全面的比较分析，包括xERC20 (ERC-7281)、OFT、NTT、CCT和SuperchainERC20 (ERC-7802)， examining their architecture, message-passing mechanisms, interoperability scope, chain compatibility, and security features.
AI.motivation: 跨链代币标准使可替代代币能够在多条区块链上存在，并采用统一的总供应量模型。然而，现有的跨链代币标准在实现方法、信任模型和目标生态系统方面存在显著差异，需要系统的比较分析来帮助开发者和生态系统理解各标准的优劣势。
AI.method: 对五种领先的跨链代币标准进行综合比较分析，审查每个标准的技术设计特性，包括架构、消息传递机制、互操作性范围、链兼容性以及安全特性。
AI.result: 分析揭示了尽管所有这些标准都致力于实现无缝跨链可替代性，但在实现方法、信任模型和目标生态系统方面存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 不同跨链代币标准各有其独特的技术设计和适用场景，开发者在选择时需要根据具体需求权衡各标准在架构、消息传递机制、兼容性及安全性等方面的特点。

title: Story Point Estimation Using Large Language Models
summary: This study investigates the use of large language models (LLMs) for story point estimation. Story points are unitless, project-specific effort estimates that help developers on the scrum team forecast which product backlog items they plan to complete in a sprint. To facilitate this process, machine learning models, especially deep neural networks, have been applied to predict the story points based on the title and description of each item. However, such machine learning models require sufficient amounts of training data (with ground truth story points annotated by human developers) from the same software project to achieve decent prediction performance. This motivated us to explore whether LLMs are capable of (RQ1) predicting story points without training data or (RQ2) with only a few training data points. Our empirical results with four LLMs on 16 software projects show that, without any training data (zero-shot prompting), LLMs can predict story points better than supervised deep learning models trained on 80% of the data. The prediction performance of LLMs can be further improved with a few training examples (few-shot prompting). In addition, a recent study explored the use of comparative judgments (between a given pair of items which one requires more effort to implement) instead of directly annotating the story points to reduce the cognitive burden on developers. Therefore, this study also explores (RQ3) whether comparative judgments are easier to predict than story points for LLMs and (RQ4) whether comparative judgments can serve as few-shot examples for LLMs to improve their predictions of story points. Empirical results suggest that it is not easier for LLMs to predict comparative judgments than to directly estimate the story points, but comparative judgments can serve as few-shot examples to improve the LLMs' prediction performance as well as the human-annotated story points.

AI.tldr: 研究探索了大语言模型在敏捷软件开发故事点估算中的应用，实验表明LLM在无训练数据条件下性能优于传统监督深度学习模型，且通过few-shot提示和比较判断可进一步提升预测效果。
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习模型需要大量带标签的训练数据才能达到良好的故事点预测性能，而LLM在零样本和少样本任务中展现出强大能力，因此有必要探索LLM在故事点估算中的潜力。
AI.method: 在16个软件项目上测试4种LLM模型，采用zero-shot和few-shot提示策略，比较LLM与传统深度学习模型的预测性能，并探索比较判断作为few-shot示例的可行性。
AI.result: LLM在zero-shot场景下即可超越传统深度学习模型（训练数据80%），few-shot提示可进一步提升预测准确率。比较判断并不比直接估算故事点更容易预测，但可作为有效的few-shot示例提升LLM性能。
AI.conclusion: LLMs在软件项目故事点估算中具有显著优势，无需训练数据即可超越传统监督学习模型，且few-shot提示可进一步提升性能。比较判断虽不易预测，但可作为有效的few-shot示例来辅助LLMs预测故事点。

title: A Novel Hybrid Heuristic-Reinforcement Learning Optimization Approach for a Class of Railcar Shunting Problems
summary: Railcar shunting is a core planning task in freight railyards, where yard planners need to disassemble and reassemble groups of railcars to form outbound trains. Classification tracks with access from one side only can be considered as stack structures, where railcars are added and removed from only one end, leading to a last-in-first-out (LIFO) retrieval order. In contrast, two-sided tracks function like queue structures, allowing railcars to be added from one end and removed from the opposite end, following a first-in-first-out (FIFO) order. We consider a problem requiring assembly of multiple outbound trains using two locomotives in a railyard with two-sided classification track access. To address this combinatorially challenging problem class, we decompose the problem into two subproblems, each with one-sided classification track access and a locomotive on each side. We present a novel Hybrid Heuristic-Reinforcement Learning (HHRL) framework that integrates railway-specific heuristic solution approaches with a reinforcement learning method, specifically Q-learning. The proposed framework leverages methods to decrease the state-action space and guide exploration during reinforcement learning. The results of a series of numerical experiments demonstrate the efficiency and quality of the HHRL algorithm in both one-sided access, single-locomotive problems and two-sided access, two-locomotive problems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究铁路货场中列车车厢调度问题，提出一种混合启发式-强化学习框架(HHRL)，结合Q-learning算法解决单边/双边分类轨道和单/双机车场景下的列车组装优化问题。
AI.motivation: 铁路货运场站的车厢调度是核心规划任务，需将车厢拆解重组为出站列车。传统研究多关注单边访问的分类轨道（类比栈结构，LIFO顺序），而双边轨道（类比队列结构，FIFO顺序）的场景更具实际意义但复杂度更高。如何有效解决双边访问、双机车场景下的组合优化问题是研究的主要动机。
AI.method: 提出混合启发式-强化学习(HHRL)框架：1)将原问题分解为两个单边访问子问题，每侧配置一台机车；2)集成 railway-specific 启发式求解方法与 Q-learning 强化学习方法；3)通过状态-动作空间压缩和探索引导策略降低问题维度。数值实验涵盖单边单机车和双边双机车两种场景。
AI.result: 实验结果表明 HHRL 算法在单边访问单机车问题和双边访问双机车问题上均表现出较高的求解效率和解的质量，验证了混合方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功将强化学习与传统运筹学方法结合，为铁路调车场调度问题提供了新思路。HHRL 框架通过问题分解和状态空间约简，有效处理了双边轨道双机车的复杂组合优化场景，为实际铁路运营中的多机车协同调度提供了可行的解决方案。

title: First-Order Softmax Weighted Switching Gradient Method for Distributed Stochastic Minimax Optimization with Stochastic Constraints
summary: This paper addresses the distributed stochastic minimax optimization problem subject to stochastic constraints. We propose a novel first-order Softmax-Weighted Switching Gradient method tailored for federated learning. Under full client participation, our algorithm achieves the standard $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-4})$ oracle complexity to satisfy a unified bound $ε$ for both the optimality gap and feasibility tolerance. We extend our theoretical analysis to the practical partial participation regime by quantifying client sampling noise through a stochastic superiority assumption. Furthermore, by relaxing standard boundedness assumptions on the objective functions, we establish a strictly tighter lower bound for the softmax hyperparameter. We provide a unified error decomposition and establish a sharp $\mathcal{O}(\log\frac{1}δ)$ high-probability convergence guarantee. Ultimately, our framework demonstrates that a single-loop primal-only switching mechanism provides a stable alternative for optimizing worst-case client performance, effectively bypassing the hyperparameter sensitivity and convergence oscillations often encountered in traditional primal-dual or penalty-based approaches. We verify the efficacy of our algorithm via experiment on the Neyman-Pearson (NP) classification and fair classification tasks.

AI.tldr: 针对联邦学习中的分布式随机 minimax 优化问题，提出 Softmax-Weighted Switching Gradient 方法，在全客户端参与下达到 O(ε^{-4}) oracle 复杂度，通过单循环原始切换机制提供稳定的最差客户端性能优化。
AI.motivation: 分布式随机 minimax 优化在联邦学习中具有重要意义，但现有方法面临收敛振荡和超参数敏感性问题。传统原始-对偶或惩罚方法在处理约束和客户端异构性时存在挑战。
AI.method: 提出一种新型一阶 Softmax-Weighted Switching Gradient 方法，采用单循环原始切换机制。通过随机优越性假设量化部分参与下的客户端采样噪声，放宽目标函数的有界性假设以获得更紧的 softmax 超参数下界。
AI.result: 在全客户端参与下达到标准的 O(ε^{-4}) oracle 复杂度，实现统一的最优性间隙和可行性容差界。通过随机优越性假设将分析扩展到实际的部分参与场景。建立 O(log(1/δ)) 高概率收敛保证。在 Neyman-Pearson 分类和公平分类任务上验证了算法有效性。
AI.conclusion: 单循环原始切换机制为优化最差客户端性能提供了稳定替代方案，有效规避了传统原始-对偶或惩罚方法中的超参数敏感性和收敛振荡问题。

title: A Generalized Feature Model for Digital Twins
